Wǒ de xuéshēng qiānzhèng míngnián liùyuè dàoqī.
My student visa expires next June.

Xīnshēng rùxué de shíhou, xuéxiào huì gěi dàjiā jièshào xiàoyuán.
When new students enroll, the school introduces them to the campus.
我刚收到学校的通知，明天不上课。
Wǒgāng shōudào xuéxiào de tōngzhī, míngtiān bú shàngkè.

Qù yínháng bànkǎ de shíhou, biéwàngle dài zhèngjiàn.
Don't forget your ID papers when you open a bank card.

任何时候你需要帮助，都可以给我打电话。

Whenever you need help, you can call me.

Our school cafeteria's food is cheap and tasty.

她打算申请去中国的大学读研究生。

She plans to apply to a Chinese university for grad school.

Tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì, huòdé le quán'é jiǎngxuéjīn.

这个学期他在课上表现得很积极。
Zhège xuéqī tā zài kèshàng biǎoxiàn de hěn jījí.
This semester he's been very active in class.
我们班在比赛中获得了第一名。
Wǒmen bān zài bǐsài zhōng huòdé le dì-yī míng.
Our class won first place in the competition.
要是明天下雨，我们就在家看电影。
Yàoshi míngtiān xiàyǔ, wǒmen jiù zàijiā kàn diànyǐng.
If it rains tomorrow, we'll watch a movie at home.
运动可以减轻学习的压力。
Yùndòng kěyǐ jiǎnqīng xuéxí de yālì.
Exercise can relieve study pressure.
这几年这个城市的经济发展得很快。
Zhè jǐnián zhège chéngshì de jīngjì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
This city's economy has grown fast in recent years.

Everyone is under a lot of pressure before exams.
明天你有比赛，我去给你加油！
Míngtiān nǐ yǒu bǐsài, wǒ qù gěi nǐ jiāyóu!
You have a match tomorrow; I'll come cheer for you!
随着时间的变化，我越来越喜欢这个城市。
Suízhe shíjiān de biànhuà, wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuan zhège chéngshì.
As time goes by, I like this city more and more.
这学期我选了五门课程。
Zhè xuéqī wǒxuǎn le wǔmén kèchéng.
I chose five courses this semester.
我的专业是软件工程。
Wǒ de zhuānyè shì ruǎnjiàn gōngchéng.
My major is software engineering.
我姐姐本科毕业以后就开始工作了。
Wǒ jiějiě běnkē bìyè yǐhòu jiù kāishǐ gōngzuò le.
My older sister started working after getting her bachelor's.
他打算毕业以后读硕士。
Tā dǎsuàn bìyè yǐhòu dú shuòshì.
He plans to do a master's after graduating.
我们实验室有三个研究生。
Wǒmen shíyànshì yǒu sānge yánjiūshēng.
There are three grad students in our lab.
李老师在美国读的博士。
Lǐ lǎoshī zài Měiguó dú de bóshì.
Teacher Li did her PhD in the US.
他在研究怎么用电脑学习中文。
Tā zài yánjiū zěnme yòng diànnǎo xuéxí Zhōngwén.
He is researching how to learn Chinese with computers.

Zhōumò xuéxiào yǒu hěn duō xiàoyuán huódòng.
There are many campus activities on weekends.
我通过朋友认识了我的室友。

I met my roommate through a friend.
我常常和中国同学交流学习经验。
Wǒ chángcháng hé Zhōngguó tóngxué jiāoliú xuéxí jīngyàn.
I often share study experiences with Chinese classmates.
刚来中国的时候，我不太适应这里的天气。

When I first came to China, I wasn't used to the weather here.
你将来想在哪个城市工作？

September 10 is Teachers' Day in China.
他爸爸在一家贸易公司工作。
Tā bàbà zài yìjiā màoyì gōngsī gōngzuò.

When it comes to studying, he has always worked hard.
看书可以学到很多知识。
Kànshū kěyǐ xuédào hěn duō zhīshi.

This room is too small; let's look at another one.

texts.title: At the college office, Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong go through the enrollment procedures

lines.zh: 你们好，欢迎来到中国留学！请把护照、签证和入学通知书给我。
lines.py: Nǐmen hǎo, huānyíng lái dào Zhōngguó liúxué! Qǐng bǎ hùzhào, qiānzhèng hé rùxué tōngzhīshū gěi wǒ.
lines.en: Hello, welcome to study in China! Please give me your passports, visas and admission letters.

lines.zh: 好的。这是我们的证件和材料。
lines.py: Hǎo de. Zhè shì wǒmen de zhèngjiàn hé cáiliào.
lines.en: OK. Here are our documents and materials.

lines.zh: （几分钟后。）
lines.py: (Jǐ fēnzhōng hòu.)
lines.en: (A few minutes later.)

lines.zh: 办好了，这是你们的学生证，下周一开始上课。先试听两周，然后在网上选课。
lines.py: Bànhǎo le, zhè shì nǐmen de xuéshēngzhèng, xià zhōuyī kāishǐ shàngkè. Xiān shìtīng liǎng zhōu, ránhòu zài wǎngshang xuǎn kè.
lines.en: All done. Here are your student ID cards. Classes start next Monday. First sit in on classes for two weeks, then choose your courses online.

lines.zh: 谢谢老师。
lines.py: Xièxie lǎoshī.
lines.en: Thank you, teacher.

lines.zh: 不客气，你们以后有任何问题都可以来找我。
lines.py: Bú kèqi, nǐmen yǐhòu yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ lái zhǎo wǒ.
lines.en: You're welcome. If you have any problems later, you can always come to me.

texts.title: On the university campus, Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong stroll and chat

lines.zh: 你看，咱们的校园真大！有图书馆、体育馆、超市，还有好几个食堂。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zánmen de xiàoyuán zhēn dà! Yǒu túshūguǎn, tǐyùguǎn, chāoshì, hái yǒu hǎo jǐ ge shítáng.
lines.en: Look, our campus is really big! There's a library, a gym, a supermarket, and several dining halls.

lines.zh: 是啊，我觉得学校就像一座小城市，什么都有，方便极了。
lines.py: Shì a, wǒ juéde xuéxiào jiù xiàng yí zuò xiǎo chéngshì, shénme dōu yǒu, fāngbiàn jí le.
lines.en: Yes, I think the school is like a small city. It has everything, so it's extremely convenient.

lines.zh: 刚才老师说，咱们可以申请奖学金，你了解过吗？
lines.py: Gāngcái lǎoshī shuō, zánmen kěyǐ shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, nǐ liǎojiě guo ma?
lines.en: The teacher just said we can apply for scholarships. Have you looked into it?

lines.zh: 我听说过一点儿，好像成绩好、表现好的学生都有机会获得奖学金。
lines.py: Wǒ tīngshuō guo yìdiǎnr, hǎoxiàng chéngjì hǎo, biǎoxiàn hǎo de xuéshēng dōu yǒu jīhuì huòdé jiǎngxuéjīn.
lines.en: I've heard a little. It seems students with good grades and good performance all have a chance to win a scholarship.

lines.zh: 那太好了，要是申请到奖学金，就能减轻不少经济压力。
lines.py: Nà tài hǎo le, yàoshi shēnqǐng dào jiǎngxuéjīn, jiù néng jiǎnqīng bù shǎo jīngjì yālì.
lines.en: That's great. If we get a scholarship, it will ease a lot of financial pressure.

lines.zh: 没错，我们一起加油吧！
lines.py: Méi cuò, wǒmen yìqǐ jiāyóu ba!
lines.en: Exactly. Let's work hard together!

texts.title: The study and life of international students at Chinese universities

lines.zh: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国学生来到中国的大学学习。他们可以先上一年的中文课程，然后根据自己的兴趣和需要选择专业。除了读本科课程，他们还可以申请读硕士研究生或者博士研究生。
lines.py: Suízhe Zhōngguó de fāzhǎn, yuè lái yuè duō de wàiguó xuéshēng lái dào Zhōngguó de dàxué xuéxí. Tāmen kěyǐ xiān shàng yì nián de Zhōngwén kèchéng, ránhòu gēnjù zìjǐ de xìngqù hé xūyào xuǎnzé zhuānyè. Chúle dú běnkēkèchéng, tāmen hái kěyǐ shēnqǐng dú shuòshì yánjiūshēng huòzhě bóshì yánjiūshēng.
lines.en: With China's development, more and more international students come to study at Chinese universities. They can first take a one-year Chinese course, then choose a major based on their own interests and needs. Besides undergraduate programs, they can also apply for master's or doctoral programs.

lines.zh: 在大学里，外国学生可以和中国学生一起学习、做研究、参加校园活动。通过这些交流，外国学生能更快地适应中国的大学生活。
lines.py: Zài dàxué li, wàiguó xuéshēng kěyǐ hé Zhōngguó xuéshēng yìqǐ xuéxí, zuò yánjiū, cānjiā xiàoyuán huódòng. Tōngguò zhèxiē jiāoliú, wàiguó xuéshēng néng gèng kuài de shìyìng Zhōngguó de dàxué shēnghuó.
lines.en: At university, international students can study, do research and take part in campus activities together with Chinese students. Through these exchanges, they can adapt to Chinese university life faster.

texts.title: Major selection and career development

lines.zh: 很多外国学生来中国学习以前，就已经想好了自己的发展方向。有人对经济感兴趣，希望将来在国际公司工作；有人喜欢学医，打算回国后当一名医生；还有人对教育有热情，想要成为一名教师。
lines.py: Hěn duō wàiguó xuéshēng lái Zhōngguó xuéxí yǐqián, jiù yǐjīng xiǎng hǎo le zìjǐ de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng. Yǒu rén duì jīngjì gǎn xìngqù, xīwàng jiānglái zài guójì gōngsī gōngzuò; yǒu rén xǐhuan xué yī, dǎsuàn huí guó hòu dāng yì míng yīshēng; hái yǒu rén duì jiàoyù yǒu rèqíng, xiǎngyào chéngwéi yì míng jiàoshī.
lines.en: Before coming to study in China, many international students have already decided on their career direction. Some are interested in economics and hope to work for an international company in the future; some like studying medicine and plan to become doctors after returning home; others are passionate about education and want to become teachers.

lines.zh: 陈天中想选择跟经济有关的专业，希望通过学习，了解更多国际贸易方面的知识。安妮以后想做一名中文老师，所以要选择国际中文教育专业。对他们来说，来到中国留学，一方面是为了学习语言和知识，另一方面也是为将来的工作和生活做准备。
lines.py: Chén Tiānzhōng xiǎng xuǎnzé gēn jīngjì yǒuguān de zhuānyè, xīwàng tōngguò xuéxí, liǎojiě gèng duō guójì màoyì fāngmiàn de zhīshi. Ānnī yǐhòu xiǎng zuò yì míng Zhōngwén lǎoshī, suǒyǐ yào xuǎnzé guójì Zhōngwén jiàoyù zhuānyè. Duì tāmen lái shuō, lái dào Zhōngguó liúxué, yì fāngmiàn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán hé zhīshi, lìng yì fāngmiàn yě shì wèi jiānglái de gōngzuò hé shēnghuó zuò zhǔnbèi.
lines.en: Chen Tianzhong wants to choose a major related to economics, hoping to learn more about international trade through his studies. Annie wants to be a Chinese teacher in the future, so she will major in International Chinese Education. For them, studying in China is partly to learn the language and knowledge, and partly to prepare for their future work and life.

grammar.title: Demonstrative pronoun 任何 (rènhé)
grammar.note: 任何 means "any / whatever". When it modifies a noun it usually takes no 的, and it is often followed by 都 or 也.
ex: 你们以后有任何问题都可以来找我。
Nǐmen yǐhòu yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ lái zhǎo wǒ.
If you have any problems later, you can always come to me.
明天我们8点出发，任何人也不能迟到。
Míngtiān wǒmen bā diǎn chūfā, rènhé rén yě bù néng chídào.
We set off at 8 tomorrow; nobody can be late.
学校有任何通知，我都会第一时间告诉你。
Xuéxiào yǒu rènhé tōngzhī, wǒ dōu huì dì-yī shíjiān gàosu nǐ.
Whenever the school has any notice, I'll tell you right away.

grammar.title: Hypothetical sentence 要是……，就……
grammar.note: The first clause (要是…) states a condition; the second clause (就…) gives the result if that condition comes true. = "if …, then …"
ex: 要是申请到奖学金，就能减轻不少经济压力。
Yàoshi shēnqǐng dào jiǎngxuéjīn, jiù néng jiǎnqīng bù shǎo jīngjì yālì.
If we get a scholarship, it will ease a lot of financial pressure.
你要是明天有时间，就跟我一起去爬山吧。
Nǐ yàoshi míngtiān yǒu shíjiān, jiù gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù páshān ba.
If you have time tomorrow, come hiking with me.
要是她不愿意参加比赛，我们就再问问别人。
Yàoshi tā bú yuànyì cānjiā bǐsài, wǒmen jiù zài wènwèn biérén.
If she doesn't want to join the competition, we'll ask someone else.

grammar.title: Preposition 随着 (suízhe)
grammar.note: 随着 is usually followed by a word or clause describing a change. It shows that one thing happens as a result of (along with) another change. = "along with / as …"
ex: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国学生来到中国的大学学习。
Suízhe Zhōngguó de fāzhǎn, yuè lái yuè duō de wàiguó xuéshēng lái dào Zhōngguó de dàxué xuéxí.
With China's development, more and more international students come to study at Chinese universities.
随着中文水平的提高，我现在能看懂中文报纸了。
Suízhe Zhōngwén shuǐpíng de tígāo, wǒ xiànzài néng kàndǒng Zhōngwén bàozhǐ le.
As my Chinese improves, I can now understand Chinese newspapers.
随着小区的环境越来越好，来这里买房子的人也变多了。
Suízhe xiǎoqū de huánjìng yuè lái yuè hǎo, lái zhèlǐ mǎi fángzi de rén yě biàn duō le.
As the neighborhood gets nicer and nicer, more people come here to buy homes.

grammar.title: 一方面……，另一方面……
grammar.note: Used to explain two reasons or situations that exist at the same time. = "on the one hand …, on the other hand …"
ex: 来到中国留学，一方面是为了学习语言和知识，另一方面也是为将来的工作和生活做准备。
Lái dào Zhōngguó liúxué, yì fāngmiàn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán hé zhīshi, lìng yì fāngmiàn yě shì wèi jiānglái de gōngzuò hé shēnghuó zuò zhǔnbèi.
Studying in China is partly to learn the language and knowledge, and partly to prepare for future work and life.
他经常在网上买东西，一方面因为便宜，另一方面因为方便。
Tā jīngcháng zài wǎngshang mǎi dōngxi, yì fāngmiàn yīnwèi piányi, lìng yì fāngmiàn yīnwèi fāngbiàn.
He often shops online, partly because it's cheap and partly because it's convenient.
多做运动一方面能让身体更健康，另一方面也能减轻压力。
Duō zuò yùndòng yì fāngmiàn néng ràng shēntǐ gèng jiànkāng, lìng yì fāngmiàn yě néng jiǎnqīng yālì.
Exercising more makes you healthier and also reduces stress.

fill.q: 她＿＿了三年的奖学金，高兴极了。
full: 她获得了三年的奖学金，高兴极了。
Tā huòdé le sān nián de jiǎngxuéjīn, gāoxìng jí le.
She won a three-year scholarship and was overjoyed.
fill.why: 获得 + 奖学金 is a fixed collocation (win/obtain a scholarship). 获得 takes 了 and an object here.

fill.q: 我是2024年＿＿的，学的是国际经济专业。
full: 我是2024年入学的，学的是国际经济专业。
Wǒ shì èr líng èr sì nián rùxué de, xué de shì guójì jīngjì zhuānyè.
I enrolled in 2024, and my major is international economics.
fill.why: Pattern: [year] + 入学 = enrolled in that year. 我是2024年入学的 uses 是……的 to stress the time of enrolling.

fill.q: 我打算考研究生，提高自己的＿＿水平。
full: 我打算考研究生，提高自己的专业水平。
Wǒ dǎsuàn kǎo yánjiūshēng, tígāo zìjǐ de zhuānyè shuǐpíng.
I plan to take the graduate entrance exam to raise my professional level.
fill.why: 专业水平 = professional/academic level in one's major. The sentence is about grad school, so the level of one's 专业 fits.

fill.q: 咱们晚上别去＿＿吃饭了，我请你出去吃饭吧。
full: 咱们晚上别去食堂吃饭了，我请你出去吃饭吧。
Zánmen wǎnshang bié qù shítáng chī fàn le, wǒ qǐng nǐ chūqu chī fàn ba.
Let's not eat at the dining hall tonight. I'll take you out to dinner.
fill.why: 去 + place + 吃饭: the blank needs a place. 食堂 (dining hall) is the only place word in the bank.

fill.q: 王经理今天下午去办＿＿了，您明天再来找他吧。
full: 王经理今天下午去办签证了，您明天再来找他吧。
Wáng jīnglǐ jīntiān xiàwǔ qù bàn qiānzhèng le, nín míngtiān zài lái zhǎo tā ba.
Manager Wang went to apply for his visa this afternoon. Please come back tomorrow.
fill.why: 办签证 = apply for / get a visa processed. 办 collocates with documents: 办签证、办护照、办学生证.

fill.q: A：你＿＿想做什么工作？B：我想在国际公司工作，有更多的发展机会。
full: A：你将来想做什么工作？B：我想在国际公司工作，有更多的发展机会。
A: Nǐ jiānglái xiǎng zuò shénme gōngzuò? B: Wǒ xiǎng zài guójì gōngsī gōngzuò, yǒu gèng duō de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
A: What job do you want in the future? B: I want to work for an international company, where there are more opportunities.
fill.why: 将来 (in the future) answers 想做什么工作 — B talks about the job he wants later on.

fill.q: A：你为什么选择这门课程？B：因为我想认真＿＿中国的历史和文化。
full: A：你为什么选择这门课程？B：因为我想认真研究中国的历史和文化。
A: Nǐ wèishénme xuǎnzé zhè mén kèchéng? B: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng rènzhēn yánjiū Zhōngguó de lìshǐ hé wénhuà.
A: Why did you choose this course? B: Because I want to seriously study Chinese history and culture.
fill.why: 认真 + verb: 认真研究 = study seriously. 研究 takes an object (中国的历史和文化).

fill.q: A：今天下午公司有＿＿，我晚点儿回家。B：好。大概几点结束？需要我去接你吗？
full: A：今天下午公司有活动，我晚点儿回家。B：好。大概几点结束？需要我去接你吗？
A: Jīntiān xiàwǔ gōngsī yǒu huódòng, wǒ wǎn diǎnr huí jiā. B: Hǎo. Dàgài jǐ diǎn jiéshù? Xūyào wǒ qù jiē nǐ ma?
A: The company has an event this afternoon, so I'll be home late. B: OK. About what time will it end? Do you need me to pick you up?
fill.why: 公司有活动 = the company has an event. That's why A will be home late.

fill.q: A：你们要去哪儿？B：我们要去给参加比赛的同学＿＿，你去吗？
full: A：你们要去哪儿？B：我们要去给参加比赛的同学加油，你去吗？
A: Nǐmen yào qù nǎr? B: Wǒmen yào qù gěi cānjiā bǐsài de tóngxué jiāyóu, nǐ qù ma?
A: Where are you going? B: We're going to cheer for our classmates in the competition. Are you coming?
fill.why: 给 + someone + 加油 = cheer for someone. 给参加比赛的同学加油.

fill.q: A：你们这次旅游怎么样？B：虽然天气不太好，但是和朋友在一起，做＿＿事情都很有意思。
full: A：你们这次旅游怎么样？B：虽然天气不太好，但是和朋友在一起，做任何事情都很有意思。
A: Nǐmen zhè cì lǚyóu zěnmeyàng? B: Suīrán tiānqì bú tài hǎo, dànshì hé péngyou zài yìqǐ, zuò rènhé shìqing dōu hěn yǒuyìsi.
A: How was your trip? B: The weather wasn't great, but with friends, anything is fun.
fill.why: 任何 + noun + 都……: 做任何事情都很有意思 = anything is fun. 任何 pairs with 都.

q: 老师给白家月什么了？
Lǎoshī gěi Bái Jiāyuè shénme le?
What did the teacher give Bai Jiayue?
why: 办好了，这是你们的学生证。
Bànhǎo le, zhè shì nǐmen de xuéshēngzhèng.

The students hand the teacher their passports, visas and admission letters; the teacher gives back only one thing — the student ID card (学生证). A, B and D are what the students gave, not what they received.

q: 他们什么时候开始上课？
Tāmen shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàngkè?
When do they start classes?
why: 下周一开始上课。先试听两周，然后在网上选课。
Xià zhōuyī kāishǐ shàngkè. Xiān shìtīng liǎng zhōu, ránhòu zài wǎngshang xuǎn kè.
Classes start 下周一 (next Monday). 两周 is how long they audit classes before choosing courses online, so D is a trap.

q: 白家月觉得学校怎么样？
Bái Jiāyuè juéde xuéxiào zěnmeyàng?
What does Bai Jiayue think of the school?
why: 我觉得学校就像一座小城市，什么都有，方便极了。
Wǒ juéde xuéxiào jiù xiàng yí zuò xiǎo chéngshì, shénme dōu yǒu, fāngbiàn jí le.
Bai Jiayue compares the campus to a small city (像一座小城市). She says it is very convenient, so C is the opposite; size and quietness are not her point.

q: 陈天中为什么想申请奖学金？
Chén Tiānzhōng wèishénme xiǎng shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn?
Why does Chen Tianzhong want to apply for a scholarship?
o: 为了认识表现好的同学
Wèile rènshi biǎoxiàn hǎo de tóngxué
to meet classmates who do well
why: 要是申请到奖学金，就能减轻不少经济压力。
Yàoshi shēnqǐng dào jiǎngxuéjīn, jiù néng jiǎnqīng bù shǎo jīngjì yālì.
His reason is financial: a scholarship would ease (减轻) economic pressure (经济压力). Good grades are a condition for getting one, not his reason.

q: 外国学生可以根据什么选择专业？
Wàiguó xuéshēng kěyǐ gēnjù shénme xuǎnzé zhuānyè?
On what basis can international students choose a major?
why: 然后根据自己的兴趣和需要选择专业。
Ránhòu gēnjù zìjǐ de xìngqù hé xūyào xuǎnzé zhuānyè.
They choose a major according to 自己的兴趣和需要 (their own interests and needs). Only B matches 兴趣.

q: 外国学生怎么能更快地适应中国的大学生活？
Wàiguó xuéshēng zěnme néng gèng kuài de shìyìng Zhōngguó de dàxué shēnghuó?
How can international students adapt to Chinese university life faster?
why: 外国学生可以和中国学生一起学习、做研究、参加校园活动。通过这些交流，外国学生能更快地适应中国的大学生活。
Wàiguó xuéshēng kěyǐ hé Zhōngguó xuéshēng yìqǐ xuéxí, zuò yánjiū, cānjiā xiàoyuán huódòng. Tōngguò zhèxiē jiāoliú, wàiguó xuéshēng néng gèng kuài de shìyìng Zhōngguó de dàxué shēnghuó.
通过这些交流 (through these exchanges) refers to studying, researching and doing activities together with Chinese students, so D 多跟中国学生交流 is the answer.

q: 很多外国学生来中国学习以前，做了什么准备？
Hěn duō wàiguó xuéshēng lái Zhōngguó xuéxí yǐqián, zuò le shénme zhǔnbèi?
What did many international students prepare before coming to study in China?
o: Rènshi le hěn duō Zhōngguó péngyou
why: 很多外国学生来中国学习以前，就已经想好了自己的发展方向。
Hěn duō wàiguó xuéshēng lái Zhōngguó xuéxí yǐqián, jiù yǐjīng xiǎng hǎo le zìjǐ de fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
The first sentence says they had already thought about their future direction (想好了自己的发展方向) before coming.

q: 安妮以后想做什么？
Ānnī yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme?
What does Annie want to do in the future?
why: 安妮以后想做一名中文老师，所以要选择国际中文教育专业。
Ānnī yǐhòu xiǎng zuò yì míng Zhōngwén lǎoshī, suǒyǐ yào xuǎnzé guójì Zhōngwén jiàoyù zhuānyè.
Annie wants to be a Chinese teacher (中文老师), so B 成为老师. 做国际贸易 is Chen Tianzhong's interest, not Annie's.

en: I have rented a suitable apartment

ex: 我的房东人很好，常常给我送水果。
Wǒ de fángdōng rén hěn hǎo, chángcháng gěi wǒ sòng shuǐguǒ.
My landlord is very nice and often gives me fruit.
楼下贴着一张房子出租的通知。
Lóuxià tiēzhe yì zhāng fángzi chūzū de tōngzhī.
There's a 'house for rent' notice posted downstairs.
这里的房租太贵了，我想搬到郊区。
Zhèlǐ de fángzū tàiguì le, wǒ xiǎng bān dào jiāoqū.
The rent here is too high; I want to move to the suburbs.
明天要去旅行，我今天晚上得收拾行李。
Míngtiān yào qù lǚxíng, wǒ jīntiān wǎnshang děi shōushi xíngli.
I'm traveling tomorrow, so I have to pack tonight.
我们在学校附近租了一个小房子。
Wǒmen zài xuéxiào fùjìn zū le yí ge xiǎo fángzi.
We rented a small place near the school.
嗯，我明白了，谢谢你。
Ńg, wǒ míngbái le, xièxie nǐ.
Mm, I understand. Thank you.
这个房间窗户很大，白天非常亮。
Zhège fángjiān chuānghu hěn dà, báitiān fēicháng liàng.
This room has big windows and is very bright during the day.

vocab.en: used with 了 at the end of a sentence for emphasis
ex: 你有什么问题，直接问我就是了。
Nǐ yǒu shénme wèntí, zhíjiē wèn wǒ jiùshì le.
If you have any questions, just ask me.
奶奶在小花园里种了很多菜。
Nǎinǎi zài xiǎo huāyuánlǐ zhòngle hěn duō cài.
Grandma grows lots of vegetables in the little garden.
学校周围有很多饭馆和商店。
Xuéxiào zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō fànguǎn hé shāngdiàn.
There are many restaurants and shops around the school.
这件衣服很漂亮，不过有点儿贵。
Zhèjiàn yīfu hěn piàoliang, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì.
This piece of clothing is pretty, but a bit expensive.
我哥哥去年大学毕业，现在在上海工作。
Wǒ gēgē qùnián dàxué bìyè, xiànzài zài Shànghǎi gōngzuò.
My older brother graduated last year and now works in Shanghai.
现在已经八点了，我们恐怕会迟到。
Xiànzài yǐjīng bādiǎn le, wǒmen kǒngpà huì chídào.
It's already eight; I'm afraid we'll be late.

vocab.en: have a jolly time; bustling; excitement
ex: 过年的时候，家里特别热闹。
Guònián de shíhou, jiālǐ tèbié rènao.
At New Year our home is especially lively.

vocab.en: move into (a new house); check into (a hotel)
ex: 我们下午两点以后才能办入住。
Wǒmen xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn yǐhòu cáinéng bàn rùzhù.
We can only check in after 2 p.m.
老师让我们每天用中文写日记。
Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen měi tiān yòng Zhōngwén xiěrìjì.
The teacher asks us to write a diary in Chinese every day.
祝你考试顺利！
Zhù nǐ kǎoshì shùnlì!
Good luck on your exam!
这个问题并不难，你再想想。
Zhège wèntí bìng bùnán, nǐ zài xiǎngxiǎng.
This question isn't hard at all; think again.
我们一家人晚上常在客厅里看电视。
Wǒmen yìjiārén wǎnshang chángzài kètīng li kàndiànshì.
Our family often watches TV in the living room in the evening.
我想买一台新电脑。
Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yìtái xīn diànnǎo.
I want to buy a new computer.
妈妈正在厨房里做饭。
Māmā zhèngzài chúfáng li zuòfàn.
Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
我平常早上七点起床。
Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshàng qīdiǎn qǐchuáng.
I usually get up at seven in the morning.
我们班的同学基本上都住在学校里。
Wǒmen bān de tóngxué jīběnshàng dōu zhù zài xuéxiào li.
Almost all of our classmates live on campus.
我整个下午都在图书馆学习。
Wǒ zhěngge xiàwǔ dōu zài túshūguǎn xuéxí.
I studied in the library the whole afternoon.
去游泳的时候别忘了带毛巾。
Qù yóuyǒng de shíhou biéwàngle dài máojīn.
Don't forget a towel when you go swimming.
我建议你早点儿去医院看看。
Wǒ jiànyì nǐ zǎodiǎnr qù yīyuàn kànkàn.
I suggest you go to the hospital soon.
上课前，请大家查看一下学校的通知。
Shàngkè qián, qǐng dàjiā chákàn yíxià xuéxiào de tōngzhī.
Before class, please check the school notice.
我给你发了一条信息，你看到了吗？
Wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yìtiáo xìnxī, nǐ kàndào le ma?
I sent you a message. Did you see it?
我在网上查找了很多关于这个城市的信息。
Wǒ zài wǎngshang cházhǎo le hěn duō guānyú zhège chéngshì de xìnxī.
I looked up a lot of information about this city online.
你先休息一会儿，我们接着讨论。
Nǐ xiān xiūxi yíhuìr, wǒmen jiēzhe tǎolùn.
Rest a bit first, then we'll continue the discussion.
他一边工作，同时还在读研究生。
Tā yìbiān gōngzuò, tóngshí hái zàidú yánjiūshēng.
He works and studies for a master's at the same time.
这家饭馆的位置很好，就在地铁站旁边。
Zhèjiā fànguǎn de wèizhì hěn hǎo, jiù zài dìtiězhàn pángbiān.
This restaurant has a great location, right next to the subway.
网上的东西价格往往比商场便宜。
Wǎngshang de dōngxi jiàgé wǎngwǎng bǐ shāngchǎng piányi.
Things online are often cheaper than in malls.
我的理想是当一名软件工程师。
Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng yì míng ruǎnjiàn gōngchéng shī.
My dream is to be a software engineer.
由于下大雨，比赛推迟了。
Yóuyú xià dàyǔ, bǐsài tuīchí le.
The match was postponed because of heavy rain.
我们公司每个月十号发工资。
Wǒmen gōngsī měi ge yuè shíhào fāgōngzī.
Our company pays salaries on the 10th of every month.
住在自己的家里，我觉得很有安全感。
Zhù zài zìjǐ de jiālǐ, wǒ juédehěnyǒu ānquángǎn.
Living in my own home makes me feel secure.

texts.title: Bai Jiayue wants to rent an apartment; Li Wen goes with her to view it

lines.zh: 请进！我给你们介绍一下，这个房子有两个房间，那个大房间出租，房租每月5500元。现在已经收拾好了，想租的话，今天就可以搬进来。
lines.py: Qǐng jìn! Wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshào yíxià, zhège fángzi yǒu liǎng ge fángjiān, nàge dà fángjiān chūzū, fángzū měiyuè wǔqiānwǔbǎi yuán. Xiànzài yǐjīng shōushi hǎo le, xiǎngzū dehuà, jīntiān jiù kěyǐ bān jìnlai.
lines.en: Come in! Let me show you around. This apartment has two rooms; the big one is for rent at 5,500 yuan a month. It's already been tidied up, so if you want it, you can move in today.

lines.zh: 嗯，这个房间真不小，还挺亮。小区离我们学校也不远。
lines.py: Ńg, zhège fángjiān zhēn bùxiǎo, hái tǐngliàng. Xiǎoqū lí wǒmen xuéxiào yě bùyuǎn.
lines.en: Mm, this room is really not small, and it's quite bright. The neighborhood isn't far from our school either.

lines.zh: 是的，我们小区离地铁站也很近，生活上很方便。如果决定租了，告诉我就是了。
lines.py: Shì de, wǒmen xiǎoqū lí dìtiězhàn yě hěn jìn, shēnghuó shàng hěn fāngbiàn. Rúguǒ juédìng zū le, gàosu wǒ jiùshì le.
lines.en: Yes, our neighborhood is also very close to the subway station, so daily life is convenient. If you decide to rent it, just tell me.

lines.zh: 好的，我们再去看看外边的环境。
lines.py: Hǎo de, wǒmen zài qù kànkàn wàibiān de huánjìng.
lines.en: OK, we'll go and look at the surroundings outside.

texts.title: In the neighborhood, Bai Jiayue and Li Wen keep checking out the surroundings

lines.zh: 家月，你看，那边还有个小花园。
lines.py: Jiāyuè, nǐ kàn, nàbiān hái yǒu ge xiǎo huāyuán.
lines.en: Jiayue, look, there's a small garden over there.

lines.zh: 嗯，这个小区到处是花，还种了不少树，周围也很安静。
lines.py: Ńg, zhège xiǎoqū dàochù shì huā, hái zhòng le bù shǎo shù, zhōuwéi yě hěn ānjìng.
lines.en: Mm, there are flowers everywhere in this neighborhood, lots of trees have been planted, and the surroundings are quiet too.

lines.zh: 是啊！这个小区的环境真不错，不过我听说，附近有十几家公司，很多刚毕业的学生都租住在这里。周末他们可能会玩到很晚，恐怕会影响你休息。
lines.py: Shì a! Zhège xiǎoqū de huánjìng zhēnbúcuò, búguò wǒ tīngshuō, fùjìn yǒu shíjǐjiā gōngsī, hěn duō gāng bìyè de xuéshēng dōu zūzhù zài zhèlǐ. Zhōumò tāmen kěnéng huìwándào hěn wǎn, kǒngpà huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ xiūxi.
lines.en: Yes! The environment here is really nice. But I heard there are a dozen or so companies nearby, and many recent graduates rent here. On weekends they might stay up late having fun, which I'm afraid could disturb your rest.

lines.zh: 没关系，我还想多认识一些朋友，和他们一起玩呢。
lines.py: Méi guānxi, wǒ hái xiǎng duō rènshi yìxiē péngyou, hé tāmen yìqǐ wán ne.
lines.en: That's OK. I'd like to make more friends and have fun with them.

lines.zh: 是呢，大家可以一起热闹热闹。
lines.py: Shì ne, dàjiā kěyǐ yìqǐ rènao rènao.
lines.en: True, everyone can have a good time together.

lines.zh: 这里房租合适，环境很好，而且房东也热情，所以我决定租这个房子了，明天就入住新家。
lines.py: Zhèlǐ fángzū héshì, huánjìng hěn hǎo, érqiě fángdōng yě rèqíng, suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng zū zhège fángzi le, míngtiān jiù rùzhù xīn jiā.
lines.en: The rent here is reasonable, the environment is great, and the landlord is friendly, so I've decided to rent this place. I'll move into my new home tomorrow.

texts.title: After moving into her new home, Bai Jiayue happily wrote a diary entry

lines.zh: 8月25日，晴
lines.py: Bā yuè èrshíwǔ rì, qíng
lines.en: August 25, sunny

lines.zh: 昨天我顺利租到了合适的房子，今天李文帮我搬家。搬进去的时候，房东又向我介绍了一下房子里的东西，并告诉我这些东西怎么用。
lines.py: Zuótiān wǒ shùnlì zūdào le héshì de fángzi, jīntiān Lǐ Wén bāng wǒ bānjiā. Bānjìn qù de shíhou, fángdōng yòu xiàng wǒ jièshào le yíxià fángzi li de dōngxi, bìng gàosu wǒ zhèxiē dōngxi zěnme yòng.
lines.en: Yesterday I successfully rented a suitable apartment, and today Li Wen helped me move. When we moved in, the landlord showed me the things in the apartment again and told me how to use them.

lines.zh: 我看了一下，客厅里有椅子、沙发，还有一台大电视；厨房里有冰箱和一些做饭用的东西，不过，我平常主要在学校食堂吃，基本上不做饭。我租的房间里，除了一张床以外，还有一台空调、一张书桌和一把椅子。
lines.py: Wǒ kàn le yíxià, kètīng li yǒu yǐzi, shāfā, hái yǒu yìtái dà diànshì; chúfáng li yǒu bīngxiāng hé yìxiē zuòfàn yòng de dōngxi, búguò, wǒ píngcháng zhǔyào zài xuéxiàoshítáng chī, jīběnshàng bú zuòfàn. Wǒzū de fángjiān li, chúle yì zhāng chuáng yǐwài, hái yǒu yìtái kōngtiáo, yì zhāng shūzhuō hé yìbǎ yǐzi.
lines.en: I took a look: the living room has chairs, a sofa and a big TV; the kitchen has a fridge and some cooking things, but I usually eat in the school dining hall and basically don't cook. Besides a bed, my room has an air conditioner, a desk and a chair.

lines.zh: 看完整个房子后，我准备再去买几条毛巾，其他东西还不需要。
lines.py: Kàn wánzhěng ge fángzi hòu, wǒ zhǔnbèi zài qù mǎi jǐtiáo máojīn, qítā dōngxi hái bù xūyào.
lines.en: After looking around the whole apartment, I plan to buy a few towels; I don't need anything else yet.

texts.title: How to rent a suitable apartment

lines.zh: 在李文的帮助下，白家月租到了合适的房子。对白家月来说，这次租房并不容易。根据李文的建议，她先在租房网站和App上查看有关信息，查找合适的房子，接着又去看了看房子，同时了解房子周围的环境。她看了好几个房子，才找到一个位置、环境和价格都合适的，最后顺利租到了理想的房子。
lines.py: Zài Lǐ Wén de bāngzhù xià, Bái Jiāyuè zūdào le héshì de fángzi. Duì Bái Jiāyuè lái shuō, zhè cì zūfáng bìng bù róngyì. Gēnjù Lǐ Wén de jiànyì, tā xiān zài zūfáng wǎngzhàn hé App shàng chákàn yǒuguān xìnxī, cházhǎo héshì de fángzi, jiēzhe yòu qù kàn le kàn fángzi, tóngshí liǎojiě fángzi zhōuwéi de huánjìng. Tā kàn le hǎo jǐ ge fángzi, cái zhǎodào yí ge wèizhì, huánjìng hé jiàgé dōu héshì de, zuìhòu shùnlì zūdào le lǐxiǎng de fángzi.
lines.en: With Li Wen's help, Bai Jiayue rented a suitable apartment. For her, renting this time was not easy at all. Following Li Wen's advice, she first checked information on rental websites and apps to look for a suitable place, then went to view apartments, while also learning about the surroundings. She viewed several apartments before finding one whose location, environment and price were all right, and in the end she successfully rented her ideal home.

lines.zh: 租房的时候，李文告诉白家月，在中国，由于很多刚工作的年轻人工资还不太高，所以他们一开始也不买房，都选择租房。工作几年后，不少人就会买房，因为大家一直觉得，有房才有家，有自己的房子会更有安全感。
lines.py: Zūfáng de shíhou, Lǐ Wén gàosu Bái Jiāyuè, zài Zhōngguó, yóuyú hěn duō gāng gōngzuò de niánqīngrén gōngzī hái bútàigāo, suǒyǐ tāmen yì kāishǐ yě bù mǎifáng, dōu xuǎnzé zūfáng. Gōngzuò jǐnián hòu, bù shǎo rén jiù huì mǎifáng, yīnwèi dàjiā yìzhí juéde, yǒufáng cái yǒujiā, yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi huì gèng yǒu ānquángǎn.
lines.en: While she was renting, Li Wen told her that in China, because many young people who just started working don't earn much yet, they don't buy at first and choose to rent. After working a few years, many people buy a home, because people have always felt that a home needs a house, and owning your own place gives a stronger sense of security.

grammar.title: Fixed pattern ×就是了
grammar.note: Used in spoken Chinese at the end of a sentence to sound sure and reassuring: "just …; that's all".
ex: 如果决定租了，告诉我就是了。
Rúguǒ juédìng zū le, gàosu wǒ jiùshì le.
If you decide to rent it, just tell me.
我一定能办到，您放心就是了。
Wǒ yídìng néng bàndào, nín fàngxīn jiùshì le.
I can definitely do it, just relax.
这次考得不好没关系，下次努力就是了。
Zhè cì kǎode bùhǎo méi guānxi, xiàcì nǔlì jiùshì le.
It doesn't matter that you didn't do well this time; just work harder next time.

grammar.title: Adversative sentence ……，不过……
grammar.note: 不过 starts the second clause and shows a turn in meaning: "…, but / however …". It's a bit softer than 但是.
ex: 这个小区的环境真不错，不过我听说，附近有十几家公司，很多刚毕业的学生都租住在这里。
Zhège xiǎoqū de huánjìng zhēnbúcuò, búguò wǒ tīngshuō, fùjìn yǒu shíjǐjiā gōngsī, hěn duō gāng bìyè de xuéshēng dōu zūzhù zài zhèlǐ.
The environment here is really nice, but I heard there are a dozen companies nearby and many recent graduates rent here.
我们在动物园看见了很多动物，不过没看见大熊猫。
Wǒmen zài dòngwùyuán kànjiàn le hěn duō dòngwù, búguò méi kànjiàn dàxióngmāo.
We saw many animals at the zoo, but we didn't see the giant pandas.
我刚来北京时还不太习惯这里的天气，不过很快就适应了。
Wǒ gānglái Běijīng shí hái bú tài xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì, búguò hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le.
When I first came to Beijing I wasn't used to the weather, but I adapted quickly.

grammar.title: Conjunction/adverb 并 (bìng)
grammar.note: ① As a conjunction, 并 links two verbs, phrases or clauses: "and also" (adds a further step). ② As an adverb before a negative (并不 / 并没有), it stresses "not at all / actually not", correcting an assumption.
ex: 房东又向我介绍了一下房子里的东西，并告诉我这些东西怎么用。
Fángdōng yòu xiàng wǒ jièshào le yíxià fángzi li de dōngxi, bìng gàosu wǒ zhèxiē dōngxi zěnme yòng.
The landlord showed me the things in the apartment again and told me how to use them.
她考上了北京大学并申请到了奖学金。
Tā kǎoshàng le Běijīng Dàxué bìng shēnqǐng dào le jiǎngxuéjīn.
She got into Peking University and also got a scholarship.
我并没有答应你就租这个房子，我还要再想想。
Wǒ bìng méiyǒu dāying nǐ jiù zū zhège fángzi, wǒ háiyào zài xiǎngxiǎng.
I never actually promised you I'd rent this place; I still need to think it over.

grammar.title: Conjunction/preposition 由于 (yóuyú)
grammar.note: ① As a conjunction at the start of the first clause, giving the cause; the second clause often starts with 所以 / 因此 (yīncǐ, therefore). ② As a preposition: "because of / due to".
ex: 在中国，由于很多刚工作的年轻人工资还不太高，所以他们一开始也不买房，都选择租房。
Zài Zhōngguó, yóuyú hěn duō gāng gōngzuò de niánqīngrén gōngzī hái bútàigāo, suǒyǐ tāmen yì kāishǐ yě bù mǎifáng, dōu xuǎnzé zūfáng.
In China, because many young workers don't earn much yet, they choose to rent at first.
由于一直下大雨，所以我们决定不爬山了。
Yóuyú yìzhí xià dàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen juédìng bù páshān le.
Because it kept raining heavily, we decided not to go hiking.
由于大家的努力，这次运动会我们班获得了第一名。
Yóuyú dàjiā de nǔlì, zhè cì yùndònghuì wǒmen bān huòdé le dì-yī míng.
Thanks to everyone's effort, our class won first place at this sports meet.

fill.q: 这个小区环境好，＿＿也不高，一个月才5000元。
full: 这个小区环境好，房租也不高，一个月才5000元。
Zhège xiǎoqū huánjìng hǎo, fángzū yě bù gāo, yìgeyuè cái wǔqiān yuán.
This neighborhood is nice and the rent isn't high, only 5,000 yuan a month.
fill.why: The sentence gives an amount per month (一个月才5000元), so the blank is the thing that costs money: 房租 (rent).

fill.q: 要＿＿一个好房子也不容易，需要多多比较。
full: 要租一个好房子也不容易，需要多多比较。
Yào zū yí ge hǎo fángzi yě bù róngyì, xūyào duōduō bǐjiào.
Renting a good place isn't easy either; you need to compare a lot.
fill.why: 要 + verb + 一个好房子: the blank needs a verb. 租一个房子 = rent a place.

fill.q: 我女儿每天都把房间＿＿得干干净净的。
full: 我女儿每天都把房间收拾得干干净净的。
Wǒ nǚ'ér měi tiān dōu bǎ fángjiān shōushi de gāngānjìngjìng de.
My daughter tidies her room until it's spotless every day.
fill.why: 把 + 房间 + 收拾得干干净净的: 收拾 (tidy up) takes a 得 complement describing the result.

fill.q: 这次比赛的通知已经发到大家的邮箱了，请注意＿＿。
full: 这次比赛的通知已经发到大家的邮箱了，请注意查看。
Zhè cì bǐsài de tōngzhī yǐjīng fādào dàjiā de yóuxiāng le, qǐng zhùyì chákàn.
The notice for this competition has been sent to everyone's email; please check it.
fill.why: 请注意查看 = please be sure to check (your email). 查看 means check/look over information.

fill.q: ＿＿后我发现，宾馆房间的灯是坏的。
full: 入住后我发现，宾馆房间的灯是坏的。
Rùzhù hòu wǒ fāxiàn, bīnguǎn fángjiān de dēng shì huài de.
After checking in I found the light in the hotel room was broken.
fill.why: 入住后 = after checking in. 入住 is used for hotels (宾馆) and new homes.

fill.q: A：我最近打算在公司附近租个房子。B：那你上网＿＿租房信息时，一定要小心，不要只看价格。
full: A：我最近打算在公司附近租个房子。B：那你上网查找租房信息时，一定要小心，不要只看价格。
A: Wǒ zuìjìn dǎsuàn zài gōngsī fùjìn zūge fángzi. B: Nà nǐ shàngwǎng cházhǎo zūfáng xìnxī shí, yídìng yào xiǎoxīn, búyào zhǐ kàn jiàgé.
A: I'm planning to rent a place near my company. B: Then when you look for listings online, be careful and don't just look at the price.
fill.why: 上网 + 查找 + 信息 = search online for information. 查找 = look for.

fill.q: A：你假期打算做什么？B：我要先回家住几天，＿＿跟朋友去上海玩。
full: A：你假期打算做什么？B：我要先回家住几天，接着跟朋友去上海玩。
A: Nǐ jiàqī dǎsuàn zuò shénme? B: Wǒyào xiān huí jiā zhù jǐtiān, jiēzhe gēn péngyou qù Shànghǎi wán.
A: What are you doing over the holiday? B: I'll go home for a few days first, then go to Shanghai with friends.
fill.why: 先……，接着…… = first …, then …. 接着 marks the next step in a sequence.

fill.q: A：听说小区＿＿有很多公司，很多年轻人都租住在附近。B：是的，所以周末时特别热闹。
full: A：听说小区周围有很多公司，很多年轻人都租住在附近。B：是的，所以周末时特别热闹。
A: Tīngshuō xiǎoqū zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō gōngsī, hěn duō niánqīngrén dōu zūzhù zài fùjìn. B: Shì de, suǒyǐ zhōumò shí tèbié rènao.
A: I heard there are many companies around the neighborhood and lots of young people rent nearby. B: Yes, so it's especially lively on weekends.
fill.why: 小区周围 = around the residential compound. 周围 follows a place noun to mean 'surroundings'.

fill.q: A：这个房子怎么样？B：很大，＿＿也大，里边除了沙发以外，还有一台大电视。
full: A：这个房子怎么样？B：很大，客厅也大，里边除了沙发以外，还有一台大电视。
A: Zhège fángzi zěnmeyàng? B: Hěn dà, kètīng yě dà, lǐbiān chúle shāfā yǐwài, hái yǒu yìtái dà diànshì.
A: How's the apartment? B: It's big, and so is the living room; besides a sofa, there's also a big TV.
fill.why: 里边除了沙发以外，还有一台大电视 — sofa and TV are things in a 客厅 (living room).

fill.q: A：关于租什么样的房子合适，你还有什么好＿＿？B：除了离公司近以外，我觉得生活上方便也很重要。
full: A：关于租什么样的房子合适，你还有什么好建议？B：除了离公司近以外，我觉得生活上方便也很重要。
A: Guānyú zū shénmeyàng de fángzi héshì, nǐ hái yǒu shénme hǎo jiànyì? B: Chúle lí gōngsī jìn yǐwài, wǒ juéde shēnghuó shàng fāngbiàn yě hěn zhòngyào.
A: Do you have any other good suggestions about what kind of place to rent? B: Besides being close to work, I think convenience for daily life is important too.
fill.why: 有什么好建议 = any good suggestions? B then gives advice, which confirms 建议.

q: 白家月在看的房子每个月房租是多少？
Bái Jiāyuè zài kàn de fángzi měi ge yuè fángzū shì duōshao?
How much is the monthly rent of the apartment Bai Jiayue is viewing?
why: 那个大房间出租，房租每月5500元。
Nàge dà fángjiān chūzū, fángzū měiyuè wǔqiānwǔbǎi yuán.
The landlord says the rent is 每月5500元 (5,500 yuan a month). Listen for the number right after 房租.

q: 白家月在看的房子离哪里近？
Bái Jiāyuè zài kàn de fángzi lí nǎlǐ jìn?
What is the apartment close to?
why: 我们小区离地铁站也很近，生活上很方便。
Wǒmen xiǎoqū lí dìtiězhàn yě hěn jìn, shēnghuó shàng hěn fāngbiàn.
The landlord says the compound is very close to the 地铁站 (subway station). The school is 不远 (not far), but the question asks what is near — the subway.

q: 白家月觉得小区的环境怎么样？
Bái Jiāyuè juéde xiǎoqū de huánjìng zěnmeyàng?
What does Bai Jiayue think of the neighborhood?
why: 这个小区到处是花，还种了不少树，周围也很安静。
Zhège xiǎoqū dàochù shì huā, hái zhòng le bù shǎo shù, zhōuwéi yě hěn ānjìng.
She says there are flowers everywhere, many trees, and the surroundings are 很安静 (quiet). 树太少 is the opposite of 种了不少树.

q: 白家月想什么时候搬进新房子？
Bái Jiāyuè xiǎng shénme shíhou bānjìn xīn fángzi?
When does Bai Jiayue want to move into her new home?
why: 所以我决定租这个房子了，明天就入住新家。
Suǒyǐ wǒ juédìng zū zhège fángzi le, míngtiān jiù rùzhù xīn jiā.
明天就入住新家 = she'll move in tomorrow. 入住 means moving into a new home.

q: 白家月租的房子，客厅里都有什么？
Bái Jiāyuè zū de fángzi, kètīng li dōu yǒu shénme?
What is in the living room of Bai Jiayue's apartment?
o: chairs, a sofa and a TV
chairs, an air conditioner and a desk
a fridge, a TV and an air conditioner
a desk, chairs and a sofa
why: 客厅里有椅子、沙发，还有一台大电视。
Kètīng li yǒu yǐzi, shāfā, hái yǒu yìtái dà diànshì.
The diary lists chairs, a sofa and a big TV in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen; the desk and air conditioner are in her bedroom.

q: 白家月平常主要在哪儿吃饭？
Bái Jiāyuè píngcháng zhǔyào zài nǎr chī fàn?
Where does Bai Jiayue usually eat?
why: 我平常主要在学校食堂吃，基本上不做饭。
Wǒ píngcháng zhǔyào zài xuéxiàoshítáng chī, jīběnshàng bú zuòfàn.
平常主要在学校食堂吃 = she usually eats at the school cafeteria, and basically never cooks.

q: 白家月觉得这次租房怎么样？
Bái Jiāyuè juéde zhè cì zūfáng zěnmeyàng?
How did Bai Jiayue find renting this time?
why: 对白家月来说，这次租房并不容易。
Duì Bái Jiāyuè lái shuō, zhè cì zūfáng bìng bù róngyì.
并不容易 = really not easy. 并 + negative strengthens the 'not', so the answer is B 不容易.

q: 根据课文，很多刚工作的年轻人为什么选择租房？
Gēnjù kèwén, hěn duō gāng gōngzuò de niánqīngrén wèishénme xuǎnzé zūfáng?
According to the text, why do many young people who just started working choose to rent?
why: 由于很多刚工作的年轻人工资还不太高，所以他们一开始也不买房，都选择租房。
Yóuyú hěn duō gāng gōngzuò de niánqīngrén gōngzī hái bútàigāo, suǒyǐ tāmen yì kāishǐ yě bù mǎifáng, dōu xuǎnzé zūfáng.
由于……，所以…… gives the reason: their salaries are not high yet (工资还不太高). 安全感 is the reason people later buy a home, not why they rent.

ex: 到第二个十字路口往左走，就能看到银行。
Dào dì'èrge shízìlùkǒu wǎng zuǒ zǒu, jiù néng kàndào yínháng.
Turn left at the second intersection and you'll see the bank.
下课以后我直接回家。
Xiàkè yǐhòu wǒ zhíjiē huí jiā.
After class I'm going straight home.
过了桥以后向右转。
Guòle qiáo yǐhòu xiàngyòuzhuǎn.
Turn right after crossing the bridge.

vocab.en: coincidentally; just in time; just right
ex: 你来得正好，我们正要吃饭。
Nǐ láide zhènghǎo, wǒmen zhèngyào chī fàn.
You came at just the right time; we're about to eat.
我对这个城市还不太熟悉。
Wǒ duì zhège chéngshì hái bú tài shúxi.
I'm not very familiar with this city yet.
我们学校的大门正对着一个公园。
Wǒmen xuéxiào de dàmén zhèngduìzhe yí ge gōngyuán.
Our school gate directly faces a park.
坐了三个小时的车，我们终于到了目的地。
Zuò le sānge xiǎoshí de chē, wǒmen zhōngyú dào le mùdìdì.
After three hours on the road, we finally reached our destination.
你可以先下载这个App，再在上面订票。
Nǐ kěyǐ xiān xiàzài zhège App, zài zài shàngmiàn dìngpiào.
You can download this app first, then book tickets on it.
会议还在进行，请大家安静。
Huìyì hái zài jìnxíng, qǐng dàjiā ānjìng.
The meeting is still in progress; please be quiet.
在中国，手机支付非常普遍。
Zài Zhōngguó, shǒujī zhīfù fēicháng pǔbiàn.
Mobile payment is very common in China.
这个学习软件可以帮你记生词。
Zhège xuéxí ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bāng nǐ jì shēngcí.
This learning app can help you memorize new words.
他不仅会说中文，而且会写汉字。
Tā bùjǐn huì shuō Zhōngwén, érqiě huì xiě hànzì.
He not only speaks Chinese but can also write characters.
在这家店买东西，扫码支付就可以。
Zài zhèjiā diànmǎi dōngxi, sǎomǎ zhīfù jiù kěyǐ.
At this shop you can just scan the code to pay.
服务员，我们要结账。
Fúwùyuán, wǒmen yào jiézhàng.
Waiter, we'd like the bill.
周末我喜欢和朋友一起去购物。
Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan hé péngyou yìqǐ qù gòuwù.
On weekends I like going shopping with friends.
我已经订好了下周去上海的火车票。
Wǒ yǐjīng dìnghǎo le xiàzhōu qù Shànghǎi de huǒchēpiào.
I've already booked train tickets to Shanghai for next week.
我的快递已经到楼下了。
Wǒ de kuàidì yǐjīng dào lóuxià le.
My package has arrived downstairs.
现在很多年轻人出门不带现金。
Xiànzài hěn duō niánqīngrén chūmén búdài xiànjīn.
Nowadays many young people go out without cash.
我的衣服大多是网购的。
Wǒ de yīfu dàduō shì wǎnggòu de.
Most of my clothes were bought online.
我给家里寄了一些中国茶。
Wǒ gěi jiālǐ jì le yìxiē Zhōngguó chá.
I sent some Chinese tea home.
超市里有水果、蔬菜、牛奶等。
Chāoshì li yǒu shuǐguǒ, shūcài, niúnǎi děng.
The supermarket has fruit, vegetables, milk, etc.
这家网店送货很快，第二天就到了。
Zhèjiā wǎngdiàn sònghuò hěn kuài, dì'èrtiān jiù dào le.
This online shop delivers fast; it arrived the next day.
他太忙了，甚至没时间吃午饭。
Tātàimáng le, shènzhì méi shíjiān chī wǔfàn.
He's so busy he doesn't even have time for lunch.
来中国以后，我的生活习惯改变了很多。
Lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu, wǒ de shēnghuóxíguàn gǎibiàn le hěn duō.
Since coming to China, my habits have changed a lot.
用手机支付，只要动动手指就可以了。
Yòng shǒujī zhīfù, zhǐyào dòngdong shǒuzhǐ jiù kěyǐ le.
Paying by phone takes just a tap of your finger.
你的房间太乱了，快收拾一下吧。
Nǐ de fángjiān tàiluàn le, kuài shōushi yíxià ba.
Your room is too messy; tidy it up.
我得管住自己，不能每天都玩手机。
Wǒ děi guǎnzhù zìjǐ, bù néng měi tiān dōu wán shǒujī.
I have to control myself and not play on my phone all day.
学校为留学生提供免费的中文课。
Xuéxiào wèi liúxuéshēng tígōng miǎnfèi de Zhōngwén kè.
The school provides free Chinese classes for international students.
坐火车的时候要带身份证或者护照。
Zuòhuǒchē de shíhou yào dài shēnfènzhèng huòzhě hùzhào.
You need your ID card or passport to take the train.
这是我的个人看法，你可以不同意。
Zhè shì wǒ de gèrén kànfǎ, nǐ kěyǐ bù tóngyì.
This is my personal opinion; you can disagree.
我还不知道明天能否来上课。
Wǒ hái bù zhīdào míngtiān néngfǒu lái shàngkè.
I don't know yet whether I can come to class tomorrow.
看手机时间太长对眼睛不好，要注意保护眼睛。
Kàn shǒujī shíjiān tài cháng duì yǎnjīng bùhǎo, yào zhùyì bǎohù yǎnjīng.
Looking at your phone too long is bad for your eyes; protect them.
外面下雨了，于是我们决定在家看电影。
Wàimiàn xiàyǔ le, yúshì wǒmen juédìng zàijiā kàn diànyǐng.
It started raining, so we decided to watch a movie at home.
我忘了邮箱的密码，只好重新设置。
Wǒ wàng le yóuxiāng de mìmǎ, zhǐhǎo chóngxīn shèzhì.
I forgot my email password and had to reset it.

vocab.en: careless; do as one pleases; no matter
ex: 你想吃什么？随便，我都可以。
Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? Suíbiàn, wǒ dōu kěyǐ.
What do you want to eat? Anything, I'm fine with whatever.
新技术让我们的生活越来越方便。
Xīn jìshù ràng wǒmen de shēnghuó yuè lái yuè fāngbiàn.
New technology makes our lives more and more convenient.
每个人都应该了解一些法律知识。
Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi liǎojiě yìxiē fǎlǜ zhīshi.
Everyone should know some basic law.
公司用各种手段保护客户的信息。
Gōngsī yòng gèzhǒng shǒuduàn bǎohù kèhù de xìnxī.
The company uses various means to protect customer data.
我保证明天以前完成作业。
Wǒ bǎozhèng míngtiān yǐqián wánchéng zuòyè.
I promise to finish the homework before tomorrow.
宿舍的网络有点儿慢。
Sùshè de wǎngluò yǒudiǎnr màn.
The dorm internet is a bit slow.

texts.title: Chen Tianzhong got lost after leaving school and asked a fellow student for directions

lines.zh: 请问，花园小区怎么走？
lines.py: Qǐngwèn, huāyuán xiǎoqū zěnme zǒu?
lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to Huayuan Residential Area?

lines.zh: 你往前走，到十字路口不要过马路，直接右转就到小区门口了。正好我也去那边，一起走吧。
lines.py: Nǐ wǎngqiánzǒu, dào shízìlùkǒu búyào guò mǎlù, zhíjiē yòuzhuǎn jiù dào xiǎoqū ménkǒu le. Zhènghǎo wǒ yě qù nàbiān, yìqǐ zǒu ba.
lines.en: Go straight. At the crossroads, don't cross the road; just turn right and you'll be at the entrance. I happen to be going that way too, so let's walk together.

lines.zh: 好的。我刚来中国，不熟悉路。北京真是太大了。
lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ gānglái Zhōngguó, bù shúxī lù. Běijīng zhēnshìtài dà le.
lines.en: OK. I just arrived in China and don't know the roads. Beijing is really too big.

lines.zh: 北京大是大，不过这边的路基本上都是正南正北、正东正西的，很好找。你也可以用手机地图，很容易就能找到目的地。
lines.py: Běijīng dàshì dà, búguò zhèbiān de lù jīběnshàng dōu shì zhèngnán zhèngběi, zhèngdōng zhèngxī de, hěn hǎozhǎo. Nǐ yě kěyǐ yòng shǒujī dìtú, hěn róngyì jiù néng zhǎodào mùdìdì.
lines.en: Beijing is big all right, but the roads around here basically run straight north–south and east–west, so they're easy to find. You can also use a phone map; it's easy to find your destination.

lines.zh: 嗯，不过很多中文地名我还不认识。
lines.py: Ńg, búguò hěn duō Zhōngwén dìmíng wǒ hái bú rènshi.
lines.en: Mm, but I still can't read many Chinese place names.

lines.zh: 没关系，你很快就会熟悉的。
lines.py: Méi guānxi, nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì shúxī de.
lines.en: Don't worry, you'll get familiar with them soon.

texts.title: After class at noon, Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong meet in the canteen and chat while eating

lines.zh: 前两天和李文喝咖啡时，他帮我下载了微信和支付宝，教我认识里边的汉字，还教我用手机进行支付。
lines.py: Qiánliǎngtiān hé Lǐ Wén hēkāfēi shí, tā bāng wǒ xiàzài le Wēixìn hé Zhīfùbǎo, jiāo wǒ rènshi lǐbiān de hànzì, hái jiāo wǒyòng shǒujī jìnxíng zhīfù.
lines.en: A couple of days ago when I had coffee with Li Wen, he downloaded WeChat and Alipay for me, taught me the characters in them, and showed me how to pay by phone.

lines.zh: 他也教了我怎么用这两个软件。
lines.py: Tā yě jiāole wǒ zěnme yòng zhè liǎng ge ruǎnjiàn.
lines.en: He also taught me how to use these two apps.

lines.zh: 现在我不仅会扫码结账，还会用手机在网上购物了。昨天我就在网上订了一台电脑，今天下午一点送到。
lines.py: Xiànzài wǒ bùjǐn huì sǎomǎ jiézhàng, háihuìyòng shǒujī zài wǎngshang gòuwù le. Zuótiān wǒ jiù zài wǎngshang dìng le yìtái diànnǎo, jīntiān xiàwǔ yìdiǎn sòngdào.
lines.en: Now I can not only scan codes to pay, I can also shop online with my phone. Yesterday I ordered a computer online, and it's arriving at 1 p.m. today.

lines.zh: 学会了这些，我们在中国生活真是方便了不少。
lines.py: Xuéhuì le zhèxiē, wǒmen zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó zhēnshì fāngbiàn le bù shǎo.
lines.en: Having learned all this, life in China has become a lot more convenient for us.

lines.zh: 对。快递员要到了，我得马上回去！家月，明天见！
lines.py: Duì. Kuàidì yuányào dào le, wǒ děi mǎshàng huíqu! Jiāyuè, míngtiān jiàn!
lines.en: Right. The courier is about to arrive, I have to go back now! See you tomorrow, Jiayue!

lines.zh: 好的，天中，再见。
lines.py: Hǎo de, Tiānzhōng, zàijiàn.
lines.en: OK, Tianzhong, bye.

texts.title: New life experiences

lines.zh: 白家月和陈天中刚到北京时就发现，中国人在饭馆或超市结账时，几乎都用手机支付，只有他们用现金结账。
lines.py: Bái Jiāyuè hé Chén Tiānzhōng gāngdào Běijīng shí jiù fāxiàn, Zhōngguó rén zài fànguǎn huò chāoshì jiézhàng shí, jīhū dōu yòng shǒujī zhīfù, zhǐyǒu tāmen yòng xiànjīn jiézhàng.
lines.en: As soon as Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong arrived in Beijing, they noticed that Chinese people almost always pay by phone at restaurants or supermarkets; only they were paying in cash.

lines.zh: 在李文的帮助下，白家月和陈天中也都学会了用手机支付、网购、寄快递等等。在中国网购，不仅选择多、价格不高，而且送货很快，很多留学生甚至改变了自己的购物习惯。不过，由于网购太方便了，动动手指就能买到想要的东西，他们也开始担心自己在网购时会乱花钱。怎么才能管住自己不乱花钱呢？
lines.py: Zài Lǐ Wén de bāngzhù xià, Bái Jiāyuè hé Chén Tiānzhōng yě dōu xuéhuì le yòng shǒujī zhīfù, wǎnggòu, jì kuàidì děngděng. Zài Zhōngguó wǎnggòu, bùjǐn xuǎnzé duō, jiàgé bùgāo, érqiě sònghuò hěn kuài, hěn duō liúxuéshēng shènzhì gǎibiàn le zìjǐ de gòuwù xíguàn. Búguò, yóuyú wǎnggòu tài fāngbiàn le, dòngdong shǒuzhǐ jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎngyào de dōngxi, tāmen yě kāishǐ dānxīn zìjǐ zài wǎnggòu shíhuì luànhuāqián. Zěnme cáinéng guǎnzhù zìjǐ bú luànhuāqián ne?
lines.en: With Li Wen's help, they both learned to pay by phone, shop online, send packages and so on. Online shopping in China offers lots of choice, low prices and fast delivery, so many international students have even changed their shopping habits. But because it's so convenient—you can buy anything with a tap of a finger—they've started to worry about spending money carelessly. How can they keep themselves from overspending?

texts.title: How to protect personal information when using mobile phones

lines.zh: 网上购物或者订票时，我们经常需要提供姓名、手机号、身份证号等个人信息。在提供这些信息时，我们也会担心：我的个人信息能否得到保护？于是，有人在网上说出了自己的担心，很快就有人给出了一些建议。比如，别把密码随便告诉别人，不在网上发自己的车票、机票信息……
lines.py: Wǎngshang gòuwù huòzhě dìngpiào shí, wǒmen jīngcháng xūyào tígōng xìngmíng, shǒujīhào, shēnfènzhènghào děng gèrénxìnxī. Zài tígōng zhèxiē xìnxī shí, wǒmen yě huì dānxīn: wǒ de gèrénxìnxī néngfǒu dédào bǎohù? Yúshì, yǒu rén zài wǎngshang shuōchū le zìjǐ de dānxīn, hěn kuài jiù yǒu rén gěichū le yìxiē jiànyì. Bǐrú, bié bǎ mìmǎ suíbiàn gàosu biérén, búzài wǎngshang fā zìjǐ de chēpiào, jīpiàoxìnxī……
lines.en: When shopping or booking tickets online, we often need to provide personal information such as our name, phone number and ID number. When we do, we worry: will my personal information be protected? So some people shared their worries online, and others soon gave suggestions, such as don't casually tell anyone your password, and don't post your train or plane ticket information online…

lines.zh: 现在，很多国家也通过技术、法律等手段来保证个人信息安全。比如中国的网络安全法、个人信息保护法等就很好地保护了人们的个人信息。
lines.py: Xiànzài, hěn duō guójiā yě tōngguò jìshù, fǎlǜ děng shǒuduàn lái bǎozhèng gèrén xìnxī'ānquán. Bǐrú Zhōngguó de wǎngluò'ānquán fǎ, gèrénxìnxī bǎohùfǎ děng jiù hěn hǎo de bǎohù le rénmen de gèrénxìnxī.
lines.en: Now many countries also use technology, law and other means to keep personal information safe. For example, China's Cybersecurity Law and Personal Information Protection Law protect people's personal information well.

grammar.title: ……×是×，就是/不过……
grammar.note: "×是×" first admits a fact ("it is × all right"), then 就是 / 不过 adds a limitation or a "but".
ex: 北京大是大，不过这边的路基本上都是正南正北、正东正西的，很好找。
Běijīng dàshì dà, búguò zhèbiān de lù jīběnshàng dōu shì zhèngnán zhèngběi, zhèngdōng zhèngxī de, hěn hǎozhǎo.
Beijing is big all right, but the roads here mostly run straight, so they're easy to find.
这个房子便宜是便宜，就是离我的公司太远了。
Zhège fángzi piányi shì piányi, jiùshì lí wǒ de gōngsī tàiyuǎn le.
This apartment is cheap, sure, but it's too far from my company.
我们想是想了，就是没想出更好的办法。
Wǒmen xiǎng shì xiǎng le, jiùshì méixiǎng chū gènghǎo de bànfǎ.
We did think about it, but we couldn't come up with a better solution.

grammar.title: 不仅/不光……，还/而且……
grammar.note: "Not only …, but also …". With one subject the pattern is: Subject + 不仅/不光 …，还/而且 …. The second part goes one step further.
ex: 现在我不仅会扫码结账，还会用手机在网上购物了。
Xiànzài wǒ bùjǐn huì sǎomǎ jiézhàng, háihuìyòng shǒujī zài wǎngshang gòuwù le.
Now I can not only scan to pay but also shop online.
王老师不光教我们说中文，而且带我们了解中国文化。
Wáng lǎoshī bùguāng jiāo wǒmen shuō Zhōngwén, érqiě dài wǒmen liǎojiě Zhōngguó wénhuà.
Teacher Wang not only teaches us to speak Chinese but also helps us understand Chinese culture.
现在很多书店不仅卖书，还卖咖啡和奶茶。
Xiànzài hěn duō shūdiàn bùjǐn màishū, hái mài kāfēi hé nǎichá.
Nowadays many bookstores sell not only books but also coffee and milk tea.

grammar.title: Conjunction 甚至 (shènzhì)
grammar.note: 甚至 = "even": it points out something more extreme than expected.
ex: 在中国网购，不仅选择多、价格不高，而且送货很快，很多留学生甚至改变了自己的购物习惯。
Zài Zhōngguó wǎnggòu, bùjǐn xuǎnzé duō, jiàgé bùgāo, érqiě sònghuò hěn kuài, hěn duō liúxuéshēng shènzhì gǎibiàn le zìjǐ de gòuwù xíguàn.
Online shopping in China is so good that many international students have even changed their shopping habits.
高铁速度真快，甚至还没看清楚，它就已经开过去了。
Gāotiě sùdù zhēn kuài, shènzhì hái méi kàn qīngchu, tā jiù yǐjīng kāi guòqù le.
The high-speed train is so fast that it's gone before you can even see it clearly.
这个小区真不错，有小花园、球场，甚至还有一个超市。
Zhège xiǎoqū zhēnbúcuò, yǒu xiǎo huāyuán, qiúchǎng, shènzhì hái yǒu yí ge chāoshì.
This neighborhood is great: it has a small garden, a sports court, and even a supermarket.

grammar.title: Successive sentence ……，于是……
grammar.note: Two clauses describe events in order; 于是 starts the second clause: "…, so / and then …".
ex: 在提供这些信息时，我们也会担心：我的个人信息能否得到保护？于是，有人在网上说出了自己的担心。
Zài tígōng zhèxiē xìnxī shí, wǒmen yě huì dānxīn: wǒ de gèrénxìnxī néngfǒu dédào bǎohù? Yúshì, yǒu rén zài wǎngshang shuōchū le zìjǐ de dānxīn.
When providing this information we worry whether it will be protected, so some people shared their worries online.
她从小就想当医生，于是上大学时就选择了学医。
Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng yīshēng, yúshì shàng dàxué shí jiù xuǎnzé le xué yī.
She wanted to be a doctor since childhood, so she chose medicine at university.
最近总感冒，于是他决定病好后就开始锻炼身体。
Zuìjìn zǒng gǎnmào, yúshì tā juédìng bìnghǎo hòu jiù kāishǐ duànliàn shēntǐ.
He keeps catching colds lately, so he decided to start exercising once he's well.

fill.q: 丽丽去快递站拿快递时，又＿＿了一个快递。
full: 丽丽去快递站拿快递时，又寄了一个快递。
Lìlì qù kuàidì zhàn ná kuàidì shí, yòu jì le yí ge kuàidì.
When Lili went to pick up a package at the delivery station, she also sent one.
fill.why: 拿快递 (pick up a package) and 寄快递 (send a package). 又寄了一个快递 = also sent one.

fill.q: 从这儿走到十字路口，再向左＿＿，就是超市了。
full: 从这儿走到十字路口，再向左转，就是超市了。
Cóng zhèr zǒu dào shízìlùkǒu, zài xiàngzuǒzhuǎn, jiùshì chāoshì le.
Walk from here to the crossroads, then turn left, and that's the supermarket.
fill.why: 向左转 = turn left. 转 is the verb used with directions after 向/往.

fill.q: 在十字路口等了半个小时，他们也没来，＿＿我就一个人去图书馆了。
full: 在十字路口等了半个小时，他们也没来，于是我就一个人去图书馆了。
Zài shízìlùkǒu děng le bànge xiǎoshí, tāmen yě méilái, yúshì wǒ jiù yí ge rénqù túshūguǎn le.
I waited at the crossroads for half an hour and they didn't come, so I went to the library alone.
fill.why: They didn't come after half an hour, so as a result she went alone: 于是 (so / thereupon) links cause and result.

fill.q: 在商场购物的时候，我喜欢用信用卡＿＿。
full: 在商场购物的时候，我喜欢用信用卡结账。
Zài shāngchǎng gòuwù de shíhou, wǒ xǐhuan yòng xìnyòngkǎ jiézhàng.
When shopping at the mall, I like to pay with a credit card.
fill.why: 用信用卡结账 = pay the bill with a credit card. 用 + method + 结账.

fill.q: 我们到电影院的时候，电影＿＿开始了。
full: 我们到电影院的时候，电影正好开始了。
Wǒmen dào diànyǐngyuàn de shíhou, diànyǐng zhènghǎo kāishǐ le.
When we got to the cinema, the movie was just starting.
fill.why: 正好 = just at that moment: the film was starting exactly when they arrived.

fill.q: A：我用＿＿结账可以吗？B：当然，这些一共125块。
full: A：我用现金结账可以吗？B：当然，这些一共125块。
A: Wǒyòng xiànjīn jiézhàng kěyǐ ma? B: Dāngrán, zhèxiē yígòng yìbǎièrshíwǔ kuài.
A: Can I pay in cash? B: Of course, it's 125 yuan in total.
fill.why: 用现金结账 = pay in cash. B's answer gives a total amount, so it's about payment.

fill.q: A：这个工作要求对网络＿＿很了解，你可以吗？B：没问题，我做这方面的工作已经有五年了。
full: A：这个工作要求对网络技术很了解，你可以吗？B：没问题，我做这方面的工作已经有五年了。
A: Zhège gōngzuò yāoqiú duì wǎngluò jìshù hěn liǎojiě, nǐ kěyǐ ma? B: Méi wèntí, wǒ zuò zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò yǐjīng yǒu wǔnián le.
A: This job requires a good understanding of network technology; can you do it? B: No problem, I've worked in this field for five years.
fill.why: 网络技术 = network technology. The reply mentions five years in this field, so a technical skill fits.

fill.q: A：你们能＿＿这些货下午就送到吗？B：您放心，我们有“闪送”服务，下午两点前就能送到。
full: A：你们能保证这些货下午就送到吗？B：您放心，我们有“闪送”服务，下午两点前就能送到。
A: Nǐmen néng bǎozhèng zhèxiē huò xiàwǔ jiù sòngdào ma? B: Nín fàngxīn, wǒmen yǒu “shǎnsòng” fúwù, xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn qián jiù néng sòngdào.
A: Can you guarantee these goods arrive this afternoon? B: Don't worry, we have an instant delivery service; it'll arrive before 2 p.m.
fill.why: 能保证……吗 = can you guarantee …? B answers with a promise of delivery before 2 p.m.

fill.q: A：这个商场特别漂亮，在这里＿＿很舒服。B：是啊，周末过来走走、看看，累了还可以坐下来喝喝咖啡或者茶。
full: A：这个商场特别漂亮，在这里购物很舒服。B：是啊，周末过来走走、看看，累了还可以坐下来喝喝咖啡或者茶。
A: Zhège shāngchǎng tèbié piàoliang, zài zhèlǐ gòuwù hěn shūfu. B: Shì a, zhōumò guòlai zǒuzǒu, kànkàn, lèi le hái kěyǐ zuò xialai hē hēkāfēi huòzhě chá.
A: This mall is really beautiful; shopping here is comfortable. B: Yes, you can stroll around on weekends and sit down for coffee or tea when tired.
fill.why: 在这里购物很舒服 = shopping here is pleasant. 商场 + 购物 go together.

fill.q: A：您好，办入住需要您＿＿身份证和手机号后四位。B：好的，这是我的身份证，手机号后四位是5063。
full: A：您好，办入住需要您提供身份证和手机号后四位。B：好的，这是我的身份证，手机号后四位是5063。
A: Nínhǎo, bàn rùzhù xūyào nín tígōng shēnfènzhèng hé shǒujīhào hòu sìwèi. B: Hǎo de, zhè shì wǒ de shēnfènzhèng, shǒujīhào hòu sìwèi shì wǔ líng liù sān.
A: Hello, to check in we need your ID card and the last four digits of your phone number. B: OK, here's my ID; the last four digits are 5063.
fill.why: 办入住需要您提供身份证 = checking in requires you to provide your ID. 提供 + 信息/证件.

q: 陈天中到十字路口后，应该怎么走？
Chén Tiānzhōng dào shízìlùkǒu hòu, yīnggāi zěnme zǒu?
Which way should Chen Tianzhong go at the crossroads?
why: 到十字路口不要过马路，直接右转就到小区门口了。
Dào shízìlùkǒu búyào guò mǎlù, zhíjiē yòuzhuǎn jiù dào xiǎoqū ménkǒu le.
At the crossroads, don't cross the road; turn right directly (直接右转). 向右转 = turn right.

q: 为了找到目的地，同学建议陈天中：
Wèile zhǎodào mùdìdì, tóngxué jiànyì Chén Tiānzhōng:
To find his destination, the student suggests that Chen Tianzhong:
why: 你也可以用手机地图，很容易就能找到目的地。
Nǐ yě kěyǐ yòng shǒujī dìtú, hěn róngyì jiù néng zhǎodào mùdìdì.
The classmate suggests 手机地图 (a map app on the phone). Subway, paper maps and taxi drivers are never mentioned.

q: 李文帮陈天中下载了什么软件？
Lǐ Wén bāng Chén Tiānzhōng xiàzài le shénme ruǎnjiàn?
What apps did Li Wen download for Chen Tianzhong?
why: 他帮我下载了微信和支付宝。
Tā bāng wǒ xiàzài le Wēixìn hé Zhīfùbǎo.
Li Wen downloaded WeChat (微信) and Alipay (支付宝) for him.

q: 陈天中为什么着急回去？
Chén Tiānzhōng wèishénme zháojí huíqu?
Why is Chen Tianzhong in a hurry to go back?
o: Li Wen is looking for him
the courier is about to arrive
the phone he bought online arrived
why: 快递员要到了，我得马上回去！
Kuàidì yuányào dào le, wǒ děi mǎshàng huíqu!
快递员要到了 = the courier is about to arrive. His computer (not a phone) is being delivered at 1 p.m.

q: 白家月和陈天中发现中国人在饭馆吃饭有什么习惯？
Bái Jiāyuè hé Chén Tiānzhōng fāxiàn Zhōngguó rén zài fànguǎn chī fàn yǒu shénme xíguàn?
What habit did they notice Chinese people have when eating at restaurants?
why: 中国人在饭馆或超市结账时，几乎都用手机支付，只有他们用现金结账。
Zhōngguó rén zài fànguǎn huò chāoshì jiézhàng shí, jīhū dōu yòng shǒujī zhīfù, zhǐyǒu tāmen yòng xiànjīn jiézhàng.
几乎都用手机支付 = almost everyone pays by phone. Only Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong used cash.

q: 根据课文，留学生网购时会担心什么？
Gēnjù kèwén, liúxuéshēng wǎnggòu shíhuì dānxīn shénme?
According to the text, what do international students worry about when shopping online?
why: 他们也开始担心自己在网购时会乱花钱。
Tāmen yě kāishǐ dānxīn zìjǐ zài wǎnggòu shíhuì luànhuāqián.
乱花钱 = spend money carelessly. Prices are low and delivery is fast, so B and C are the opposite of the text.

q: 网上购物或者订票时，经常需要提供哪些信息？
Wǎngshang gòuwù huòzhě dìngpiào shí, jīngcháng xūyào tígōng nǎxiē xìnxī?
What information is often needed when shopping or booking tickets online?
why: 我们经常需要提供姓名、手机号、身份证号等个人信息。
Wǒmen jīngcháng xūyào tígōng xìngmíng, shǒujīhào, shēnfènzhènghào děng gèrénxìnxī.
The text lists name, phone number and ID number, so all three are needed: D 以上都需要 (all of the above).

q: 下列哪项不是课文中的建议？
Xiàliè nǎxiàng búshì kèwén zhōng de jiànyì?
Which of the following is NOT a suggestion in the text?
o: don't post your train ticket info
don't casually tell others your password
don't send or receive email in cafés
don't post your plane ticket info
why: 别把密码随便告诉别人，不在网上发自己的车票、机票信息……
Bié bǎ mìmǎ suíbiàn gàosu biérén, búzài wǎngshang fā zìjǐ de chēpiào, jīpiàoxìnxī……
The suggestions are: don't tell others your password, don't post train or plane ticket info. Nothing is said about email in cafés, so C is NOT a suggestion from the text.

ex: 下雨天出行要注意安全。

Be careful when you go out on rainy days.
我家到学校的距离大概三公里。
Wǒjiā dào xuéxiào de jùlí dàgài sān gōnglǐ.
The distance from my home to school is about three kilometers.

Eating more healthy food is good for your body.
