texts.title: At the subway station, Chen Tianzhong was about to buy a ticket and enter

lines.zh: 啊，我的手机停机了！怎么办啊？
lines.py: A, wǒ de shǒujī tíngjī le! Zěnmebàn a?
lines.en: Oh, my phone service has been cut off! What do I do?

lines.zh: 你好，你看上去很着急，需要帮忙吗？
lines.py: Nǐhǎo, nǐ kàn shangqu hěnzháojí, xūyào bāngmáng ma?
lines.en: Hi, you look worried. Do you need help?

lines.zh: 我忘了交电话费，手机停机了。我没带现金，手机没有信号，上不了网，买不了地铁票了。
lines.py: Wǒ wàng le jiāo diànhuàfèi, shǒujī tíngjī le. Wǒ méidài xiànjīn, shǒujī méiyǒu xìnhào, shàng bu liǎo wǎng, mǎi bu liǎo dìtiěpiào le.
lines.en: I forgot to pay my phone bill, so my service was cut off. I didn't bring cash, my phone has no signal, I can't get online, and I can't buy a subway ticket.

lines.zh: 你要去哪儿？我帮你买张票。
lines.py: Nǐ yào qù nǎr? Wǒ bāng nǐ mǎizhāng piào.
lines.en: Where are you going? I'll buy you a ticket.

lines.zh: 太感谢你了，我要去北京大学站。对了，能不能告诉我你的联系方式？我想把钱还给你。
lines.py: Tài gǎnxiè nǐ le, wǒyào qù Běijīng Dàxué Zhàn. Duìle, néng bù néng gàosu wǒ nǐ de liánxìfāngshì? Wǒ xiǎng bǎ qián huán gěi nǐ.
lines.en: Thank you so much, I'm going to Peking University Station. By the way, could you give me your contact information? I'd like to pay you back.

lines.zh: 别客气，很高兴能帮到你。
lines.py: Bié kèqi, hěn gāoxìng néng bāngdào nǐ.
lines.en: Don't mention it. I'm glad I could help you.

texts.title: Downstairs, Bai Jiayue meets a neighbor who lives on the same floor

lines.zh: 阿姨，您怎么站在这儿不上楼？
lines.py: Āyí, nín zěnme zhàn zài zhèr bú shànglóu?
lines.en: Auntie, why are you standing here instead of going upstairs?

lines.zh: 我开车去超市买了不少东西，刚拿过来了一些。我先休息一会儿，再去车里拿剩下的。
lines.py: Wǒ kāichē qù chāoshì mǎi le bù shǎo dōngxi, gāng ná guòlai le yìxiē. Wǒxiān xiūxi yíhuìr, zài qù chēlǐ ná shèngxià de.
lines.en: I drove to the supermarket and bought quite a lot, and I've just brought some over. I'll rest a bit first, then get the rest from the car.

lines.zh: 我正好要上楼，我帮您提上去吧。
lines.py: Wǒ zhènghǎo yào shànglóu, wǒ bāng níntí shangqu ba.
lines.en: I'm going upstairs anyway; let me carry them up for you.

lines.zh: 不用不用，这几个袋子太重了，我自己拿吧。
lines.py: Bú yòng bú yòng, zhè jǐ ge dàizi tàizhòng le, wǒ zìjǐ ná ba.
lines.en: No, no, these bags are too heavy; I'll carry them myself.

lines.zh: 没事，我提着这些东西就算锻炼身体了，再说邻居之间就是要互相帮助啊。
lines.py: Méishì, wǒ tízhe zhèxiē dōngxi jiùsuàn duànliàn shēntǐ le, zàishuō línjū zhījiān jiùshì yào hùxiāngbāngzhù a.
lines.en: It's fine, carrying these counts as exercise for me. Besides, neighbors should help each other.

lines.zh: 谢谢家月！那就辛苦你了。
lines.py: Xièxie Jiāyuè! Nà jiù xīnkǔ nǐ le.
lines.en: Thank you, Jiayue! Sorry for the trouble then.

texts.title: A new option for short commutes

lines.zh: 在城市里，人们出行的方式越来越多。短距离出行时，骑自行车往往是人们常见的选择。白家月就很喜欢骑车去学校，她觉得这样既方便，又能锻炼身体，还能保护环境。
lines.py: Zài chéngshì li, rénmen chūxíng de fāngshì yuè lái yuè duō. Duǎnjùlí chūxíng shí, qí zìxíngchē wǎngwǎng shì rénmen chángjiàn de xuǎnzé. Bái Jiāyuè jiù hěn xǐhuan qíchēqù xuéxiào, tā juéde zhèyàng jì fāngbiàn, yòu néng duànliàn shēntǐ, hái néng bǎohùhuánjìng.
lines.en: In cities, there are more and more ways to get around. For short trips, cycling is often a common choice. Bai Jiayue loves biking to school; she thinks it's convenient, good exercise, and protects the environment.

lines.zh: 除了骑自行车，人们还会选择骑电动车。电动车速度快，价格不高，充电也很方便，所以越来越流行。陈天中平时也骑自行车，不过为了省力气，他最近打算买一辆电动车。
lines.py: Chúle qí zìxíngchē, rénmen háihuì xuǎnzé qí diàndòngchē. Diàndòngchē sùdùkuài, jiàgé bùgāo, chōngdiàn yě hěn fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ yuè lái yuè liúxíng. Chén Tiānzhōng píngshí yě qí zìxíngchē, búguò wèile shěng lìqi, tā zuìjìn dǎsuàn mǎi yí liàng diàndòngchē.
lines.en: Besides bikes, people also choose e-bikes. E-bikes are fast, not expensive and easy to charge, so they are more and more popular. Chen Tianzhong usually rides a bike too, but to save effort, he's planning to buy an e-bike.

texts.title: Thoughtful services at subway stations

lines.zh: 在中国，乘客可以在不少地铁站里直接扫码购买食物和饮料，有的地铁站还提供免费借雨伞、发雨衣等服务。
lines.py: Zài Zhōngguó, chéngkè kěyǐ zài bù shǎo dìtiězhàn li zhíjiē sǎomǎ gòumǎi shíwù hé yǐnliào, yǒu de dìtiězhàn hái tígōng miǎnfèi jiè yǔsǎn, fā yǔyī děng fúwù.
lines.en: In China, passengers can scan a code to buy food and drinks directly in many subway stations, and some stations even lend umbrellas and give out raincoats for free.

lines.zh: 有些地铁站附近公司比较多，工作日站里还有早餐车，没来得及吃早饭的人在这里就能买到热包子和牛奶等，省了不少时间。有的地铁站里甚至还有鲜花店，乘客下班时可以顺便买花送给家人。
lines.py: Yǒuxiē dìtiězhàn fùjìn gōngsī bǐjiào duō, gōngzuòrì zhàn li hái yǒu zǎocān chē, méi láidejí chī zǎofàn de rén zài zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào rè bāozi hé niúnǎi děng, shěng le bù shǎo shíjiān. Yǒu de dìtiězhàn li shènzhì hái yǒu xiānhuādiàn, chéngkè xiàbān shí kěyǐ shùnbiàn mǎihuā sònggěi jiārén.
lines.en: Some stations have many companies nearby, so on workdays there are breakfast carts; people who didn't have time for breakfast can buy hot buns, milk and so on, saving a lot of time. Some stations even have flower shops, so passengers can pick up flowers for their family on the way home.

lines.zh: 这些小小的服务，不仅方便了人们的出行，也让大家的心情变得更加愉快。
lines.py: Zhèxiē xiǎoxiǎode fúwù, bùjǐn fāngbiàn le rénmen de chūxíng, yě ràng dàjiā de xīnqíng biànde gèngjiā yúkuài.
lines.en: These small services not only make commuting easier but also make everyone's mood happier.

grammar.title: Complement of potentiality: Verb + 得/不 + 了
grammar.note: 得了 / 不了 after a verb (or inside a separable verb) says whether an action can or cannot be done: 上不了网 = can't get online; 来不了 = can't come.
ex: 手机没有信号，上不了网，买不了地铁票了。
Shǒujī méiyǒu xìnhào, shàng bu liǎo wǎng, mǎi bu liǎo dìtiěpiào le.
My phone has no signal, so I can't get online or buy a subway ticket.
她刚才给我发信息，说她今天来不了了。
Tā gāngcái gěiwǒfā xìnxī, shuō tā jīntiān lái bu liǎo le.
She just texted me saying she can't come today.
明天的足球比赛，你们班男生参加得了吗？
Míngtiān de zúqiúbǐsài, nǐmen bān nánshēng cānjiā de liǎo ma?
Can the boys in your class take part in tomorrow's soccer match?

grammar.title: Conjunction 再说 (zàishuō)
grammar.note: 再说 adds one more reason after a first reason: "besides / what's more".
ex: 我提着这些东西就算锻炼身体了，再说邻居之间就是要互相帮助啊。
Wǒ tízhe zhèxiē dōngxi jiùsuàn duànliàn shēntǐ le, zàishuō línjū zhījiān jiùshì yào hùxiāngbāngzhù a.
Carrying these counts as exercise; besides, neighbors should help each other.
今天太晚了，别去超市了，再说外面还在下雨呢。
Jīntiān tàiwǎn le, bié qù chāoshì le, zàishuō wàimiàn hái zài xiàyǔ ne.
It's too late today, don't go to the supermarket; besides, it's still raining outside.
你就跟我们一起参加活动吧。你今天正好有时间，再说人多也更热闹。
Nǐ jiù gēn wǒmen yìqǐ cānjiā huódòng ba. Nǐ jīntiān zhènghǎo yǒu shíjiān, zàishuō rénduō yě gèng rènao.
Join our activity. You happen to be free today, and besides, more people makes it more fun.

grammar.title: 既……，又/也……
grammar.note: Links adjectives, verbs or phrases to show two qualities or situations at the same time: "both … and …".
ex: 她觉得这样既方便，又能锻炼身体，还能保护环境。
Tā juéde zhèyàng jì fāngbiàn, yòu néng duànliàn shēntǐ, hái néng bǎohùhuánjìng.
She thinks it's both convenient and good exercise, and also eco-friendly.
这家饭馆的菜既好吃，又便宜。
Zhèjiā fànguǎn de cài jì hǎochī, yòu piányi.
This restaurant's food is both tasty and cheap.
我很喜欢这门课程，既能提高中文水平，也能学到历史知识。
Wǒ hěn xǐhuan zhè mén kèchéng, jì néng tígāo Zhōngwén shuǐpíng, yě néng xuédào lìshǐ zhīshi.
I like this course: it improves my Chinese and also teaches me history.

grammar.title: 来得及 / 来不及
grammar.note: 来得及 = there's still time to do it or make it. 来不及 = there isn't enough time; it's too late.
ex: 没来得及吃早饭的人在这里就能买到热包子和牛奶等。
Méi láidejí chī zǎofàn de rén zài zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào rè bāozi hé niúnǎi děng.
People who didn't have time for breakfast can buy hot buns and milk here.
你现在才告诉我，我来不及通知大家了。
Nǐ xiànzài cái gàosu wǒ, wǒ láibují tōngzhī dàjiā le.
You're only telling me now; I don't have time to notify everyone.
中午12点的飞机，咱们9点出发来得及吗？
Zhōngwǔ shíèr diǎn de fēijī, zánmen jiǔ diǎn chūfā láidejí ma?
The flight is at noon; will we make it if we leave at 9?

fill.q: 还＿＿不少菜，我们带回家吃吧。
full: 还剩不少菜，我们带回家吃吧。
Hái shèng bù shǎo cài, wǒmen dài huí jiā chī ba.
There's quite a lot of food left; let's take it home.
fill.why: 还剩 + amount = there is still … left. 还剩不少菜 = quite a lot of food is left.

fill.q: 外面的雨＿＿了，咱们出去走走吧。
full: 外面的雨停了，咱们出去走走吧。
Wàimiàn de yǔ tíng le, zánmen chūqu zǒuzǒu ba.
The rain outside has stopped; let's go for a walk.
fill.why: 雨停了 = the rain has stopped. 停 (stop) with 了 shows a change.

fill.q: 同学＿＿应该互相帮助、互相学习。
full: 同学之间应该互相帮助、互相学习。
Tóngxué zhījiān yīnggāi hùxiāngbāngzhù, hùxiāngxuéxí.
Classmates should help and learn from each other.
fill.why: A + 之间 = between/among A. 同学之间 = among classmates.

fill.q: 今天我再准备一下材料，明天跟您＿＿。
full: 今天我再准备一下材料，明天跟您联系。
Jīntiān wǒ zài zhǔnbèi yíxià cáiliào, míngtiān gēn nín liánxì.
I'll prepare the materials today and contact you tomorrow.
fill.why: 跟 + someone + 联系 = contact someone. 明天跟您联系 = I'll contact you tomorrow.

fill.q: 奶奶说她每天打扫房间，就＿＿做运动了。
full: 奶奶说她每天打扫房间，就算做运动了。
Nǎinǎi shuō tā měi tiān dǎsǎo fángjiān, jiùsuàn zuò yùndòng le.
Grandma says cleaning the house every day counts as exercise.
fill.why: 就算 + something = count as. 打扫房间就算做运动了 = cleaning counts as exercise.

fill.q: A：你要去超市吗？能不能＿＿帮我买个面包？B：没问题。
full: A：你要去超市吗？能不能顺便帮我买个面包？B：没问题。
A: Nǐ yào qù chāoshì ma? Néng bù néng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎige miànbāo? B: Méi wèntí.
A: Are you going to the supermarket? Could you pick up some bread for me while you're there? B: No problem.
fill.why: 顺便 = while you're at it. Since A is going to the supermarket anyway, B asks them to buy bread 顺便.

fill.q: A：听说你最近一直坚持锻炼。B：是的，我希望自己的身体＿＿健康。
full: A：听说你最近一直坚持锻炼。B：是的，我希望自己的身体更加健康。
A: Tīngshuō nǐ zuìjìn yìzhí jiānchí duànliàn. B: Shì de, wǒ xīwàng zìjǐ de shēntǐ gèngjiā jiànkāng.
A: I heard you've been exercising regularly. B: Yes, I want to be even healthier.
fill.why: 更加 + adjective = even more. 更加健康 = even healthier.

fill.q: A：我发现街上很多人都穿绿色的衣服。B：是啊，看来今年比较＿＿绿色。
full: A：我发现街上很多人都穿绿色的衣服。B：是啊，看来今年比较流行绿色。
A: Wǒ fāxiàn jiēshàng hěn duō rén dōu chuān lǜsè de yīfu. B: Shì a, kànlái jīnnián bǐjiào liúxíng lǜsè.
A: I noticed lots of people on the street wearing green. B: Yes, it seems green is in this year.
fill.why: 今年流行绿色 = green is in fashion this year. 流行 can take an object (a color, style).

fill.q: A：咱们先休息休息吧，我一点儿＿＿也没有了。B：好，你先坐一会儿，我去给你买瓶饮料。
full: A：咱们先休息休息吧，我一点儿力气也没有了。B：好，你先坐一会儿，我去给你买瓶饮料。
A: Zánmen xiān xiūxi xiūxi ba, wǒ yìdiǎnr lìqi yě méiyǒu le. B: Hǎo, nǐ xiān zuò yíhuìr, wǒ qù gěi nǐ mǎi píng yǐnliào.
A: Let's rest; I have no strength left at all. B: OK, sit down and I'll buy you a drink.
fill.why: 一点儿力气也没有 = have no strength at all. 一点儿 + noun + 也/都 + 没有.

fill.q: A：你每天走路上下班吗？B：对，我家到公司的＿＿不算远，走路大概半个小时。
full: A：你每天走路上下班吗？B：对，我家到公司的距离不算远，走路大概半个小时。
A: Nǐ měi tiān zǒulù shàngxiàbān ma? B: Duì, wǒjiā dào gōngsī de jùlí búsuàn yuǎn, zǒulù dàgài bànge xiǎoshí.
A: Do you walk to work every day? B: Yes, the distance from my home to the office isn't far, about half an hour on foot.
fill.why: A 到 B 的距离 = the distance from A to B. 不算远 describes a distance.

q: 陈天中的手机怎么了？
Chén Tiānzhōng de shǒujī zěnme le?
What's wrong with Chen Tianzhong's phone?
why: 我忘了交电话费，手机停机了。
Wǒ wàng le jiāo diànhuàfèi, shǒujī tíngjī le.
He forgot to pay the phone bill, so the service was suspended (停机了). The phone isn't lost or broken; he has it with him.

q: 陈天中要去哪儿？
Chén Tiānzhōng yào qù nǎr?
Where is Chen Tianzhong going?
why: 太感谢你了，我要去北京大学站。
Tài gǎnxiè nǐ le, wǒyào qù Běijīng Dàxué Zhàn.
He says 我要去北京大学站 — Peking University Station.

q: 白家月现在要做什么？
Bái Jiāyuè xiànzài yào zuò shénme?
What is Bai Jiayue about to do?
why: 我正好要上楼，我帮您提上去吧。
Wǒ zhènghǎo yào shànglóu, wǒ bāng níntí shangqu ba.
正好要上楼 = she is just about to go upstairs. Going to the supermarket and the car is what the neighbor did.

q: 白家月要帮邻居做什么？
Bái Jiāyuè yào bāng línjū zuò shénme?
What will Bai Jiayue help the neighbor do?
why: 我帮您提上去吧。
Wǒ bāng níntí shangqu ba.
提上去 = carry (the bags) up. So she helps carry the things upstairs (把东西提上楼). The neighbor plans to fetch the rest from the car herself.

q: 白家月怎么去学校？
Bái Jiāyuè zěnme qù xuéxiào?
How does Bai Jiayue get to school?
why: 白家月就很喜欢骑车去学校。
Bái Jiāyuè jiù hěn xǐhuan qíchēqù xuéxiào.
骑车 here means riding a bicycle (骑自行车). The e-bike is what Chen Tianzhong plans to buy.

q: 最近陈天中打算买什么？
Zuìjìn Chén Tiānzhōng dǎsuàn mǎi shénme?
What is Chen Tianzhong planning to buy?
why: 为了省力气，他最近打算买一辆电动车。
Wèile shěng lìqi, tā zuìjìn dǎsuàn mǎi yí liàng diàndòngchē.
To save effort, he plans to buy an e-bike (电动车). He already rides a regular bike.

q: 根据课文，什么样的地铁站里最可能有早餐车？
Gēnjù kèwén, shénmeyàng de dìtiězhàn li zuì kěnéng yǒu zǎocān chē?
According to the text, which subway stations are most likely to have breakfast carts?
why: 有些地铁站附近公司比较多，工作日站里还有早餐车。
Yǒuxiē dìtiězhàn fùjìn gōngsī bǐjiào duō, gōngzuòrì zhàn li hái yǒu zǎocān chē.
Breakfast carts appear in stations with many companies nearby (附近公司比较多), because office workers pass through on workdays.

q: 根据课文，人们在地铁站里最可能买到：
Gēnjù kèwén, rénmen zài dìtiězhàn li zuì kěnéng mǎi dào:
According to the text, what can people most likely buy in a subway station?
why: 没来得及吃早饭的人在这里就能买到热包子和牛奶等。
Méi láidejí chī zǎofàn de rén zài zhèlǐ jiù néng mǎi dào rè bāozi hé niúnǎi děng.
You can BUY hot buns (包子). Umbrellas are lent (借) and raincoats are given out (发) for free, not bought; maps aren't mentioned.

en: "Not afraid of spicy" vs. "Afraid of not spicy"

ex: 从这儿到机场至少要一个小时。
Cóng zhèr dào jīchǎng zhìshǎo yào yí ge xiǎoshí.
It takes at least an hour from here to the airport.
我在家里常常做中餐。
Wǒ zài jiālǐ chángcháng zuò zhōngcān.
I often cook Chinese food at home.
我专门为你买了这本书。
Wǒ zhuānmén wèi nǐ mǎi le zhè běnshū.
I bought this book especially for you.
我饿了，煮一碗面条吃吧。
Wǒ è le, zhǔ yìwǎn miàntiáo chī ba.
I'm hungry; let's cook a bowl of noodles.
这道菜的油太多了，不太健康。
Zhè dàocài de yóutàiduō le, bútài jiànkāng.
This dish has too much oil; not very healthy.
今天我做了三道菜。
Jīntiān wǒ zuò le sāndào cài.
I made three dishes today.
肉还没熟，再煮五分钟吧。
Ròu hái méishú, zài zhǔ wǔfēnzhōng ba.
The meat isn't cooked yet; boil it five more minutes.
你先坐，我给你倒杯茶。
Nǐ xiān zuò, wǒ gěi nǐ dàobēichá.
Have a seat; I'll pour you some tea.
我做菜的时候喜欢多放辣椒。
Wǒ zuòcài de shíhou xǐhuan duōfàng làjiāo.
I like to add lots of chili when I cook.
这个菜有点儿辣，你能吃吗？
Zhège cài yǒudiǎnr là, nǐ néng chī ma?
This dish is a bit spicy. Can you eat it?
我晚上不敢一个人走这条路。
Wǒ wǎnshang bùgǎn yí ge rén zǒu zhè tiáolù.
I don't dare walk this road alone at night.
我早上没吃饭，现在肚子很饿。
Wǒ zǎoshàng méi chī fàn, xiànzài dùzi hěn è.
I didn't eat breakfast and now I'm very hungry.
我们俩的爱好完全相同。
Wǒmen liǎ de àihào wánquánxiāngtóng.
The two of us have exactly the same hobbies.
请大家按顺序排队上车。
Qǐng dàjiā àn shùnxù páiduì shàngchē.
Please line up in order to board.
两个人吃四个菜，够了。
Liǎng ge rén chī sìge cài, gòu le.
Four dishes for two people is enough.
这个月的钱不够用了。
Zhège yuè de qián búgòu yòng le.
There isn't enough money this month.
他的中文已经达到了HSK四级的水平。
Tā de Zhōngwén yǐjīng dádào le HSK sìjí de shuǐpíng.
His Chinese has already reached HSK level 4.
周末我们几个老同学聚一聚吧。
Zhōumò wǒmen jǐ ge lǎotóngxué jùyíjù ba.
Let's get together this weekend, us old classmates.
我们公司的午餐时间是十二点到一点。
Wǒmen gōngsī de wǔcānshíjiān shì shí'èrdiǎn dào yìdiǎn.
Our company's lunch break is from twelve to one.
这个汤太咸了，再加点儿水吧。
Zhège tāngtàixián le, zài jiā diǎnr shuǐba.
This soup is too salty; add a bit of water.
夏天我喜欢吃凉菜。
Xiàtiān wǒ xǐhuan chī liángcài.
In summer I like eating cold dishes.
这个苹果有点儿酸。
Zhège píngguǒ yǒudiǎnr suān.
This apple is a bit sour.
感冒的时候喝点儿热汤对身体好。
Gǎnmào de shíhou hē diǎnr rètāng duì shēntǐ hǎo.
When you have a cold, some hot soup is good for you.
下课以后，大家各回各的宿舍。
Xiàkè yǐhòu, dàjiā gèhuí gè de sùshè.
After class everyone goes back to their own dorm.
这顿饭我来付钱吧。
Zhè dùnfàn wǒlái fùqián ba.
Let me pay for this meal.
下周五我们班要聚餐。
Xià zhōuwǔ wǒmen bānyào jùcān.
Our class is having a dinner next Friday.
今天是朋友聚会，大家穿得随意一点儿就好。
Jīntiān shì péngyou jùhuì, dàjiā chuān de suíyì yìdiǎnr jiù hǎo.
It's a friends' party today; just dress casually.
会议下午两点正式开始。
Huìyì xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn zhèngshì kāishǐ.
The meeting officially starts at 2 p.m.
这只是一件普通的衣服。
Zhè zhǐshì yíjiàn pǔtōng de yīfu.
This is just an ordinary piece of clothing.
我们公司非常重视员工的意见。
Wǒmen gōngsī fēicháng zhòngshì yuángōng de yìjiàn.
Our company values employees' opinions highly.
电影票上有座位号。
Diànyǐngpiào shàng yǒu zuòwèihào.
The movie ticket has a seat number.
这个周末你有什么安排？
Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shénme ānpái?
Do you have any plans this weekend?
请按照老师的要求写作文。
Qǐng ànzhào lǎoshī de yāoqiú xiězuòwén.
Please write the essay according to the teacher's requirements.
我们班同学的年龄差不多。
Wǒmen bān tóngxué de niánlíng chàbuduō.
The students in our class are about the same age.
遇到困难的时候，要勇敢面对。
Yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, yào yǒnggǎn miànduì.
When you meet difficulties, face them bravely.
主人热情地欢迎我们。
Zhǔrén rèqíng de huānyíng wǒmen.
The host warmly welcomed us.
等你到了北京，给我打个电话。
Děng nǐ dào le Běijīng, gěi wǒ dǎge diànhuà.
When you get to Beijing, give me a call.
我们应该尊重每个人的选择。
Wǒmen yīnggāi zūnzhòng měi ge rén de xuǎnzé.
We should respect everyone's choices.

texts.title: At Liu Ming and Wang Yixue's home, the couple invited Bai Jiayue and Li Wen for a meal

lines.zh: 家月，你来中国至少两个月了，习惯吃中餐了吗？
lines.py: Jiāyuè, nǐ lái Zhōngguó zhìshǎo liǎng ge yuè le, xíguàn chī zhōngcān le ma?
lines.en: Jiayue, you've been in China for at least two months. Are you used to Chinese food yet?

lines.zh: 习惯了，而且我很喜欢吃中国菜。
lines.py: Xíguàn le, érqiě wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī Zhōngguó cài.
lines.en: Yes, and I really like Chinese food.

lines.zh: 你还没吃过水煮鱼吧？这是我专门为你做的。
lines.py: Nǐ hái méichīguo Shuǐzhǔyú ba? Zhè shì wǒ zhuānmén wèi nǐ zuò de.
lines.en: You haven't had boiled fish in chili oil yet, have you? I made it especially for you.

lines.zh: 看起来不像水煮鱼，更像“油煮鱼”。
lines.py: Kàn qilai búxiàng Shuǐzhǔyú, gèng xiàng “yóu zhǔ yú”.
lines.en: It doesn't look like fish boiled in water, more like fish boiled in oil.

lines.zh: 这道菜是先用水把鱼煮熟，最后再倒上辣椒油，其实只有最上面那一层是油。你尝尝，对你来说辣不辣？
lines.py: Zhè dàocài shì xiān yòngshuǐ bǎ yú zhǔshú, zuìhòu zài dào shang làjiāoyóu, qíshí zhǐyǒu zuì shàngmiàn nà yì céng shì yóu. Nǐ chángcháng, duì nǐ lái shuō làbulà?
lines.en: For this dish, you first boil the fish in water until cooked, then pour chili oil on top at the end. Actually only the top layer is oil. Try it. Is it spicy for you?

lines.zh: 辣是辣，但是非常好吃！
lines.py: Làshì là, dànshì fēicháng hǎochī!
lines.en: It's spicy all right, but it's delicious!

lines.zh: 那你多吃点儿，不要客气。
lines.py: Nà nǐ duō chī diǎnr, búyào kèqi.
lines.en: Then have some more, don't be shy.

texts.title: At Liu Ming and Wang Yixue's home, the couple chat with Bai Jiayue and Li Wen over the meal

lines.zh: 我听李文说，你现在也爱吃辣了？
lines.py: Wǒ tīng Lǐ Wén shuō, nǐ xiànzài yě ài chī là le?
lines.en: I heard from Li Wen that you love spicy food now too?

lines.zh: 是的，来中国以后，我越来越喜欢吃辣了。
lines.py: Shì de, lái Zhōngguó yǐhòu, wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuan chī là le.
lines.en: Yes, since coming to China I like spicy food more and more.

lines.zh: 我们以前不太敢吃辣，吃完可能会肚子不舒服，不过现在也慢慢适应了。
lines.py: Wǒmen yǐqián bútàigǎn chī là, chī wán kěnéng huì dùzi bù shūfu, búguò xiànzài yě mànmàn shìyìng le.
lines.en: We didn't really dare eat spicy food before; our stomachs might hurt afterwards. But now we've gradually gotten used to it.

lines.zh: 对，我们现在都不怕辣了。家月，你是“不怕辣”还是“怕不辣”？
lines.py: Duì, wǒmen xiànzài dōu búpà là le. Jiāyuè, nǐ shì “búpà là” háishi “pà búlà”?
lines.en: Right, none of us are afraid of spicy food now. Jiayue, are you "not afraid of spicy" or "afraid of not spicy"?

lines.zh: 中文真有意思，相同的字，顺序一换，意思就变了。
lines.py: Zhōngwén zhēn yǒuyìsi, xiāngtóng de zì, shùnxù yíhuàn, yìsi jiù biàn le.
lines.en: Chinese is so interesting: the same characters, just change the order, and the meaning changes.

lines.zh: 你的中文水平够高的，这都听懂了！你说得对，“不怕辣”是说不怕吃辣的菜，“怕不辣”是担心菜还不够辣呢。
lines.py: Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng gòu gāo de, zhè dōu tīngdǒng le! Nǐ shuōdeduì, “búpà là” shì shuō búpà chī là de cài, “pà búlà” shì dānxīn cài hái búgòu là ne.
lines.en: Your Chinese is really good; you even understood that! You're right: "not afraid of spicy" means you're not afraid to eat spicy food, and "afraid of not spicy" means you worry the food isn't spicy enough.

lines.zh: 我还达不到“怕不辣”的水平，甚至也不能算“不怕辣”，只是喜欢吃辣。
lines.py: Wǒ hái dá bu dào “pà búlà” de shuǐpíng, shènzhì yě bù néng suàn “búpà là”, zhǐshì xǐhuan chī là.
lines.en: I haven't reached the "afraid of not spicy" level; I can't even count as "not afraid of spicy". I just like spicy food.

texts.title: At a restaurant, Bai Jiayue, Chen Tianzhong, Li Wen and Annie have lunch together

lines.zh: 周末，白家月、陈天中、李文和安妮聚在一起吃午餐。白家月想吃辣的，要了辣子鸡；陈天中爱吃甜的，想尝尝松鼠鳜鱼；李文更喜欢吃咸的，选了红烧羊肉和一道凉菜；安妮听说贵州酸汤很有名，点了酸汤米线。他们边吃边聊，非常愉快。
lines.py: Zhōumò, Bái Jiāyuè, Chén Tiānzhōng, Lǐ Wén hé Ānnī jùzàiyìqǐ chī wǔcān. Bái Jiāyuè xiǎng chī là de, yào le Làzǐjī; Chén Tiānzhōng ài chī tián de, xiǎng chángcháng Sōngshǔ Guìyú; Lǐ Wén gèng xǐhuan chī xián de, xuǎn le Hóngshāo Yángròu hé yí dào liángcài; Ānnī tīngshuō Guìzhōu suān tāng hěn yǒumíng, diǎn le Suāntāng Mǐxiàn. Tāmen biān chī biān liáo, fēicháng yúkuài.
lines.en: On the weekend, Bai Jiayue, Chen Tianzhong, Li Wen and Annie got together for lunch. Bai Jiayue wanted something spicy and ordered Spicy Chicken; Chen Tianzhong loves sweet food and wanted to try Squirrel-shaped Mandarin Fish; Li Wen prefers salty food and chose Braised Lamb and a cold dish; Annie had heard Guizhou sour soup is famous and ordered Rice Noodles in Sour Broth. They chatted as they ate and had a great time.

lines.zh: 结账时，李文想请客，但大家觉得还是各付各的更合适。于是，李文付完钱后，大家把钱转给了他，还笑着说下次再一起聚餐。
lines.py: Jiézhàng shí, Lǐ Wén xiǎng qǐngkè, dàn dàjiā juéde háishi gèfù gè de gèng héshì. Yúshì, Lǐ Wén fùwán qián hòu, dàjiā bǎ qián zhuǎngěi le tā, hái xiào zhe shuō xiàcì zài yìqǐ jùcān.
lines.en: When paying the bill, Li Wen wanted to treat everyone, but they all felt it was better for each to pay their own share. So after Li Wen paid, everyone transferred money to him and laughingly said they'd eat together again next time.

texts.title: Seating arrangement at the Chinese dining table

lines.zh: 今天吃饭的时候，大家坐得比较随意。李文告诉白家月，在中国，正式聚餐和普通聚餐不同，正式聚餐时人们比较重视座位的安排，比如可以按照年龄大小来安排，年龄比较大的客人往往会坐在中间或者面对门口的座位。大家坐下时，主人会请客人先坐。如果聚餐时有老人，年轻人要等老人坐下后再坐。
lines.py: Jīntiān chī fàn de shíhou, dàjiā zuò de bǐjiào suíyì. Lǐ Wén gàosu Bái Jiāyuè, zài Zhōngguó, zhèngshì jùcān hé pǔtōng jùcān bù tóng, zhèngshì jùcān shí rénmen bǐjiào zhòngshì zuòwèi de ānpái, bǐrú kěyǐ ànzhào niánlíng dàxiǎo lái ānpái, niánlíng bǐjiào dà de kèrén wǎngwǎng huì zuòzài zhōngjiān huòzhě miànduì ménkǒu de zuòwèi. Dàjiā zuòxià shí, zhǔrén huì qǐng kèrén xiānzuò. Rúguǒ jùcān shíyǒu lǎorén, niánqīngrén yào děng lǎorén zuòxià hòu zài zuò.
lines.en: Today everyone sat rather casually at the meal. Li Wen told Bai Jiayue that in China, formal dinners differ from ordinary ones. At formal dinners people pay attention to the seating arrangement; for example, seats can be arranged by age, and older guests usually sit in the middle or in the seat facing the door. When sitting down, the host invites the guests to sit first. If there are elderly people, young people should wait until the elderly are seated before sitting down.

lines.zh: 白家月听后觉得很有意思，她认为这么做是照顾客人、尊重老人的表现。
lines.py: Bái Jiāyuè tīnghòu juédehěnyǒu yìsi, tā rènwéi zhème zuò shì zhàogù kèrén, zūnzhòng lǎorén de biǎoxiàn.
lines.en: Bai Jiayue found this very interesting; she thinks it shows care for guests and respect for the elderly.

grammar.title: Adverb of scope 至少
grammar.note: 至少 means the time, quantity or degree is not below a certain minimum: "at least".
ex: 家月，你来中国至少两个月了，习惯吃中餐了吗？
Jiāyuè, nǐ lái Zhōngguó zhìshǎo liǎng ge yuè le, xíguàn chī zhōngcān le ma?
Jiayue, you've been in China at least two months. Are you used to Chinese food?
每年至少有两百名留学生来我校学习中文专业。
Měinián zhìshǎo yǒu liǎngbǎimíng liúxuéshēng lái wǒxiào xuéxí Zhōngwén zhuānyè.
At least 200 international students come to our school to major in Chinese every year.
我们虽然没有见过面，但至少在网上聊过很多次，也算比较熟悉了。
Wǒmen suīrán méiyǒu jiànguo miàn, dàn zhìshǎo zài wǎngshàngliáo guo hěn duō cì, yě suàn bǐjiào shúxī le.
Although we've never met, we've at least chatted online many times, so we're fairly familiar.

grammar.title: Adverb/verb 够
grammar.note: 够 has two uses: (1) as an adverb it shows a high degree, often in the pattern 够……的 ("really / quite"); (2) as a verb it means a quantity meets a need or reaches a standard ("be enough").
ex: 你的中文水平够高的，这都听懂了！
Nǐ de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng gòu gāo de, zhè dōu tīngdǒng le!
Your Chinese is really good; you even understood that!
明天请家月和李文来家里吃饭，四个菜够不够？
Míngtiān qǐng Jiāyuè hé Lǐ Wén lái jiālǐ chī fàn, sìge cài gòubugòu?
We're having Jiayue and Li Wen over tomorrow. Are four dishes enough?
我尝了一下，还不够甜，再加一点儿糖吧。
Wǒcháng le yíxià, hái búgòu tián, zài jiā yìdiǎnr táng ba.
I tasted it; it's not sweet enough. Add a bit more sugar.

grammar.title: Fixed pattern 各 × 各的
grammar.note: 各 + verb + 各的 means everyone does the same kind of action independently, without affecting each other: 各付各的 = each pays their own.
ex: 大家觉得还是各付各的更合适。
Dàjiā juéde háishi gèfù gè de gèng héshì.
Everyone felt it was better for each to pay their own.
到了办公室，大家就开始各忙各的了。
Dào le bàngōngshì, dàjiā jiù kāishǐ gèmánggè de le.
Once in the office, everyone got busy with their own work.
在图书馆里，大家都很安静，各看各的书。
Zài túshūguǎn li, dàjiā dōu hěn ānjìng, gèkàn gè de shū.
In the library everyone is quiet, each reading their own book.

grammar.title: Preposition 等
grammar.note: In this lesson 等 is a preposition meaning "till / when", introducing a time or condition: 等 + event + 再/就 + action.
ex: 如果聚餐时有老人，年轻人要等老人坐下后再坐。
Rúguǒ jùcān shíyǒu lǎorén, niánqīngrén yào děng lǎorén zuòxià hòu zài zuò.
If there are elderly people, young people should wait until they are seated before sitting.
等我写完作业，再跟你出去玩。
Děng wǒ xiě wán zuòyè, zài gēn nǐ chūqu wán.
When I finish my homework, I'll go out with you.
等我们到火车站的时候，火车已经开走了。
Děng wǒmen dào huǒchēzhàn de shíhou, huǒchē yǐjīng kāizǒu le.
By the time we got to the train station, the train had already left.

fill.q: 家里没＿＿了，你去超市买一瓶吧。
full: 家里没油了，你去超市买一瓶吧。
Jiālǐ méiyóu le, nǐ qù chāoshì mǎi yìpíng ba.
We're out of oil at home; go buy a bottle at the supermarket.
fill.why: 没 + noun + 了 = have run out of something. 家里没油了 = we're out of oil; then 买一瓶 confirms it's a liquid.

fill.q: 这道菜看起来太辣了，我不＿＿吃。
full: 这道菜看起来太辣了，我不敢吃。
Zhè dàocài kàn qilai tàilà le, wǒ bùgǎn chī.
This dish looks too spicy; I don't dare eat it.
fill.why: 不敢 + verb = don't dare to. 太辣了，我不敢吃.

fill.q: 我＿＿有点儿不舒服，想休息一下。
full: 我肚子有点儿不舒服，想休息一下。
Wǒ dùzi yǒudiǎnr bù shūfu, xiǎng xiūxi yíxià.
My stomach feels a bit off; I want to rest.
fill.why: 肚子不舒服 = stomach feels unwell. A body part is needed before 不舒服.

fill.q: 已经煮了十多分钟了，饺子＿＿了吧？
full: 已经煮了十多分钟了，饺子熟了吧？
Yǐjīng zhǔ le shíduōfēnzhōng le, jiǎozi shóu le ba?
They've been boiling for over ten minutes; the dumplings should be done, right?
fill.why: 饺子熟了 = the dumplings are cooked. 熟 describes food being done after 煮了十多分钟.

fill.q: 这是我＿＿为你准备的礼物，希望你喜欢。
full: 这是我专门为你准备的礼物，希望你喜欢。
Zhè shì wǒ zhuānmén wèi nǐ zhǔnbèi de lǐwù, xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan.
This is a gift I prepared especially for you. I hope you like it.
fill.why: 专门为你准备 = prepared especially for you. 专门 goes before 为 + person.

fill.q: A：请问，这个＿＿有人吗？B：没有人，您坐吧。
full: A：请问，这个座位有人吗？B：没有人，您坐吧。
A: Qǐngwèn, zhège zuòwèi yǒu rén ma? B: Méiyǒu rén, nín zuò ba.
A: Excuse me, is this seat taken? B: No, please sit.
fill.why: 这个座位有人吗？= Is this seat taken? A fixed question in restaurants and trains.

fill.q: A：你尝尝，这道菜是不是做得太＿＿了？B：嗯，是的，我跟服务员说一下。
full: A：你尝尝，这道菜是不是做得太咸了？B：嗯，是的，我跟服务员说一下。
A: Nǐ chángcháng, zhè dàocài shìbushì zuò de tài xián le? B: Ńg, shì de, wǒ gēn fúwùyuán shuō yíxià.
A: Taste this. Isn't it too salty? B: Yes, it is. I'll tell the waiter.
fill.why: 做得太咸了 = made too salty. A taste adjective is needed after 太.

fill.q: A：你们怎么还不吃？一会儿菜都＿＿了。B：我们在等你呢，一起吃更热闹。
full: A：你们怎么还不吃？一会儿菜都凉了。B：我们在等你呢，一起吃更热闹。
A: Nǐmen zěnme hái bùchī? Yíhuìr cài dōu liáng le. B: Wǒmen zài děng nǐ ne, yìqǐ chī gèng rènao.
A: Why aren't you eating? The food will get cold. B: We're waiting for you; it's more fun to eat together.
fill.why: 菜凉了 = the food has gone cold. 一会儿 suggests a change if you wait.

fill.q: A：我发现早上出来跑步的人变多了。B：是啊，因为人们越来越＿＿身体健康了。
full: A：我发现早上出来跑步的人变多了。B：是啊，因为人们越来越重视身体健康了。
A: Wǒ fāxiàn zǎoshàng chulai pǎobù de rén biàn duō le. B: Shì a, yīnwèi rénmen yuè lái yuè zhòngshì shēntǐ jiànkāng le.
A: I've noticed more people running in the morning. B: Yes, because people care more and more about their health.
fill.why: 重视身体健康 = pay attention to health. 越来越 + verb of attitude.

fill.q: A：这是我去超市帮你带的东西。B：谢谢！多少钱？我把钱＿＿给你。
full: A：这是我去超市帮你带的东西。B：谢谢！多少钱？我把钱付给你。
A: Zhè shì wǒ qù chāoshì bāng nǐ dài de dōngxi. B: Xièxie! Duōshao qián? Wǒ bǎ qián fùgěi nǐ.
A: Here's what I picked up for you at the supermarket. B: Thanks! How much? Let me pay you.
fill.why: 把钱付给你 = pay you the money. 付 + 钱 + 给 + person.

q: 白家月来中国多久了？
Bái Jiāyuè lái Zhōngguó duō jiǔ le?
How long has Bai Jiayue been in China?
why: 家月，你来中国至少两个月了，习惯吃中餐了吗？
Jiāyuè, nǐ lái Zhōngguó zhìshǎo liǎng ge yuè le, xíguàn chī zhōngcān le ma?
至少两个月 = at least two months, so it's two months or more. The best match is C 两个多月. A (less than two) contradicts 至少; D (two years) is far too long.

q: 白家月觉得水煮鱼怎么样？
Bái Jiāyuè juéde Shuǐzhǔyú zěnmeyàng?
What does Bai Jiayue think of the boiled fish?
why: 辣是辣，但是非常好吃！
Làshì là, dànshì fēicháng hǎochī!
A是A，但是…… concedes the first point: 'it IS spicy, but delicious'. So she finds it rather spicy (比较辣). It's not 'not tasty' — she says 非常好吃.

q: 关于王一雪一家，可以知道什么？
Guānyú Wáng Yīxuě yìjiā, kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What do we know about Wang Yixue's family?
o: they don't eat spicy food now
they can eat spicy food now
they used to dare eat spicy food
they used to love spicy food
why: 我们以前不太敢吃辣……不过现在也慢慢适应了。……我们现在都不怕辣了。
Wǒmen yǐqián bútàigǎn chī là…… búguò xiànzài yě mànmàn shìyìng le. …… wǒmen xiànzài dōu búpà là le.
They didn't dare eat spicy food before but have adapted; now they're not afraid of it. So B 现在能吃辣. C and D describe the past wrongly.

q: 白家月现在的口味是什么？
Bái Jiāyuè xiànzài de kǒuwèi shì shénme?
What is Bai Jiayue's taste now?
o: is afraid it's not spicy enough
why: 我还达不到“怕不辣”的水平，甚至也不能算“不怕辣”，只是喜欢吃辣。
Wǒ hái dá bu dào “pà búlà” de shuǐpíng, shènzhì yě bù néng suàn “búpà là”, zhǐshì xǐhuan chī là.
She says she is neither 怕不辣 nor even 不怕辣 — she just likes spicy food (只是喜欢吃辣) = 爱吃辣.

q: 陈天中点了什么菜？
Chén Tiānzhōng diǎn le shénme cài?
What did Chen Tianzhong order?
why: 陈天中爱吃甜的，想尝尝松鼠鳜鱼。
Chén Tiānzhōng ài chī tián de, xiǎng chángcháng Sōngshǔ Guìyú.
He loves sweet food and wanted to try Squirrel-shaped Mandarin Fish, which is sweet and sour.

q: 李文喜欢吃什么口味的菜？
Lǐ Wén xǐhuan chī shénme kǒuwèi de cài?
What flavor does Li Wen like?
why: 李文更喜欢吃咸的，选了红烧羊肉和一道凉菜。
Lǐ Wén gèng xǐhuan chī xián de, xuǎn le Hóngshāo Yángròu hé yí dào liángcài.
李文更喜欢吃咸的 = Li Wen prefers salty food.

q: 一般来说，什么人会坐面对门口的座位？
Yìbānláishuō, shénme rénhuì zuò miànduì ménkǒu de zuòwèi?
Generally, who sits in the seat facing the door?
why: 年龄比较大的客人往往会坐在中间或者面对门口的座位。
Niánlíng bǐjiào dà de kèrén wǎngwǎng huì zuòzài zhōngjiān huòzhě miànduì ménkǒu de zuòwèi.
Older guests (年龄比较大的客人) sit in the middle or in the seat facing the door — the seat of honor.

q: 一般来说，正式聚餐时，谁先坐下？
Yìbānláishuō, zhèngshì jùcān shí, shuí xiān zuòxià?
Generally, at a formal dinner, who sits down first?
why: 如果聚餐时有老人，年轻人要等老人坐下后再坐。
Rúguǒ jùcān shíyǒu lǎorén, niánqīngrén yào děng lǎorén zuòxià hòu zài zuò.
Young people wait until the elderly (老人) sit down first. The host invites guests to sit first, but the host himself doesn't sit first.

en: I will go with you to see the doctor

ex: 他感冒了，晚上一直咳嗽。
Tā gǎnmào le, wǎnshang yìzhí késou.
He has a cold and coughs all night.
她咳了几声，然后开始说话。
Tā ké le jǐshēng, ránhòu kāishǐ shuōhuà.
She coughed a few times, then started speaking.
他中文说得这么好，真厉害！
Tā Zhōngwén shuō de zhème hǎo, zhēn lìhai!
He speaks Chinese so well — amazing!
这次的交通问题很严重。
Zhè cì de jiāotōng wèntí hěn yánzhòng.
The traffic problem this time is very serious.
要下雨了，我们赶快回家吧。
Yào xiàyǔ le, wǒmen gǎnkuài huí jiā ba.
It's about to rain; let's hurry home.
周末我陪妈妈去买东西。
Zhōumò wǒ péi māmā qù mǎi dōngxi.
On the weekend I went shopping with my mom.
你能帮我把这句话翻译成中文吗？
Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ zhèjù huà fānyìchéng Zhōngwén ma?
Can you translate this sentence into Chinese for me?
护士给病人量了体温。
Hùshi gěi bìngrén liàng le tǐwēn.
The nurse took the patient's temperature.
请先填一下这张表。
Qǐng xiān tián yíxià zhè zhāngbiǎo.
Please fill in this form first.
这张表上要写姓名、性别和年龄。
Zhè zhāngbiǎoshàng yào xiě xìngmíng, xìngbié hé niánlíng.
This form asks for name, sex and age.
我的国籍是印度尼西亚。
Wǒ de guójí shì Yìndùníxīyà.
My nationality is Indonesian.
她来自一个很大的家庭。
Tā láizì yí ge hěn dà de jiātíng.
She comes from a big family.
请把你的地址发给我，我给你寄快递。
Qǐng bǎ nǐ de dìzhǐ fāgěi wǒ, wǒ gěi nǐ jì kuàidì.
Send me your address and I'll mail you a package.
现在很多医院都可以在网上挂号。
Xiànzài hěn duō yīyuàn dōu kěyǐ zài wǎngshang guàhào.
Many hospitals now let you register online.
这家饭馆太有名了，每天都要排队。
Zhèjiā fànguǎn tài yǒumíng le, měi tiān dōu yào páiduì.
This restaurant is so famous that there's a queue every day.
我在酒店大厅等你。
Wǒ zài jiǔdiàn dàtīng děng nǐ.
I'll wait for you in the hotel lobby.
我很少喝咖啡，只是偶尔喝一杯。
Wǒ hěnshǎo hēkāfēi, zhǐshì ǒu'ěr hēyìbēi.
I rarely drink coffee, just occasionally a cup.
他今天穿了一身黑色的衣服。
Tā jīntiān chuān le yì shēn hēisè de yīfu.
He's dressed all in black today.
他没复习，结果考得不好。
Tā méi fùxí, jiéguǒ kǎode bùhǎo.
He didn't review, and as a result he did badly.
大家都知道学习外语的重要性。
Dàjiā dōu zhīdào xuéxíwàiyǔ de zhòngyàoxìng.
Everyone knows the importance of learning a foreign language.
护士说我的体温是三十八度。
Hùshi shuō wǒ de tǐwēn shì sānshíbā dù.
The nurse said my temperature is 38 degrees.
明天要降温了，多穿点儿衣服。
Míngtiān yào jiàngwēn le, duō chuān diǎnr yīfu.
It's going to get colder tomorrow; wear more clothes.
学中文不能光看书，还要多说。
Xué Zhōngwén bù néng guāng kànshū, háiyào duō shuō.
To learn Chinese you can't just read; you also need to speak a lot.
我小时候特别怕打针。
Wǒ xiǎoshíhou tèbié pà dǎzhēn.
I was really afraid of injections as a kid.
多听多说是学语言很有效的方法。
Duō tīng duō shuō shì xué yǔyán hěn yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ.
Listening and speaking a lot is an effective way to learn a language.
请大家按时交作业。
Qǐng dàjiā ànshí jiāo zuòyè.
Please hand in your homework on time.
跑完步以后，我出了很多汗。
Pǎo wánbù yǐhòu, wǒchū le hěn duō hàn.
After running I sweated a lot.
明天早上六点请叫醒我。
Míngtiān zǎoshàng liùdiǎn qǐng jiàoxǐng wǒ.
Please wake me at six tomorrow morning.
吃了药以后，我感觉好多了。
Chī le yào yǐhòu, wǒ gǎnjué hǎoduō le.
After taking the medicine, I feel much better.
今天的气温很低，出门多穿点儿。
Jīntiān de qìwēn hěn dī, chūmén duō chuān diǎnr.
It's cold today; wear more when you go out.
我头疼得很，特别难受。
Wǒ tóuténg de hěn, tèbié nánshòu.
My head hurts a lot; I feel awful.
我给他打了好几次电话，都打不通。
Wǒ gěi tā dǎ le hǎo jǐcì diànhuà, dōu dǎ bùtōng.
I called him several times but couldn't get through.
在学习的过程中，遇到困难很正常。
Zài xuéxí de guòchéng zhōng, yùdào kùnnan hěn zhèngcháng.
Meeting difficulties in the learning process is normal.
她在公司的市场部工作。
Tā zài gōngsī de shìchǎngbù gōngzuò.
She works in the company's marketing department.
这个停车场每小时收费十块。
Zhège tíngchēchǎng měi xiǎoshí shōufèi shíkuài.
This car park charges ten yuan an hour.
医生问了我最近的身体情况。
Yīshēng wèn le wǒ zuìjìn de shēntǐ qíngkuàng.
The doctor asked about my recent health.
你把电话号码给我，到了以后我好联系你。
Nǐ bǎ diànhuàhàomǎ gěi wǒ, dào le yǐhòu wǒ hǎo liánxì nǐ.
Give me your number so I can contact you when I arrive.
经过一个月的治疗，他的病好了。
Jīngguò yìgeyuè de zhìliáo, tā de bìng hǎo le.
After a month of treatment, he recovered.
学中文要一步一步来，别着急。
Xué Zhōngwén yào yí bù yí bù lái, biézháojí.
Learn Chinese step by step; don't rush.

texts.title: At home, Bai Jiayue was lying in bed, on the phone with Li Wen

lines.zh: 喂，李文，我身体不舒服。
lines.py: Wèi, Lǐ Wén, wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu.
lines.en: Hello, Li Wen, I'm not feeling well.

lines.zh: 你怎么了？听你的声音，好像感冒了。
lines.py: Nǐ zěnme le? Tīng nǐ de shēngyīn, hǎoxiàng gǎnmào le.
lines.en: What's wrong? You sound like you have a cold.

lines.zh: 对，我还发烧，一直咳嗽，咳得很厉害。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ hái fāshāo, yìzhí késou, kéde hěn lìhai.
lines.en: Yes, and I have a fever and keep coughing; it's really bad.

lines.zh: 那挺严重的，最好赶快去医院检查一下。
lines.py: Nà tǐng yánzhòng de, zuìhǎo gǎnkuài qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià.
lines.en: That's pretty serious. You'd better go to the hospital and get checked right away.

lines.zh: 我也这么想，不过我来中国后还没去过医院，不知道怎么在中国的医院看病。
lines.py: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng, búguò wǒlái Zhōngguó hòu hái méi qùguo yīyuàn, bù zhīdào zěnme zài Zhōngguó de yīyuàn kànbìng.
lines.en: I think so too, but I haven't been to a hospital since coming to China, and I don't know how to see a doctor at a Chinese hospital.

lines.zh: 没关系，我陪你一起去，还能帮你翻译。你在家等一下，我现在就去接你。
lines.py: Méi guānxi, wǒ péi nǐ yìqǐ qù, hái néng bāng nǐ fānyì. Nǐ zàijiā děng yíxià, wǒ xiànzài jiù qù jiē nǐ.
lines.en: No problem. I'll go with you and can interpret for you too. Wait at home; I'll come pick you up now.

lines.zh: 太好了！有你陪着，我就放心多了。
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Yǒu nǐ péi zhe, wǒ jiù fàngxīn duō le.
lines.en: Great! With you there, I feel much more at ease.

texts.title: In the hospital lobby, Li Wen helps Bai Jiayue register to see a doctor

lines.zh: 护士，您好，我的这位外国朋友生病了，第一次来这里看病，需要怎么做？
lines.py: Hùshi, nínhǎo, wǒ de zhèwèi wàiguó péngyou shēngbìng le, dìyīcì lái zhèlǐ kànbìng, xūyào zěnme zuò?
lines.en: Hello, nurse. My foreign friend here is sick and it's her first time seeing a doctor here. What do we need to do?

lines.zh: 请在这张表上写上病人的姓名、性别、国籍、年龄、电话号码和家庭地址。
lines.py: Qǐng zài zhè zhāngbiǎoshàng xiě shàng bìngrén de xìngmíng, xìngbié, guójí, niánlíng, diànhuàhàomǎ hé jiātíng dìzhǐ.
lines.en: Please write the patient's name, sex, nationality, age, phone number and home address on this form.

lines.zh: 我写好了，您看看，这样可以吗？
lines.py: Wǒ xiě hǎo le, nín kànkàn, zhèyàng kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: I've filled it in. Could you take a look? Is this OK?

lines.zh: 没问题，您拿着病人的护照去挂号吧。
lines.py: Méi wèntí, nín ná zhe bìngrén de hùzhào qù guàhào ba.
lines.en: That's fine. Take the patient's passport and go register.

lines.zh: 家月，我去排队挂号，你先在大厅休息，别着急。
lines.py: Jiāyuè, wǒ qù páiduì guàhào, nǐ xiān zài dàtīng xiūxi, biézháojí.
lines.en: Jiayue, I'll go line up to register. Rest in the lobby first, don't worry.

lines.zh: 好的，真是太谢谢你了！
lines.py: Hǎo de, zhēnshìtài xièxie nǐ le!
lines.en: OK, thank you so much!

lines.zh: 你跟我有什么好客气的。
lines.py: Nǐ gēn wǒ yǒu shénme hǎo kèqi de.
lines.en: No need to be so polite with me.

texts.title: A visit to the doctor

lines.zh: 下午白家月去看病了，她告诉医生，自己平时身体不错，偶尔才会生一次病。这次她病得很厉害，头也一直疼，身上一点儿力气都没有。医生给她做了检查，检查结果出来后，发现她得了比较严重的流行性感冒。
lines.py: Xiàwǔ Bái Jiāyuè qù kànbìng le, tā gàosu yīshēng, zìjǐ píngshí shēntǐ búcuò, ǒu'ěr cái huìshēng yí cì bìng. Zhè cì tā bìng de hěn lìhai, tóu yě yìzhí téng, shēnshàng yìdiǎnr lìqi dōu méiyǒu. Yīshēng gěi tā zuò le jiǎnchá, jiǎnchá jiéguǒ chulai hòu, fāxiàn tā dé le bǐjiào yánzhòng de liúxíngxìng gǎnmào.
lines.en: In the afternoon Bai Jiayue went to the doctor. She told the doctor she's usually healthy and only gets sick once in a while. This time she was very sick, had a constant headache and no strength at all. The doctor examined her, and when the results came out, they found she had a fairly serious flu.

lines.zh: 医生告诉她，现在需要把体温降下来，光吃药恐怕不够，打针会更有效。医生还让她回家以后按时吃药，多喝水，多休息。
lines.py: Yīshēng gàosu tā, xiànzài xūyào bǎ tǐwēn jiàng xialai, guāng chīyào kǒngpà búgòu, dǎzhēn huì gèng yǒuxiào. Yīshēng hái ràng tā huí jiā yǐhòu ànshí chīyào, duōhēshuǐ, duō xiūxi.
lines.en: The doctor told her they needed to bring her temperature down; medicine alone probably wasn't enough, and an injection would be more effective. The doctor also told her to take her medicine on time at home, drink lots of water and rest a lot.

lines.zh: 晚上，白家月睡觉时出了一身汗。第二天醒来时，她感觉头不那么疼了，体温也低了一些，身体不那么难受了。
lines.py: Wǎnshang, Bái Jiāyuè shuìjiào shí chū le yì shēn hàn. Dì'èrtiān xǐngláishí, tā gǎnjué tóu bú nàme téng le, tǐwēn yě dī le yìxiē, shēntǐ bú nàme nánshòu le.
lines.en: At night, Bai Jiayue sweated all over while sleeping. When she woke up the next day, her headache was better, her temperature was a bit lower, and she didn't feel so bad.

texts.title: How to see a doctor in China

lines.zh: 外国人第一次在中国看病，可能会担心语言不通，或者觉得看病的过程和自己的国家不同。其实，这些问题都有办法解决。
lines.py: Wàiguórén dìyīcì zài Zhōngguó kànbìng, kěnéng huì dānxīn yǔyánbùtōng, huòzhě juéde kànbìng de guòchéng hé zìjǐ de guójiā bù tóng. Qíshí, zhèxiē wèntí dōu yǒu bànfǎ jiějué.
lines.en: When foreigners see a doctor in China for the first time, they may worry about the language barrier or find the process different from their own country. Actually, there are ways to solve these problems.

lines.zh: 有的医院有国际部，那里的医生一般会说英文，交流比较方便，但是国际部的收费比较高。如果没有特别需要，可以选择普通部，用简单的中文和医生交流。
lines.py: Yǒu de yīyuàn yǒu guójìbù, nàlǐ de yīshēng yìbān huì shuō Yīngwén, jiāoliú bǐjiào fāngbiàn, dànshì guójìbù de shōufèi bǐjiào gāo. Rúguǒ méiyǒu tèbié xūyào, kěyǐ xuǎnzé pǔtōng bù, yòng jiǎndān de Zhōngwén hé yīshēng jiāoliú.
lines.en: Some hospitals have an international department where doctors usually speak English, so communication is easier, but it charges more. If you have no special need, you can choose the general department and talk to the doctor in simple Chinese.

lines.zh: 在中国看病要先挂号，然后再去找医生。医生会问病人的情况，有时还会做一些检查，好给出合适的治疗方法。只要按照医生说的一步一步来，一般都可以顺利得到治疗。
lines.py: Zài Zhōngguó kànbìng yào xiān guàhào, ránhòu zài qù zhǎo yīshēng. Yīshēng huì wèn bìngrén de qíngkuàng, yǒushí háihuì zuò yìxiē jiǎnchá, hǎo gěichū héshì de zhìliáo fāngfǎ. Zhǐyào ànzhào yīshēng shuō de yí bù yí bù lái, yìbān dōu kěyǐ shùnlì dédào zhìliáo.
lines.en: In China you first register and then see the doctor. The doctor asks about your condition and sometimes runs tests in order to give a suitable treatment. As long as you follow the doctor's instructions step by step, you can usually get treated smoothly.

grammar.title: Adjective 厉害
grammar.note: 厉害 can follow a verb or adjective to show a very high degree: Verb + 得 + (adverb) + 厉害, or Adjective + 得 + 厉害.
ex: 我还发烧，一直咳嗽，咳得很厉害。
Wǒ hái fāshāo, yìzhí késou, kéde hěn lìhai.
I also have a fever and keep coughing; it's really bad.
我昨天跑步跑多了，今天腿疼得厉害。
Wǒ zuótiān pǎobù pǎo duō le, jīntiān tuǐténg de lìhai.
I ran too much yesterday; my legs hurt terribly today.
这道菜辣得厉害，我吃了一口就不敢再吃了。
Zhè dàocài làde lìhai, wǒ chī le yì kǒu jiù bùgǎn zài chī le.
This dish is extremely spicy; after one bite I didn't dare eat more.

grammar.title: Fixed pattern (没)有什么(好)×的
grammar.note: (没)有什么(好) + verb/adjective + 的 means there's no need to do something, or no reason to feel a certain way: 有什么好客气的 = no need to be polite.
ex: 你跟我有什么好客气的。
Nǐ gēn wǒ yǒu shénme hǎo kèqi de.
There's no need to be polite with me.
这种事在网上有很多，没有什么奇怪的。
Zhèzhǒng shì zài wǎngshang yǒu hěn duō, méiyǒu shénme qíguài de.
There are lots of things like this online; there's nothing strange about it.
我觉得这家商场里的东西都很一般，没有什么好买的。
Wǒ juéde zhèjiā shāngchǎng li de dōngxi dōu hěn yìbān, méiyǒu shénme hǎo mǎi de.
I think everything in this mall is ordinary; there's nothing worth buying.

grammar.title: Adverb of frequency 偶尔
grammar.note: 偶尔 means an action or situation happens only once in a while: "occasionally". It is often used with 才 or contrasted with 经常/一般.
ex: 她告诉医生，自己平时身体不错，偶尔才会生一次病。
Tā gàosu yīshēng, zìjǐ píngshí shēntǐ búcuò, ǒu'ěr cái huìshēng yí cì bìng.
She told the doctor she's usually healthy and only gets sick once in a while.
他经常在家看电影，偶尔才去电影院看。
Tā jīngcháng zàijiā kàn diànyǐng, ǒu'ěr cái qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn.
He usually watches movies at home and only occasionally goes to the cinema.
我一般都在学校食堂吃饭，偶尔会跟朋友一起出去吃。
Wǒ yìbān dōu zài xuéxiàoshítáng chī fàn, ǒu'ěr huì gēn péngyou yìqǐ chūqu chī.
I usually eat in the school cafeteria and occasionally go out with friends.

grammar.title: Purpose clause ……，好……
grammar.note: The first clause states an action or situation; the second clause, introduced by 好, states its purpose: "so that / in order to".
ex: 医生有时还会做一些检查，好给出合适的治疗方法。
Yīshēng yǒushí háihuì zuò yìxiē jiǎnchá, hǎo gěichū héshì de zhìliáo fāngfǎ.
Doctors sometimes run tests in order to give a suitable treatment.
你们先了解一下情况，好做出决定。
Nǐmen xiān liǎojiě yíxià qíngkuàng, hǎo zuòchū juédìng.
Learn about the situation first so you can make a decision.
我把电话号码告诉你，以后有什么事好联系我。
Wǒ bǎ diànhuàhàomǎ gàosu nǐ, yǐhòu yǒu shénme shìhǎo liánxì wǒ.
I'll give you my phone number so you can contact me if anything comes up.

fill.q: 咱们过去问问＿＿，看牙应该去几楼。
full: 咱们过去问问护士，看牙应该去几楼。
Zánmen guòqù wènwèn hùshi, kànyá yīnggāi qù jǐlóu.
Let's go ask the nurse which floor the dentist is on.
fill.why: 问问护士 = ask the nurse. The context is a hospital (看牙 = see the dentist), so a hospital staff noun is needed.

fill.q: 我这两天有点儿＿＿，不知道是不是感冒了。
full: 我这两天有点儿咳嗽，不知道是不是感冒了。
Wǒ zhè liǎngtiān yǒudiǎnr késou, bù zhīdào shìbushì gǎnmào le.
I've been coughing a bit these past two days; I wonder if I've caught a cold.
fill.why: 有点儿 + verb/adjective: 有点儿咳嗽 = have a slight cough, and the speaker wonders if it's a cold.

fill.q: 把你的＿＿给我吧，我给你寄点儿东西。
full: 把你的地址给我吧，我给你寄点儿东西。
Bǎ nǐ de dìzhǐ gěi wǒ ba, wǒ gěi nǐ jì diǎnr dōngxi.
Give me your address; I'll mail you something.
fill.why: 给我地址 so I can mail (寄) you something — you need an address.

fill.q: 这个问题很＿＿，我们必须马上想办法解决。
full: 这个问题很严重，我们必须马上想办法解决。
Zhège wèntí hěn yánzhòng, wǒmen bìxū mǎshàng xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué.
This problem is very serious; we must find a way to solve it right away.
fill.why: 很严重 = very serious; 必须马上想办法解决 confirms a serious problem.

fill.q: 你都发烧好几天了，＿＿去医院检查一下吧。
full: 你都发烧好几天了，赶快去医院检查一下吧。
Nǐ dōu fāshāo hǎo jǐtiān le, gǎnkuài qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià ba.
You've had a fever for days; go get checked at the hospital right away.
fill.why: 赶快 + verb = do it quickly. After days of fever, you should go to the hospital 赶快.

fill.q: A：这道菜是怎么做的？B：下次我把做菜的＿＿拍下来发给你。
full: A：这道菜是怎么做的？B：下次我把做菜的过程拍下来发给你。
A: Zhè dàocài shì zěnme zuò de? B: Xiàcì wǒ bǎ zuòcài de guòchéng pāi xialai fāgěinǐ.
A: How is this dish made? B: Next time I'll film the cooking process and send it to you.
fill.why: 做菜的过程 = the cooking process. 拍下来 = film it, so B will record the process.

fill.q: A：你今天怎么这么饿？B：白天太忙了，＿＿喝了点儿水，一口饭都没吃。
full: A：你今天怎么这么饿？B：白天太忙了，光喝了点儿水，一口饭都没吃。
A: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme zhème è? B: Báitiān tàimáng le, guānghē le diǎnr shuǐ, yì kǒu fàn dōu méi chī.
A: Why are you so hungry today? B: I was so busy I only drank some water and didn't eat a bite.
fill.why: 光 + verb = only. 光喝了点儿水 = only drank some water, no food at all.

fill.q: A：经理叫你过去，要了解一下最近的工作＿＿。B：好的，我现在就去他的办公室。
full: A：经理叫你过去，要了解一下最近的工作情况。B：好的，我现在就去他的办公室。
A: Jīnglǐ jiào nǐ guòqù, yào liǎojiě yíxià zuìjìn de gōngzuò qíngkuàng. B: Hǎo de, wǒ xiànzài jiù qù tā de bàngōngshì.
A: The manager wants to see you about how work has been going lately. B: OK, I'll go to his office now.
fill.why: 工作情况 = how work is going. 了解 + 情况 is a very common pair.

fill.q: A：我早上给你打电话，你怎么没接啊？B：昨天睡得太晚了，今天10点才＿＿。
full: A：我早上给你打电话，你怎么没接啊？B：昨天睡得太晚了，今天10点才醒。
A: Wǒ zǎoshàng gěi nǐ dǎdiànhuà, nǐ zěnme méijiē a? B: Zuótiān shuìde tàiwǎn le, jīntiān shí diǎn cái xǐng.
A: I called you this morning; why didn't you answer? B: I went to bed too late yesterday and only woke up at 10 today.
fill.why: 10点才醒 = didn't wake up until 10. 醒 = wake up; 才 shows lateness.

fill.q: A：你觉得看电影学中文怎么样？B：我觉得这种方法很＿＿，不但能学语言，还能了解中国文化。
full: A：你觉得看电影学中文怎么样？B：我觉得这种方法很有效，不但能学语言，还能了解中国文化。
A: Nǐ juéde kàn diànyǐngxué Zhōngwén zěnmeyàng? B: Wǒ juéde zhèzhǒng fāngfǎ hěn yǒuxiào, búdàn néngxué yǔyán, hái néng liǎojiě Zhōngguó wénhuà.
A: What do you think of learning Chinese through movies? B: I think it's very effective: you learn the language and also learn about Chinese culture.
fill.why: 很有效 = very effective. B then explains why the method works.

q: 李文让白家月做什么？
Lǐ Wén ràng Bái Jiāyuè zuò shénme?
What does Li Wen tell Bai Jiayue to do?
o: go to the hospital with him
why: 那挺严重的，最好赶快去医院检查一下。
Nà tǐng yánzhòng de, zuìhǎo gǎnkuài qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá yíxià.
最好赶快去医院检查一下 = you'd better get checked at the hospital right away. Li Wen offers to interpret, but that's for her, not something she does for him.

q: 白家月担心什么？
Bái Jiāyuè dānxīn shénme?
What is Bai Jiayue worried about?
o: not knowing which medicine to take
not knowing how to see a doctor
not knowing which hospital is good
Shēntǐ yuè lái yuè bù shūfu
why: 不知道怎么在中国的医院看病。
Bù zhīdào zěnme zài Zhōngguó de yīyuàn kànbìng.
She has never been to a hospital in China and doesn't know how to see a doctor there — B 不知道怎么看病.

q: 护士让李文做什么？
Hùshi ràng Lǐ Wén zuò shénme?
What does the nurse ask Li Wen to do?
o: line up and wait for the doctor
Zài biǎoshàng xiě bìngrén de xìnxī
write the patient's information on the form
why: 请在这张表上写上病人的姓名、性别、国籍、年龄、电话号码和家庭地址。
Qǐng zài zhè zhāngbiǎoshàng xiě shàng bìngrén de xìngmíng, xìngbié, guójí, niánlíng, diànhuàhàomǎ hé jiātíng dìzhǐ.
The nurse asks him to fill in the patient's information on the form (在表上写病人的信息). He then takes the passport to register; he doesn't hand it to the nurse.

q: 李文要去做什么？
Lǐ Wén yào qù zuò shénme?
What is Li Wen going to do?
why: 家月，我去排队挂号。
Jiāyuè, wǒ qù páiduì guàhào.
我去排队挂号 = I'll line up to register. 挂号 is registering at a hospital.

q: 白家月告诉医生什么了？
Bái Jiāyuè gàosu yīshēng shénme le?
What did Bai Jiayue tell the doctor?
why: 这次她病得很厉害，头也一直疼，身上一点儿力气都没有。
Zhè cì tā bìng de hěn lìhai, tóu yě yìzhí téng, shēnshàng yìdiǎnr lìqi dōu méiyǒu.
She told the doctor her head kept hurting (头也一直疼). She sweated later, at night; nothing says she took medicine before or had a low temperature.

q: 第二天，白家月怎么样了？
Dì'èrtiān, Bái Jiāyuè zěnmeyàng le?
How was Bai Jiayue the next day?
why: 她感觉头不那么疼了，体温也低了一些，身体不那么难受了。
Tā gǎnjué tóu bú nàme téng le, tǐwēn yě dī le yìxiē, shēntǐ bú nàme nánshòu le.
The next morning she felt less uncomfortable (不那么难受了). Her headache and temperature went DOWN, so A, B and C are all opposites.

q: 关于国际部里的医生，下列哪项正确？
Guānyú guójìbù li de yīshēng, xiàliè nǎxiàng zhèngquè?
Which is true about the doctors in the international department?
why: 有的医院有国际部，那里的医生一般会说英文。
Yǒu de yīyuàn yǒu guójìbù, nàlǐ de yīshēng yìbān huì shuō Yīngwén.
Doctors in the international department usually speak English (一般会说英文). The text says nothing about them being foreign, older or more professional.

q: 根据课文，在中国看病，怎么做能顺利得到治疗？
Gēnjù kèwén, zài Zhōngguó kànbìng, zěnme zuònéng shùnlì dédào zhìliáo?
According to the text, how can you get treated smoothly in China?
why: 只要按照医生说的一步一步来，一般都可以顺利得到治疗。
Zhǐyào ànzhào yīshēng shuō de yí bù yí bù lái, yìbān dōu kěyǐ shùnlì dédào zhìliáo.
只要……就/都…… = as long as …: following the doctor step by step is the condition for smooth treatment.

If you have any ideas, tell me directly.

Thanks for your help — it came just in time!

你对这个问题有什么看法？

考试那天，请大家提前十分钟到教室。
Kǎoshì nàtiān, qǐng dàjiā tíqián shífēnzhōng dào jiàoshì.
On exam day, please arrive ten minutes early.

Bǎ shēngcí xiě zài kǎpiàn shàng, biànyú fùxí.
Write new words on cards to make review easier.

ex: 他存了一笔钱，打算去旅游。
Tācún le yì bǐ qián, dǎsuàn qù lǚyóu.
He saved some money and plans to travel.
这家小饭馆的生意特别好。
Zhèjiā xiǎo fànguǎn de shēngyi tèbié hǎo.
This little restaurant's business is booming.
刚来中国的时候，我遇到了很多困难。
Gāng lái Zhōngguó de shíhou, wǒ yùdào le hěn duō kùnnan.
When I first came to China, I faced many difficulties.
他最大的优点是做事认真。
Tā zuìdà de yōudiǎn shì zuòshì rènzhēn.
His greatest strength is that he works conscientiously.
每个人都有优点，也有缺点。
Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yōudiǎn, yě yǒu quēdiǎn.
Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.
我们要根据实际情况做决定。
Wǒmen yào gēnjù shíjì qíngkuàng zuò juédìng.
We should decide based on the actual situation.
这种药的效果很好，吃了两天就不咳嗽了。
Zhèzhǒng yào de xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo, chī le liǎngtiān jiù bù késou le.
This medicine works well; after two days the cough stopped.
这节课的重点是“既然……就……”。
Zhèjié kè de zhòngdiǎn shì “jìrán…… jiù……”.
The key point of this class is 既然……就…….
听了老师的解释，我一下就懂了。
Tīng le lǎoshī de jiěshì, wǒ yíxià jiù dǒng le.
After the teacher's explanation, I understood right away.
她毕业以后找到了一份很好的工作。

Jìnrù dàxué yǐhòu, wǒ kāishǐ yí ge rén shēnghuó.
After entering university, I began living on my own.
