texts.title: In Wang Yixue's office, a colleague was reporting to her

lines.zh: 经理，打扰您一下。市场调查的计划书我昨天发到您邮箱了。在内容方面，您觉得有需要改的吗？
lines.py: Jīnglǐ, dǎrǎo nín yíxià. Shìchǎng diàochá de jìhuàshū wǒ zuótiān fādào nín yóuxiāng le. Zài nèiróng fāngmiàn, nín juéde yǒu xūyào gǎi de ma?
lines.en: Manager, sorry to bother you. I sent the market survey plan to your email yesterday. Is there anything in the content you think needs changing?

lines.zh: 我看过了，写得不错，就是调查的地点只有超市，不太够。
lines.py: Wǒ kànguo le, xiěde búcuò, jiùshì diàochá de dìdiǎn zhǐyǒu chāoshì, bútàigòu.
lines.en: I've read it; it's well written. It's just that the survey only covers supermarkets, which isn't quite enough.

lines.zh: 好的，那我再加一些网店。
lines.py: Hǎo de, nà wǒ zàijiā yìxiē wǎngdiàn.
lines.en: OK, then I'll add some online shops.

lines.zh: 行。做调查的时候要细心，注意了解客户真正的想法。
lines.py: Xíng. Zuò diàochá de shíhou yào xìxīn, zhùyì liǎojiě kèhù zhēnzhèng de xiǎngfǎ.
lines.en: Fine. Be careful when doing the survey, and pay attention to what customers really think.

lines.zh: 明白了，我会认真准备，按时完成任务。
lines.py: Míngbái le, wǒhuì rènzhēn zhǔnbèi, ànshí wánchéng rènwu.
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare carefully and finish the task on time.

lines.zh: 嗯，如果遇到什么问题，及时跟我联系。
lines.py: Ńg, rúguǒ yùdào shénme wèntí, jíshí gēn wǒ liánxì.
lines.en: Mm, if you run into any problems, contact me right away.

texts.title: At the company, a colleague asks Yang Tongle for advice

lines.zh: 杨哥，经理让我下周去上海出差，做市场调查，你有这方面的经验吗？
lines.py: Yáng gē, jīnglǐ ràng wǒ xiàzhōu qù Shànghǎi chūchāi, zuò shìchǎng diàochá, nǐ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de jīngyàn ma?
lines.en: Brother Yang, the manager wants me to go to Shanghai on a business trip next week to do market research. Do you have experience with this?

lines.zh: 你要去几天？主要调查什么内容？
lines.py: Nǐ yào qù jǐtiān? Zhǔyào diàochá shénme nèiróng?
lines.en: How many days will you be there? What are you mainly researching?

lines.zh: 去四天，打算采访一些客户，了解他们对新产品的看法。
lines.py: Qù sìtiān, dǎsuàn cǎifǎng yìxiē kèhù, liǎojiě tāmen duì xīn chǎnpǐn de kànfǎ.
lines.en: Four days. I plan to interview some customers to find out their opinions on the new product.

lines.zh: 那你要提前准备好问题，便于和客户交流。
lines.py: Nà nǐ yào tíqiánzhǔnbèi hǎo wèntí, biànyú hé kèhù jiāoliú.
lines.en: Then prepare your questions in advance so it's easier to talk with customers.

lines.zh: 好的，我已经准备了一些问题。
lines.py: Hǎo de, wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi le yìxiē wèntí.
lines.en: OK, I've already prepared some questions.

lines.zh: 很好。既然出差时间不长，就要安排好时间，多获得有用的信息。
lines.py: Hěn hǎo. Jìrán chūchāi shíjiān bù cháng, jiùyào ānpái hǎo shíjiān, duō huòdé yǒuyòng de xìnxī.
lines.en: Good. Since the trip isn't long, you should plan your time well and get as much useful information as possible.

texts.title: Different clients, different approaches

lines.zh: 前段时间，杨同乐的同事谈成了一笔不错的生意。刚开始，这位同事也遇到了一些困难。拿和客户交流来说，虽然她能把产品的优缺点说得很清楚，但实际效果并不理想。杨同乐告诉她，这是因为她介绍的方式都一样。其实，不同年龄、不同性别的客户对产品的关注点是不一样的。
lines.py: Qiánduànshíjiān, Yáng Tónglè de tóngshì tánchéng le yì bǐ búcuò de shēngyi. Gāng kāishǐ, zhèwèi tóngshì yě yùdào le yìxiē kùnnan. Ná hé kèhù jiāoliú lái shuō, suīrán tā néng bǎ chǎnpǐn de yōuquēdiǎn shuō de hěn qīngchu, dàn shíjìxiàoguǒ bìng bù lǐxiǎng. Yáng Tónglè gàosu tā, zhè shì yīnwèi tā jièshào de fāngshì dōu yíyàng. Qíshí, bù tóng niánlíng, bù tóng xìngbié de kèhù duì chǎnpǐn de guānzhùdiǎn shì bù yíyàng de.
lines.en: A while ago, Yang Tongle's colleague closed a good deal. At first she also ran into some difficulties. Take communicating with customers, for example: although she could explain the product's pros and cons clearly, the actual results weren't ideal. Yang Tongle told her this was because she introduced it the same way every time. In fact, customers of different ages and genders care about different things in a product.

lines.zh: 于是，这位同事又认真地进行了几次市场调查，了解不同客户的想法。后来她在面对不同客户时，能根据他们的情况介绍产品，效果一下就好了很多。
lines.py: Yúshì, zhèwèi tóngshì yòu rènzhēn de jìnxíng le jǐcì shìchǎng diàochá, liǎojiě bù tóng kèhù de xiǎngfǎ. Hòulái tā zài miànduì bù tóng kèhù shí, néng gēnjù tāmen de qíngkuàng jièshào chǎnpǐn, xiàoguǒ yíxià jiù hǎo le hěn duō.
lines.en: So she carefully did several more rounds of market research to understand what different customers think. Later, when facing different customers, she could introduce the product according to their situation, and the results improved a lot at once.

texts.title: Career choice and development

lines.zh: 有的年轻人经常换工作，总觉得下一份工作会更好。但是，适应新工作往往需要比较长的时间。如果总是换工作，不但很难积累经验，还可能会使自己的发展受到影响。
lines.py: Yǒu de niánqīngrén jīngcháng huàn gōngzuò, zǒng juéde xià yí fèn gōngzuò huì gènghǎo. Dànshì, shìyìng xīn gōngzuò wǎngwǎng xūyào bǐjiào cháng de shíjiān. Rúguǒ zǒngshì huàn gōngzuò, búdàn hěnnán jīlěi jīngyàn, hái kěnéng huì shǐ zìjǐ de fāzhǎn shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
lines.en: Some young people change jobs often, always thinking the next job will be better. But adapting to a new job usually takes quite a long time. If you keep changing jobs, it's hard to build experience, and it may also hurt your development.

lines.zh: 我认为，年轻人刚进入社会时，不能只关心工资的高低，更要重视学习。比如，学习课本中没有的专业知识，了解公司的管理方式，学会和同事有效交流，等等。只有把这些基础打好，提高工作能力，今后才会有更好的发展机会。
lines.py: Wǒ rènwéi, niánqīngrén gāng jìnrù shèhuì shí, bù néng zhǐ guānxīn gōngzī de gāodī, gèngyào zhòngshì xuéxí. Bǐrú, xuéxí kèběn zhōng méiyǒu de zhuānyè zhīshi, liǎojiě gōngsī de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, xuéhuì hé tóngshì yǒuxiào jiāoliú, děngděng. Zhǐyǒu bǎ zhèxiē jīchǔ dǎ hǎo, tígāo gōngzuò nénglì, jīnhòu cái huì yǒu gènghǎo de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
lines.en: I think when young people first enter society, they shouldn't only care about salary; they should value learning more, for example learning professional knowledge not found in textbooks, understanding how the company is managed, and learning to communicate effectively with colleagues. Only by building this foundation and improving their abilities will they have better opportunities in the future.

grammar.title: Fixed pattern 在……方面
grammar.note: 在……方面 limits the scope or area being discussed: "in terms of / when it comes to …".
ex: 在内容方面，您觉得有需要改的吗？
Zài nèiróng fāngmiàn, nín juéde yǒu xūyào gǎi de ma?
In terms of content, is there anything you think needs changing?
在时间安排方面，你可以再想一想。
Zài shíjiān ānpái fāngmiàn, nǐ kěyǐ zài xiǎngyìxiǎng.
As for the schedule, you can think it over again.
他才来中国两个月，在生活方面，还不太习惯。
Tā cái lái Zhōngguó liǎng ge yuè, zài shēnghuó fāngmiàn, hái bú tài xíguàn.
He's only been in China two months and isn't used to daily life yet.

grammar.title: Causal sentence 既然……，就……
grammar.note: The first clause states a premise (a known fact); the second clause gives the conclusion drawn from it: "since …, then …".
ex: 既然出差时间不长，就要安排好时间，多获得有用的信息。
Jìrán chūchāi shíjiān bù cháng, jiùyào ānpái hǎo shíjiān, duō huòdé yǒuyòng de xìnxī.
Since the trip isn't long, plan your time well and get more useful information.
既然大家都同意，我们就这么做吧。
Jìrán dàjiā dōu tóngyì, wǒmen jiù zhème zuò ba.
Since everyone agrees, let's do it this way.
既然你们已经决定了，就不要再改了。
Jìrán nǐmen yǐjīng juédìng le, jiù búyào zài gǎi le.
Since you've already decided, don't change it again.

grammar.title: Fixed pattern 拿……来说
grammar.note: 拿……来说 introduces a specific aspect or example: "take … for example".
ex: 拿和客户交流来说，虽然她能把产品的优缺点说得很清楚，但实际效果并不理想。
Ná hé kèhù jiāoliú lái shuō, suīrán tā néng bǎ chǎnpǐn de yōuquēdiǎn shuō de hěn qīngchu, dàn shíjìxiàoguǒ bìng bù lǐxiǎng.
Take talking with customers: although she could explain the pros and cons clearly, the actual results weren't ideal.
现在的生活很方便。拿购物来说，人们不出门就能买到想要的东西。
Xiànzài de shēnghuó hěn fāngbiàn. Ná gòuwù lái shuō, rénmen bù chūmén jiù néng mǎi dào xiǎngyào de dōngxi.
Life is very convenient now. Take shopping: people can buy what they want without leaving home.
在中国，南北方的生活习惯不同。拿吃饭来说，一般南方人更爱吃米饭。
Zài Zhōngguó, nánběifāng de shēnghuóxíguàn bù tóng. Ná chī fàn lái shuō, yìbān nánfāngrén gèng ài chī mǐfàn.
In China, northern and southern habits differ. Take eating: southerners generally prefer rice.

grammar.title: Pivotal sentence: Subject + 使 + Object + Verb phrase
grammar.note: Subject + 使 + object + verb phrase shows that a situation or reason causes a person or thing to change or produce a result: "make / cause someone to …".
ex: 如果总是换工作，可能会使自己的发展受到影响。
Rúguǒ zǒngshì huàn gōngzuò, kěnéng huì shǐ zìjǐ de fāzhǎn shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
Changing jobs all the time may hurt your own development.
这个新方法使工作变得更加简单了。
Zhège xīn fāngfǎ shǐ gōngzuò biànde gèngjiā jiǎndān le.
This new method makes the work simpler.
参加这些交流活动使留学生更快适应了大学生活。
Cānjiā zhèxiē jiāoliú huódòng shǐ liúxuéshēng gèng kuài shìyìng le dàxué shēnghuó.
Taking part in these exchange activities helped international students adapt to university life faster.

fill.q: 发现问题以后，我们要＿＿解决。
full: 发现问题以后，我们要及时解决。
Fāxiàn wèntí yǐhòu, wǒmen yào jíshí jiějué.
Once we find a problem, we must solve it promptly.
fill.why: 及时解决 = solve promptly. 发现问题以后 shows it should be done right away.

fill.q: 不好意思，这么晚还来＿＿您休息。
full: 不好意思，这么晚还来打扰您休息。
Bù hǎoyìsi, zhème wǎn hái lái dǎrǎo nín xiūxi.
Sorry to disturb your rest so late.
fill.why: 打扰您休息 = disturb your rest. 这么晚 shows the apology is for bothering someone.

fill.q: 我刚才把家庭地址写错了，可以＿＿一下吗？
full: 我刚才把家庭地址写错了，可以改一下吗？
Wǒ gāngcái bǎ jiātíng dìzhǐ xiěcuò le, kěyǐ gǎi yíxià ma?
I just wrote my home address wrong. Can I correct it?
fill.why: 写错了 → 可以改一下吗? 改 = correct/change what was written wrong.

fill.q: 他和同事交流了一下，了解了大家的＿＿。
full: 他和同事交流了一下，了解了大家的想法。
Tā hé tóngshì jiāoliú le yíxià, liǎojiě le dàjiā de xiǎngfǎ.
He talked with his colleagues and learned what everyone thought.
fill.why: 了解了大家的想法 = learned everyone's ideas. 交流了一下 leads to knowing what others think.

fill.q: 老师把学习材料放到了网上，＿＿学生们复习。
full: 老师把学习材料放到了网上，便于学生们复习。
Lǎoshī bǎ xuéxícáiliào fàngdào le wǎngshang, biànyú xuéshēng men fùxí.
The teacher put the study materials online to make review easier for students.
fill.why: 便于 + verb = make it easier to. 便于学生们复习 = so students can review easily.

fill.q: A：听说你最近一直坚持跑步。B：是的，我觉得＿＿很好，身体比以前好多了。
full: A：听说你最近一直坚持跑步。B：是的，我觉得效果很好，身体比以前好多了。
A: Tīngshuō nǐ zuìjìn yìzhí jiānchí pǎobù. B: Shì de, wǒ juéde xiàoguǒ hěn hǎo, shēntǐ bǐ yǐqián hǎoduō le.
A: I heard you've been running regularly. B: Yes, it works really well; I'm much healthier than before.
fill.why: 效果很好 = it works well. B's health improved, which is the effect of running.

fill.q: A：经理为什么让小王去做市场调查？B：经理说他的＿＿是很会和别人交流。
full: A：经理为什么让小王去做市场调查？B：经理说他的优点是很会和别人交流。
A: Jīnglǐ wèishénme ràng Xiǎo Wáng qù zuò shìchǎng diàochá? B: Jīnglǐ shuō tā de yōudiǎn shì hěnhuì hé biérén jiāoliú.
A: Why did the manager send Xiao Wang to do the market survey? B: The manager said his strength is communicating with people.
fill.why: 他的优点是…… = his strength is …. Being good at communication is a strength.

fill.q: A：我想学好中文，有什么建议吗？B：刚开始的时候别太着急，先把＿＿打好。
full: A：我想学好中文，有什么建议吗？B：刚开始的时候别太着急，先把基础打好。
A: Wǒ xiǎng xuéhǎo Zhōngwén, yǒu shénme jiànyì ma? B: Gāng kāishǐ de shíhou biétài zháojí, xiān bǎ jīchǔ dǎ hǎo.
A: I want to learn Chinese well. Any advice? B: Don't rush at first; build a solid foundation.
fill.why: 把基础打好 = build a solid foundation. 打基础 is a fixed collocation.

fill.q: A：你在大学学的是什么专业？B：我学的是酒店＿＿专业，现在在一家酒店工作。
full: A：你在大学学的是什么专业？B：我学的是酒店管理专业，现在在一家酒店工作。
A: Nǐ zài dàxué xué de shì shénme zhuānyè? B: Wǒxué de shì jiǔdiàn guǎnlǐ zhuānyè, xiànzài zài yìjiā jiǔdiàn gōngzuò.
A: What did you major in at university? B: Hotel management; now I work at a hotel.
fill.why: 酒店管理专业 = hotel management major. 管理 + industry name forms a major.

fill.q: A：您讲得真好，讲完我＿＿就明白了。谢谢您！B：别客气，还有不懂的就来问我。
full: A：您讲得真好，讲完我一下就明白了。谢谢您！B：别客气，还有不懂的就来问我。
A: Nín jiǎng de zhēn hǎo, jiǎngwán wǒ yíxià jiù míngbái le. Xièxie nín! B: Bié kèqi, hái yǒu bù dǒng de jiù lái wèn wǒ.
A: You explained it so well; I understood right away. Thank you! B: You're welcome; come ask me if anything else is unclear.
fill.why: 一下就明白了 = understood right away. 一下 as an adverb = all at once.

q: 同事把什么发到了王一雪的邮箱了？
Tóngshì bǎ shénme fādào le Wáng Yīxuě de yóuxiāng le?
What did the colleague send to Wang Yixue's email?
why: 市场调查的计划书我昨天发到您邮箱了。
Shìchǎng diàochá de jìhuàshū wǒ zuótiān fādào nín yóuxiāng le.
计划书 = written plan. She sent the market survey plan (调查的计划) to the manager's email.

q: 除了超市，同事还打算在哪儿进行调查？
Chúle chāoshì, tóngshì hái dǎsuàn zài nǎr jìnxíng diàochá?
Besides supermarkets, where else will the colleague do the survey?
why: 好的，那我再加一些网店。
Hǎo de, nà wǒ zàijiā yìxiē wǎngdiàn.
The manager says supermarkets alone aren't enough, so the colleague adds some online shops (网店).

q: 同事要去上海做什么？
Tóngshì yào qù Shànghǎi zuò shénme?
What is the colleague going to Shanghai for?
why: 经理让我下周去上海出差，做市场调查。
Jīnglǐ ràng wǒ xiàzhōu qù Shànghǎi chūchāi, zuò shìchǎng diàochá.
去上海出差 = go to Shanghai on a business trip. Market research is the work done on the trip.

q: 同事已经准备好什么了？
Tóngshì yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo shénme le?
What has the colleague already prepared?
why: 好的，我已经准备了一些问题。
Hǎo de, wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi le yìxiē wèntí.
After Yang Tongle advises preparing questions in advance, she says she has already prepared some (要问的问题).

q: 前段时间，杨同乐的同事怎么了？
Qiánduànshíjiān, Yáng Tónglè de tóngshì zěnme le?
What happened to Yang Tongle's colleague a while ago?
why: 前段时间，杨同乐的同事谈成了一笔不错的生意。
Qiánduànshíjiān, Yáng Tónglè de tóngshì tánchéng le yì bǐ búcuò de shēngyi.
谈成了一笔生意 = closed a deal. 谈成 means 'negotiate successfully'.

q: 同事是通过什么办法解决问题的？
Tóngshì shì tōngguò shénme bànfǎ jiějuéwèntí de?
How did the colleague solve the problem?
why: 于是，这位同事又认真地进行了几次市场调查，了解不同客户的想法。
Yúshì, zhèwèi tóngshì yòu rènzhēn de jìnxíng le jǐcì shìchǎng diàochá, liǎojiě bù tóng kèhù de xiǎngfǎ.
She did several more rounds of market research (做市场调查) to understand different customers, which fixed the problem.

q: 根据课文，为什么有的年轻人经常换工作？
Gēnjù kèwén, wèishénme yǒu de niánqīngrén jīngcháng huàn gōngzuò?
According to the text, why do some young people change jobs often?
o: they have high standards for themselves
觉得下一份工作会更好
Juéde xià yí fèn gōngzuò huì gènghǎo
they think the next job will be better
why: 有的年轻人经常换工作，总觉得下一份工作会更好。
Yǒu de niánqīngrén jīngcháng huàn gōngzuò, zǒng juéde xià yí fèn gōngzuò huì gènghǎo.
总觉得下一份工作会更好 = they always think the next job will be better. Pay and boredom aren't mentioned.

q: 他认为，年轻人刚进入社会时，应该更重视什么？
Tā rènwéi, niánqīngrén gāng jìnrù shèhuì shí, yīnggāi gèng zhòngshì shénme?
According to the author, what should young people value more when starting out?
why: 不能只关心工资的高低，更要重视学习。
Bù néng zhǐ guānxīn gōngzī de gāodī, gèngyào zhòngshì xuéxí.
不能只……，更要…… : not only salary — they should value learning (学习) more.

en: Relax when it's time to relax

ex: 第一次用中文演讲的时候，我特别紧张。
Dìyīcì yòng Zhōngwén yǎnjiǎng de shíhou, wǒ tèbié jǐnzhāng.
The first time I gave a speech in Chinese, I was very nervous.
考完试了，我们出去放松一下吧。
Kǎowánshì le, wǒmen chūqu fàngsōng yíxià ba.
Exams are over; let's go out and relax.
呀，你怎么来了？
Ya, nǐ zěnme lái le?
Oh, what are you doing here?
不管怎么样，我都会支持你。
Bùguǎn zěnmeyàng, wǒ dōu huì zhīchí nǐ.
No matter what, I'll support you.
郊区的空气比市区好多了。
Jiāoqū de kōngqì bǐ shìqū hǎoduō le.
The air in the suburbs is much better than downtown.
国庆节的时候，很多人去外地游玩。
Guóqìngjié de shíhou, hěn duō rénqù wàidì yóuwán.
During National Day, many people travel for fun.
这真是个好主意！
Zhè zhēnshì ge hǎo zhǔyi!
That's a really good idea!
外出的时候要注意安全。
Wàichū de shíhou yào zhùyì'ānquán.
Be careful when you go out.
他从小就戴眼镜。
Tā cóngxiǎo jiù dàiyǎnjìng.
He has worn glasses since childhood.
冬天出门最好戴帽子。
Dōngtiān chūmén zuìhǎo dàimàozi.
In winter you'd better wear a hat when going out.
我们小组正在做一个软件项目。
Wǒmen xiǎozǔ zhèngzài zuò yí ge ruǎnjiàn xiàngmù.
Our group is working on a software project.
这个星期他每天都加班到十点。
Zhège xīngqī tā měi tiān dōu jiābān dào shídiǎn.
This week he worked overtime till ten every day.
考试前一天别熬夜，要早点儿睡。
Kǎoshì qiányìtiān bié áoyè, yào zǎodiǎnr shuì.
Don't stay up the night before the exam; go to bed early.
快点儿走，否则就赶不上火车了。
Kuàidiǎnr zǒu, fǒuzé jiù gǎnbúshàng huǒchē le.
Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
别着急，你不会失去这个机会的。
Biézháojí, nǐ bú huì shīqù zhège jīhuì de.
Don't worry, you won't lose this chance.
这本书很值得一读。
Zhè běnshū hěn zhíde yìdú.
This book is well worth reading.
下雨了，比赛暂停了半个小时。
Xiàyǔ le, bǐsài zàntíng le bànge xiǎoshí.
It rained and the match was paused for half an hour.
吃完饭之后，我们去散步吧。
Chīwánfàn zhīhòu, wǒmen qù sànbù ba.
Let's take a walk after eating.
这里的风景太美了，我们拍张照吧。
Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng tàiměi le, wǒmen pāi zhāngzhào ba.
The scenery here is gorgeous; let's take a photo.
早上学习的效率比晚上高。
Zǎoshàng xuéxí de xiàolǜ bǐ wǎnshang gāo.
Studying in the morning is more efficient than at night.
最近他睡得不好，成绩也下降了。
Zuìjìn tā shuì de bùhǎo, chéngjì yě xiàjiàng le.
He's been sleeping poorly lately, and his grades dropped.
跟去年相比，今年的冬天暖和多了。
Gēn qùnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián de dōngtiān nuǎnhuo duō le.
Compared with last year, this winter is much warmer.
他每天都练习，因此进步得很快。
Tā měi tiān dōu liànxí, yīncǐ jìnbù de hěn kuài.
He practices every day, so he's improving fast.
请提醒我明天带护照。
Qǐng tíxǐng wǒ míngtiān dài hùzhào.
Please remind me to bring my passport tomorrow.
我与朋友们一起去了长城。
Wǒ yǔ péngyou men yìqǐ qù le Chángchéng.
I went to the Great Wall with my friends.
周末我喜欢去大自然里走走。
Zhōumò wǒ xǐhuan qù dàzìrán li zǒuzǒu.
On weekends I like walking in nature.
杭州是一个美丽的城市。
Hángzhōu shì yí ge měilì de chéngshì.
Hangzhou is a beautiful city.
山上的景色特别漂亮。
Shānshàng de jǐngsè tèbié piàoliang.
The view from the mountain is especially beautiful.
雅加达是印度尼西亚的首都。
Yǎjiādá shì Yìndùníxīyà de shǒudū.
Jakarta is the capital of Indonesia.
我们学校离市区有点儿远。
Wǒmen xuéxiào lí shìqū yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.
Our school is a bit far from downtown.
爬到山顶，眼前的景色美极了。
Pá dào shāndǐng, yǎnqián de jǐngsè měi jí le.
At the top, the view before our eyes was stunning.
我们一边吃饭一边看美景。
Wǒmen yìbiān chī fàn yìbiān kàn měijǐng.
We ate while enjoying the view.
我们下周要去参观一家科技公司。
Wǒmen xiàzhōu yào qù cānguān yìjiā kējì gōngsī.
Next week we're visiting a tech company.
北京有很多有名的旅游景点。
Běijīng yǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de lǚyóujǐngdiǎn.
Beijing has many famous tourist attractions.
这个小区交通很方便，附近有地铁站。
Zhège xiǎoqū jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu dìtiězhàn.
Transport is convenient here; there's a subway station nearby.
请乘坐三号线到学校站下车。
Qǐng chéngzuò sānhào xiàndào xuéxiào zhàn xiàchē.
Take Line 3 and get off at the school station.
听到这个消息，我十分高兴。
Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī, wǒ shífēn gāoxìng.
I was very happy to hear the news.
他看起来很严肃，实际上很幽默。
Tā kàn qilai hěn yánsù, shíjìshang hěn yōumò.
He looks serious, but he's actually very funny.

texts.title: On Friday night, Annie was on the phone with Bai Jiayue

lines.zh: 家月，最近学习太紧张了，咱们明天出去放松放松吧。
lines.py: Jiāyuè, zuìjìn xuéxí tàijǐnzhāng le, zánmen míngtiān chūqu fàngsōng fàngsōng ba.
lines.en: Jiayue, studying has been so intense lately. Let's go out and relax tomorrow.

lines.zh: 呀，正好我也想出去呢。咱们去哪儿好呢？
lines.py: Ya, zhènghǎo wǒ yě xiǎng chūqu ne. Zánmen qù nǎr hǎo ne?
lines.en: Oh, I was just thinking of going out too. Where should we go?

lines.zh: 不管去哪儿，能放松的地方都行。
lines.py: Bùguǎn qù nǎr, néng fàngsōng de dìfang dōuxíng.
lines.en: Anywhere is fine, as long as we can relax.

lines.zh: 郊区怎么样？
lines.py: Jiāoqū zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How about the suburbs?

lines.zh: 天中说，下周王老师要带咱们去郊区游玩呢。
lines.py: Tiānzhōng shuō, xiàzhōu Wáng lǎoshī yào dài zánmen qù jiāoqū yóuwán ne.
lines.en: Tianzhong said Teacher Wang is taking us on an outing to the suburbs next week.

lines.zh: 是吗？那咱们明天去爬长城吧，不是说“不到长城非好汉”吗？
lines.py: Shì ma? Nà zánmen míngtiān qù pá Chángchéng ba, búshì shuō “bú dào Chángchéng fēi hǎohàn” ma?
lines.en: Really? Then let's climb the Great Wall tomorrow. Don't they say "you're not a true hero until you've reached the Great Wall"?

lines.zh: 好主意！不过明天是个大晴天，外出记得戴帽子。
lines.py: Hǎo zhǔyi! Búguò míngtiān shì ge dàqíngtiān, wàichū jìde dàimàozi.
lines.en: Good idea! But tomorrow will be very sunny, so remember to wear a hat when you go out.

texts.title: On the weekend, Li Wen, Yang Tongle and others were on an outing in the suburbs

lines.zh: 同乐哥，你们平时工作忙吗？
lines.py: Tónglè gē, nǐmen píngshí gōngzuò máng ma?
lines.en: Brother Tongle, are you usually busy at work?

lines.zh: 挺忙的。以前我总觉得年轻时要多学多干，所以参加了公司里的很多项目，经常加班、熬夜，身体也亮起了红灯。
lines.py: Tǐngmáng de. Yǐqián wǒ zǒng juéde niánqīng shíyào duōxué duō gàn, suǒyǐ cānjiā le gōngsī li de hěn duō xiàngmù, jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè, shēntǐ yě liàngqǐ le hóngdēng.
lines.en: Pretty busy. I used to think that when you're young you should learn and do as much as possible, so I joined lots of company projects and often worked overtime and stayed up late, until my health started flashing red.

lines.zh: 还是别给自己太大压力，否则，失去健康就不值得了。
lines.py: Háishi bié gěi zìjǐ tài dà yālì, fǒuzé, shīqù jiànkāng jiù bù zhíde le.
lines.en: You'd better not put too much pressure on yourself; otherwise, losing your health isn't worth it.

lines.zh: 是啊，后来我就不接那么多项目了。我发现暂停下来、好好休息之后，我能把工作做得更快更好。
lines.py: Shì a, hòulái wǒ jiù bùjiē nàme duō xiàngmù le. Wǒ fāxiàn zàntíng xialai, hǎohǎo xiūxi zhīhòu, wǒnéng bǎ gōngzuò zuò de gèng kuài gènghǎo.
lines.en: Right. Later I stopped taking on so many projects. I found that after pausing and resting well, I could work faster and better.

lines.zh: 对，该工作时就工作，该放松时就要放松。
lines.py: Duì, gāi gōngzuò shí jiù gōngzuò, gāi fàngsōng shí jiùyào fàngsōng.
lines.en: Yes: work when it's time to work, and relax when it's time to relax.

lines.zh: 是的，现在我周末常来郊区，在好山好水好风景中放松自己。
lines.py: Shì de, xiànzài wǒ zhōumò cháng lái jiāoqū, zài hǎoshānhǎoshuǐ hǎo fēngjǐng zhōng fàngsōng zìjǐ.
lines.en: Exactly. Now I often come to the suburbs on weekends to relax among the beautiful mountains, rivers and scenery.

texts.title: Learning to relax

lines.zh: 以前杨同乐总觉得自己年轻，就应该多学多干、积累经验。很多年轻人和他想法一样。但是，由于工作紧张，他们经常加班、熬夜，休息不够，结果工作效率下降，健康也受到了影响。
lines.py: Yǐqián Yáng Tónglè zǒng juéde zìjǐ niánqīng, jiù yīnggāi duōxué duō gàn, jīlěi jīngyàn. Hěn duō niánqīngrén hé tā xiǎngfǎ yíyàng. Dànshì, yóuyú gōngzuò jǐnzhāng, tāmen jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè, xiūxi búgòu, jiéguǒ gōngzuòxiàolǜ xiàjiàng, jiànkāng yě shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
lines.en: Yang Tongle used to think that since he was young, he should learn and do as much as possible and build experience. Many young people think the same. But because work is intense, they often work overtime and stay up late without enough rest; as a result, their efficiency drops and their health suffers.

lines.zh: 现在越来越多的人认识到，跟一直加班相比，休息好了再工作，效率更高。因此，很多人开始做出改变，提醒自己减轻压力、多多放松。比如，杨同乐周末时或者与朋友们去郊区游玩，在大自然美丽的景色中好好放松自己；或者就在家里安安静静地看看书。休息好了，再回去上班时，心情愉快，工作效率也更高。
lines.py: Xiànzài yuè lái yuè duō de rén rènshi dào, gēn yìzhí jiābān xiāngbǐ, xiūxi hǎo le zài gōngzuò, xiàolǜ gènggāo. Yīncǐ, hěn duō rén kāishǐ zuòchū gǎibiàn, tíxǐng zìjǐ jiǎnqīng yālì, duōduō fàngsōng. Bǐrú, Yáng Tónglè zhōumò shí huòzhě yǔ péngyou men qù jiāoqū yóuwán, zài dàzìrán měilì de jǐngsè zhōng hǎohǎo fàngsōng zìjǐ; huòzhě jiù zài jiālǐ ān'ānjìngjìng de kànkànshū. Xiūxi hǎo le, zài huíqu shàngbān shí, xīnqíngyúkuài, gōngzuòxiàolǜ yě gèng gāo.
lines.en: Now more and more people realize that, compared with working overtime all the time, working after a good rest is more efficient. So many people have started to change, reminding themselves to reduce stress and relax more. For example, on weekends Yang Tongle either goes to the suburbs with friends to relax in nature's beautiful scenery, or stays home and quietly reads. Well rested, he goes back to work in a good mood and works more efficiently.

texts.title: Where is a good place to relax

lines.zh: 一到周末，很多人都喜欢外出游玩。你一般去哪里呢？
lines.py: Yídào zhōumò, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuan wàichū yóuwán. Nǐ yìbān qù nǎlǐ ne?
lines.en: As soon as the weekend comes, many people like to go out. Where do you usually go?

lines.zh: 我生活在中国的首都——北京。在北京，周末的时候，有人会在市区公园走走，看看眼前的美景；有人喜欢去参观长城、故宫等有名的景点，放松心情的同时，也能了解历史文化。北京交通很方便，所以我和家人更爱乘坐公交车去郊区，偶尔也会自己开车。郊区有山有水，还有很多农家乐，吃、玩、住都十分方便。
lines.py: Wǒ shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó de shǒudū – Běijīng. Zài Běijīng, zhōumò de shíhou, yǒu rén huì zài shìqū gōngyuán zǒuzǒu, kànkàn yǎnqián de měijǐng; yǒu rén xǐhuan qù cānguān Chángchéng, Gùgōng děng yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, fàngsōng xīnqíng de tóngshí, yě néng liǎojiě lìshǐ wénhuà. Běijīng jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ hé jiārén gèng'ài chéngzuò gōngjiāochē qù jiāoqū, ǒu'ěr yě huì zìjǐ kāichē. Jiāoqū yǒushānyǒushuǐ, hái yǒu hěn duō nóngjiālè, chī, wán, zhù dōu shífēn fāngbiàn.
lines.en: I live in China's capital, Beijing. On weekends some people walk in city parks and enjoy the beautiful views in front of them; others like visiting famous sites like the Great Wall and the Palace Museum, relaxing while learning about history and culture. Beijing's public transport is very convenient, so my family and I prefer taking public transport to the suburbs, and occasionally we drive. The suburbs have mountains and water and lots of farm stays, so eating, playing and staying there are all very convenient.

lines.zh: 在我看来，不管去哪里玩，实际上都是为了放松。也可以说，只要能放松，去哪儿都合适。
lines.py: Zàiwǒkànlái, bùguǎn qù nǎlǐ wán, shíjìshang dōu shì wèile fàngsōng. Yě kěyǐ shuō, zhǐyào néng fàngsōng, qù nǎr dōu héshì.
lines.en: In my view, wherever you go, it's really all about relaxing. You could say that as long as you can relax, anywhere is fine.

grammar.title: Conditional sentence 不管……，都/也……
grammar.note: The first clause gives any possible condition; the second says the result stays the same. Structure: 不管 + condition/situation/change, (subject) + 都/也 + result. "No matter …, still …".
ex: 不管去哪儿，能放松的地方都行。
Bùguǎn qù nǎr, néng fàngsōng de dìfang dōuxíng.
No matter where we go, anywhere relaxing is fine.
不管有什么想法，你都要说出来，让我们知道。
Bùguǎn yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ, nǐ dōu yàoshuō chulai, ràng wǒmen zhīdào.
Whatever ideas you have, say them so we know.
不管遇到多大困难，我们也要坚持，最后一定能完成任务。
Bùguǎn yùdào duōdà kùnnan, wǒmen yě yào jiānchí, zuìhòu yídìng néng wánchéng rènwu.
No matter how big the difficulties, we'll persist, and in the end we'll surely finish the task.

grammar.title: Hypothetical sentence ……，否则……
grammar.note: The first clause gives a requirement, suggestion or condition; the second, with 否则, says what will happen if it isn't met: "…, otherwise …".
ex: 还是别给自己太大压力，否则，失去健康就不值得了。
Háishi bié gěi zìjǐ tài dà yālì, fǒuzé, shīqù jiànkāng jiù bù zhíde le.
Don't put too much pressure on yourself; otherwise losing your health isn't worth it.
今晚早点儿睡吧，否则明天早上起不来，又该迟到了。
Jīnwǎn zǎodiǎnr shuì ba, fǒuzé míngtiān zǎoshàng qǐbulái, yòu gāi chídào le.
Go to bed early tonight, otherwise you won't get up tomorrow and you'll be late again.
吃不完的菜要放进冰箱，否则很容易坏。
Chībuwán de cài yào fàngjìn bīngxiāng, fǒuzé hěn róngyì huài.
Put leftover food in the fridge, otherwise it goes bad easily.

grammar.title: Comparative sentence 跟……相比
grammar.note: 跟……相比 is used to compare: "compared with …". 跟 is common in speech and informal settings; in writing and formal settings 与 is more common.
ex: 跟一直加班相比，休息好了再工作，效率更高。
Gēn yìzhí jiābān xiāngbǐ, xiūxi hǎo le zài gōngzuò, xiàolǜ gènggāo.
Compared with constant overtime, working after a good rest is more efficient.
跟读研究生相比，我更想直接工作。
Gēndú yánjiūshēng xiāngbǐ, wǒ gèng xiǎng zhíjiē gōngzuò.
Compared with going to grad school, I'd rather start working right away.
跟用现金相比，手机支付更方便些。
Gēn yòng xiànjīn xiāngbǐ, shǒujī zhīfù gèng fāngbiàn xiē.
Compared with cash, paying by phone is more convenient.

grammar.title: Set phrase 有A有B
grammar.note: In 有A有B, A and B are usually single syllables (sometimes two). They are related, similar or opposite in meaning, and together describe a full, varied situation.
ex: 郊区有山有水，还有很多农家乐。
Jiāoqū yǒushānyǒushuǐ, hái yǒu hěn duō nóngjiālè.
The suburbs have mountains and water, and lots of farm stays.
超市里的苹果有大有小，有红有绿，看起来都非常好吃。
Chāoshì li de píngguǒ yǒudàyǒuxiǎo, yǒuhóngyǒu lǜ, kàn qilai dōu fēicháng hǎochī.
The supermarket's apples come big and small, red and green, and they all look delicious.
春天，公园里到处都是人，有男有女，有大人有孩子，特别热闹。
Chūntiān, gōngyuán li dàochù dōu shì rén, yǒu nányǒu nǚ, yǒu dàrén yǒu háizi, tèbié rènao.
In spring the park is full of people, men and women, adults and children; it's very lively.

fill.q: 从北京＿＿高铁去上海，四五个小时就能到，特别快。
full: 从北京乘坐高铁去上海，四五个小时就能到，特别快。
Cóng Běijīng chéngzuò gāotiě qù Shànghǎi, sìwǔge xiǎoshí jiù néng dào, tèbié kuài.
Taking the high-speed train from Beijing to Shanghai takes just four or five hours; it's really fast.
fill.why: 乘坐 + vehicle = take/ride. 乘坐高铁 = take the high-speed train (more formal than 坐).

fill.q: 下雨天妈妈总是＿＿我，出门时别忘了带雨伞。
full: 下雨天妈妈总是提醒我，出门时别忘了带雨伞。
Xiàyǔtiān māmā zǒngshì tíxǐng wǒ, chūménshí biéwàngle dài yǔsǎn.
On rainy days Mom always reminds me not to forget my umbrella.
fill.why: 提醒 + person + to do something = remind someone. 提醒我别忘了带雨伞.

fill.q: 夏天比较热，出汗多，所以我一般不＿＿手表。
full: 夏天比较热，出汗多，所以我一般不戴手表。
Xiàtiān bǐjiào rè, chūhàn duō, suǒyǐ wǒ yìbān búdài shǒubiǎo.
Summer is hot and I sweat a lot, so I usually don't wear a watch.
fill.why: 戴 + accessories (watch, hat, glasses). 戴手表 = wear a watch. 穿 is for clothes.

fill.q: 他今天是第一次参加比赛，所以十分＿＿。
full: 他今天是第一次参加比赛，所以十分紧张。
Tā jīntiān shì dìyīcì cānjiā bǐsài, suǒyǐ shífēn jǐnzhāng.
Today is his first competition, so he's very nervous.
fill.why: 第一次参加比赛 → nervous: 十分紧张.

fill.q: 大家正不知道怎么办时，小文想出了一个好＿＿，这个难题马上就解决了。
full: 大家正不知道怎么办时，小文想出了一个好主意，这个难题马上就解决了。
Dàjiā zhèng bù zhīdào zěnmebàn shí, Xiǎo Wén xiǎngchū le yí ge hǎo zhǔyi, zhège nántí mǎshàng jiù jiějué le.
Just when nobody knew what to do, Xiao Wen came up with a good idea, and the problem was solved at once.
fill.why: 想出了一个好主意 = came up with a good idea. 主意 collocates with 想出、好.

fill.q: A：明天有什么安排？B：明天就安排了一个＿＿——八达岭长城。因为有些远，需要坐高铁去。
full: A：明天有什么安排？B：明天就安排了一个景点——八达岭长城。因为有些远，需要坐高铁去。
A: Míngtiān yǒu shénme ānpái? B: Míngtiān jiù ānpái le yí ge jǐngdiǎn – Bādálǐng Chángchéng. Yīnwèi yǒuxiē yuǎn, xūyào zuò gāotiě qù.
A: What's the plan for tomorrow? B: Just one sight: the Badaling Great Wall. It's a bit far, so we need to take the high-speed train.
fill.why: 安排了一个景点——八达岭长城: the dash introduces the name of the scenic spot.

fill.q: A：八达岭长城的＿＿太美了，我很喜欢。你以前来过吗？B：来过，这是我第三次来了。
full: A：八达岭长城的风景太美了，我很喜欢。你以前来过吗？B：来过，这是我第三次来了。
A: Bādálǐng Chángchéng de fēngjǐng tàiměi le, wǒ hěn xǐhuan. Nǐ yǐqián lái guo ma? B: Láiguo, zhè shì wǒ dìsāncì lái le.
A: The scenery at Badaling is gorgeous; I love it. Have you been before? B: Yes, this is my third time.
fill.why: 风景太美了 = the scenery is gorgeous. 美 describes scenery.

fill.q: A：你怎么了？感觉这段时间你的工作效率＿＿了。B：可能是因为最近晚上睡不着，休息不好。
full: A：你怎么了？感觉这段时间你的工作效率下降了。B：可能是因为最近晚上睡不着，休息不好。
A: Nǐ zěnme le? Gǎnjué zhè duànshíjiān nǐ de gōngzuòxiàolǜ xiàjiàng le. B: Kěnéng shìyīnwèi zuìjìn wǎnshang shuì bu zháo, xiūxi bùhǎo.
A: What's up? Your work efficiency seems to have dropped lately. B: Maybe because I can't sleep at night and don't rest well.
fill.why: 效率下降了 = efficiency dropped. B gives the cause: not sleeping well.

fill.q: A：这道菜看着不太好吃，我不想吃。B：＿＿挺好吃的，你尝尝。
full: A：这道菜看着不太好吃，我不想吃。B：实际上挺好吃的，你尝尝。
A: Zhè dàocài kànzhe bú tài hǎo chī, wǒ bùxiǎng chī. B: Shíjìshang tǐnghǎochī de, nǐ chángcháng.
A: This dish doesn't look tasty; I don't want it. B: It's actually pretty good. Try it.
fill.why: 实际上 = actually; it contrasts with A's guess (looks bad → actually tastes good).

fill.q: A：我刚收到通知，今天下午要停水。B：那咱们赶快多接点儿水，＿＿做不了饭了。
full: A：我刚收到通知，今天下午要停水。B：那咱们赶快多接点儿水，否则做不了饭了。
A: Wǒgāng shōudào tōngzhī, jīntiān xiàwǔ yào tíngshuǐ. B: Nà zánmen gǎnkuài duōjiē diǎnr shuǐ, fǒuzé zuò bu liǎo fàn le.
A: I just got a notice that the water will be cut off this afternoon. B: Then let's store some water quickly, otherwise we can't cook.
fill.why: 赶快多接点儿水，否则做不了饭: store water, otherwise we can't cook.

q: 安妮想外出放松一下，白家月呢？
Ānnī xiǎng wàichū fàngsōng yíxià, Bái Jiāyuè ne?
Annie wants to go out and relax. What about Bai Jiayue?
o: she wants to review at home
she happens to want to go out too
why: 呀，正好我也想出去呢。
Ya, zhènghǎo wǒ yě xiǎng chūqu ne.
正好我也想出去 = I happen to want to go out too. She isn't busy and has no other plans.

q: 安妮和白家月最后决定去哪里？
Ānnī hé Bái Jiāyuè zuìhòu juédìng qù nǎlǐ?
Where do Annie and Bai Jiayue finally decide to go?
why: 那咱们明天去爬长城吧。……好主意！
Nà zánmen míngtiān qù pá Chángchéng ba. …… hǎo zhǔyi!
The suburbs are ruled out because Teacher Wang is taking them there next week, so they choose to climb the Great Wall (长城), and Annie agrees: 好主意.

q: 杨同乐以前工作怎么样？
Yáng Tónglè yǐqián gōngzuò zěnmeyàng?
What was Yang Tongle's work like before?
why: 经常加班、熬夜，身体也亮起了红灯。
Jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè, shēntǐ yě liàngqǐ le hóngdēng.
He joined many projects and often worked overtime (经常加班) and stayed up late.

q: 杨同乐周末来郊区是为了什么？
Yáng Tónglè zhōumò lái jiāoqū shì wèile shénme?
Why does Yang Tongle come to the suburbs on weekends?
why: 在好山好水好风景中放松自己。
Zài hǎoshānhǎoshuǐ hǎo fēngjǐng zhōng fàngsōng zìjǐ.
He comes to the suburbs to relax (放松自己) among the mountains, rivers and scenery.

q: 根据课文，经常加班、熬夜会怎么样？
Gēnjù kèwén, jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè huì zěnmeyàng?
According to the text, what happens if you often work overtime and stay up late?
why: 结果工作效率下降，健康也受到了影响。
Jiéguǒ gōngzuòxiàolǜ xiàjiàng, jiànkāng yě shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
结果 introduces the outcome: efficiency drops and health is affected (健康受到影响). A is the opposite.

q: 周末好好休息，给杨同乐带来了什么变化？
Zhōumò hǎohǎo xiūxi, gěi Yáng Tónglè dàilái le shénme biànhuà?
What change did resting well on weekends bring Yang Tongle?
why: 休息好了，再回去上班时，心情愉快，工作效率也更高。
Xiūxi hǎo le, zài huíqu shàngbān shí, xīnqíngyúkuài, gōngzuòxiàolǜ yě gèng gāo.
After resting, he goes back to work in a good mood and with higher efficiency (工作效率更高). Less work and more friends aren't mentioned.

q: 根据课文，周末的时候，很多人都喜欢做什么？
Gēnjù kèwén, zhōumò de shíhou, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuan zuò shénme?
According to the text, what do many people like to do on weekends?
why: 一到周末，很多人都喜欢外出游玩。
Yídào zhōumò, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuan wàichū yóuwán.
一到……就…… : as soon as the weekend comes, many people like to go out (外出游玩).

q: 他和家人为什么喜欢坐公交车去郊区？
Tā hé jiārén wèishénme xǐhuan zuò gōngjiāochē qù jiāoqū?
Why do he and his family like taking public transport to the suburbs?
why: 北京交通很方便，所以我和家人更爱乘坐公交车去郊区。
Běijīng jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ hé jiārén gèng'ài chéngzuò gōngjiāochē qù jiāoqū.
所以 gives the reason: Beijing's transport is convenient (北京交通方便). Speed, crowds and scenery from the bus aren't mentioned.

ex: 祝你考试顺利，取得好成绩！
Zhù nǐ kǎoshì shùnlì, qǔdé hǎo chéngjì!
Good luck on your exam — I hope you do well!
我最喜欢吃巧克力蛋糕。
Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
Chocolate cake is my favorite.
这个电影的故事很让人感动。
Zhège diànyǐng de gùshì hěn ràng rén gǎndòng.
This movie's story is very touching.
他们在海边吃了一顿浪漫的晚餐。
Tāmen zài hǎibiān chī le yídùn làngmàn de wǎncān.
They had a romantic dinner by the sea.
我们的中文老师说话很幽默。
Wǒmen de Zhōngwén lǎoshī shuōhuà hěn yōumò.
Our Chinese teacher speaks with a lot of humor.
老师很耐心地回答了我的问题。
Lǎoshī hěn nàixīn de huídá le wǒ de wèntí.
The teacher answered my question patiently.
这个城市的美食吸引了很多游客。
Zhège chéngshì de měishí xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
This city's food attracts many tourists.
我第一次来中国的时候才十八岁，当时一句中文也不会说。
Wǒ dìyīcì lái Zhōngguó de shíhou cái shíbāsuì, dāngshí yíjù Zhōngwén yě bú huì shuō.
I was only eighteen when I first came to China, and I couldn't speak a word of Chinese then.
这么好的机会，你可别错过。
Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, nǐ kě biécuòguò.
Don't miss such a good opportunity.
幸运的是，我们赶上了最后一班地铁。
Xìngyùn de shì, wǒmen gǎnshàng le zuìhòu yìbān dìtiě.
Luckily we caught the last subway train.
祝你们永远幸福！
Zhùnǐmen yǒngyuǎn xìngfú!
Wishing you happiness forever!
尽管下着大雨，他还是按时到了。
Jǐnguǎn xià zhe dàyǔ, tā háishi ànshí dào le.
Although it was pouring, he still arrived on time.
她性格很开朗，交了很多朋友。
Tā xìnggé hěn kāilǎng, jiāole hěn duō péngyou.
She's very outgoing and has made lots of friends.
我和我的室友有很多共同点。
Wǒ hé wǒ de shìyǒu yǒu hěn duō gòngtóngdiǎn.
My roommate and I have a lot in common.
照顾好自己的身体是每个人的责任。
Zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ de shēntǐ shì měi ge rén de zérèn.
Taking care of your health is everyone's responsibility.
朋友之间应该相互信任。
Péngyou zhījiān yīnggāi xiānghùxìnrèn.
Friends should trust one another.
你的心情我能理解。
Nǐ de xīnqíng wǒnéng lǐjiě.
I understand how you feel.
我父母一直很支持我来中国留学。
Wǒ fùmǔ yìzhí hěn zhīchí wǒlái Zhōngguó liúxué.
My parents have always supported my studying in China.
这个城市给我留下了很深的印象。
Zhège chéngshì gěi wǒ liúxià le hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
This city left a deep impression on me.
我实在太累了，想早点儿睡。
Wǒ shízài tàilèi le, xiǎng zǎodiǎnr shuì.
I'm really too tired; I want to sleep early.
今天阳光很好，我们去公园走走吧。
Jīntiān yángguāng hěn hǎo, wǒmen qù gōngyuán zǒuzǒu ba.
It's sunny today; let's walk in the park.
这个项目由王经理负责。
Zhège xiàngmù yóu Wáng jīnglǐ fùzé.
Manager Wang is in charge of this project.
他上课的时候回答问题很积极。
Tā shàngkè de shíhou huídá wèntí hěn jījí.
He answers questions actively in class.
此次会议非常重要，请大家准时参加。
Cǐcì huìyì fēicháng zhòngyào, qǐng dàjiā zhǔnshí cānjiā.
This meeting is very important; please attend on time.
他们在大学认识，从此成了好朋友。
Tāmen zài dàxué rènshi, cóngcǐ chéng le hǎo péngyou.
They met at university and have been good friends ever since.
看了这部电影以后，我对中国历史产生了兴趣。
Kàn le zhèbù diànyǐng yǐhòu, wǒ duì Zhōngguó lìshǐ chǎnshēng le xìngqù.
After seeing this film, I became interested in Chinese history.
这是一个关于爱情的故事。
Zhè shì yí ge guānyú àiqíng de gùshì.
This is a story about love.
同学间应该多交流。
Tóngxué jiān yīnggāi duō jiāoliú.
Classmates should communicate more with each other.
我很珍惜我们之间的友情。
Wǒ hěn zhēnxī wǒmen zhījiān de yǒuqíng.
I really treasure our friendship.
大学生活给我留下了很多美好的回忆。
Dàxué shēnghuó gěi wǒ liúxià le hěn duō měihǎo de huíyì.
College life left me many fond memories.
出国留学是我人生中一次重要的经历。
Chūguó liúxué shì wǒ rénshēng zhōng yí cì zhòngyào de jīnglì.
Studying abroad is an important experience in my life.
昨天的足球比赛太精彩了！
Zuótiān de zúqiúbǐsài tàijīngcǎi le!
Yesterday's soccer match was so exciting!
他们兄弟俩的感情一直很好。
Tāmen xiōngdìliǎ de gǎnqíng yìzhí hěn hǎo.
The two brothers have always been close.
这条河很深，不能游泳。
Zhètiáo hé hěn shēn, bù néng yóuyǒng.
This river is deep; no swimming.
他的父母经营着一家小饭馆。
Tā de fùmǔ jīngyíng zhe yìjiā xiǎo fànguǎn.
His parents run a small restaurant.
吵架的时候，也要尊重对方。
Chǎojià de shíhou, yě yào zūnzhòng duìfāng.
Even when arguing, respect the other person.
在中国生活了一年，我感受到了很多不同的文化。
Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó le yì nián, wǒ gǎnshòu dào le hěn duō bù tóng de wénhuà.
Living in China for a year, I've experienced many different cultures.
我喜欢运动，尤其是游泳。
Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng, yóuqí shì yóuyǒng.
I like sports, especially swimming.
这些日子我一直在准备考试。
Zhèxiē rìzi wǒ yìzhí zài zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
These days I've been preparing for exams.
我从来没去过哈尔滨。
Wǒ cóngláiméi qùguo Hā'ěrbīn.
I've never been to Harbin.

texts.title: At a restaurant, Li Wen was celebrating Bai Jiayue's birthday

lines.zh: 家月，给你的，祝你生日快乐！
lines.py: Jiāyuè, gěi nǐ de, zhù nǐ shēngrìkuàilè!
lines.en: Jiayue, this is for you. Happy birthday!

lines.zh: 啊，好漂亮的花！还有巧克力！你怎么知道我喜欢这个巧克力？
lines.py: A, hǎo piàoliang de huā! Hái yǒu qiǎokèlì! Nǐ zěnme zhīdào wǒ xǐhuan zhège qiǎokèlì?
lines.en: Oh, what beautiful flowers! And chocolate! How did you know I like this chocolate?

lines.zh: 上次咱们去超市，看你拿起来看了看又放下了，我就记住了。
lines.py: Shàngcì zánmen qù chāoshì, kàn nǐ ná qilai kàn le kàn yòu fàngxià le, wǒ jiù jìzhù le.
lines.en: Last time we went to the supermarket, I saw you pick it up, look at it and put it back, so I remembered.

lines.zh: 好感动！我不说你也懂我在想什么，你真是细心又浪漫。其实刚认识不久，你的幽默与耐心就很吸引我，不过我当时也只把你当普通朋友。如果你没有一直找我聊天儿，我们可能就错过了。
lines.py: Hǎo gǎndòng! Wǒ bù shuō nǐ yě dǒng wǒ zài xiǎng shénme, nǐ zhēnshì xìxīn yòu làngmàn. Qíshí gāng rènshi bùjiǔ, nǐ de yōumò yǔ nàixīn jiù hěn xīyǐn wǒ, búguò wǒ dāngshí yě zhǐ bǎ nǐ dāng pǔtōng péngyou. Rúguǒ nǐ méiyǒu yìzhí zhǎo wǒ liáotiānr, wǒmen kěnéng jiù cuòguò le.
lines.en: I'm so touched! You know what I'm thinking even without my saying it; you're so attentive and romantic. Actually, soon after we met, your humor and patience attracted me, but back then I only saw you as an ordinary friend. If you hadn't kept chatting with me, we might have missed each other.

lines.zh: 我终于遇见了对的人，哪能错过呢？
lines.py: Wǒ zhōngyú yùjiàn le duì de rén, nǎnéng cuòguò ne?
lines.en: I finally met the right person. How could I let her slip away?

lines.zh: 遇见你，我也觉得很幸运。
lines.py: Yùjiàn nǐ, wǒ yě juéde hěn xìngyùn.
lines.en: I feel lucky to have met you too.

texts.title: At home, Wang Yixue and Liu Ming were talking about Wang Yifei and Yang Tongle's marriage

lines.zh: 看到一飞和同乐结婚后这么幸福，我这个介绍人也特别开心。
lines.py: Kàndào Yīfēi hé Tónglè jiéhūn hòu zhème xìngfú, wǒ zhège jièshào rén yě tèbié kāixīn.
lines.en: Seeing Yifei and Tongle so happy after getting married, I'm especially glad as the one who introduced them.

lines.zh: 是啊，同乐是你的好朋友，一飞是你妹妹，你都很了解。
lines.py: Shì a, Tónglè shì nǐ de hǎo péngyou, Yīfēi shì nǐ mèimèi, nǐ dōu hěn liǎojiě.
lines.en: Yes, Tongle is your good friend and Yifei is your sister; you know them both well.

lines.zh: 嗯，他们尽管性格不同，但是有很多共同爱好。特别是同乐人好，性格也好，很有责任感。
lines.py: Ńg, tāmen jǐnguǎn xìnggé bù tóng, dànshì yǒu hěn duō gòngtóng'àihào. Tèbié shì Tónglè rénhǎo, xìnggé yěhǎo, hěn yǒu zérèngǎn.
lines.en: Mm, although their personalities differ, they share many interests. Tongle especially is a good person with a good personality and a strong sense of responsibility.

lines.zh: 是的，一飞也算在对的时间遇到了对的人。后边的路还很长，希望他们能一直相互理解、相互支持。
lines.py: Shì de, Yīfēi yě suàn zài duì de shíjiān yùdào le duì de rén. Hòubiān de lù hái hěn cháng, xīwàng tāmen néng yìzhí xiānghù lǐjiě, xiānghù zhīchí.
lines.en: Yes, Yifei met the right person at the right time. There's a long road ahead; I hope they'll always understand and support each other.

lines.zh: 我了解同乐，更了解一飞，相信他们会一直走下去的。
lines.py: Wǒ liǎojiě Tónglè, gèng liǎojiě Yīfēi, xiāngxìn tāmen huì yìzhí zǒu xiaqu de.
lines.en: I know Tongle, and I know Yifei even better. I believe they'll stay together.

lines.zh: 祝他们越来越幸福。
lines.py: Zhù tāmen yuè lái yuè xìngfú.
lines.en: I wish them more and more happiness.

texts.title: Yang Tongle's double fortune

lines.zh: 王一雪比杨同乐更早进入公司。杨同乐刚来不久，王一雪对他印象就非常好：人很实在，性格阳光，工作负责，表现积极……后来他们一起出了次差，此次出差，让两人熟悉了起来，从此成了好朋友。一次聊天儿时，王一雪了解到杨同乐还没女朋友，正好自己的妹妹王一飞也没有男朋友，于是王一雪就把王一飞介绍给了他。
lines.py: Wáng Yīxuě bǐ Yáng Tónglè gèng zǎo jìnrù gōngsī. Yáng Tónglè gāng lái bùjiǔ, Wáng Yīxuě duì tā yìnxiàng jiù fēicháng hǎo: rén hěn shízài, xìnggé yángguāng, gōngzuò fùzé, biǎoxiàn jījí…… hòulái tāmen yìqǐ chūle cì chāi, cǐcì chūchāi, ràng liǎngrén shúxī le qilai, cóngcǐ chéng le hǎo péngyou. Yí cì liáotiānr shí, Wáng Yīxuě liǎojiě dào Yáng Tónglè hái méi nǚpéngyǒu, zhènghǎo zìjǐ de mèimèi Wáng Yīfēi yě méiyǒu nánpéngyǒu, yúshì Wáng Yīxuě jiù bǎ Wáng Yīfēi jièshào gěi le tā.
lines.en: Wang Yixue joined the company earlier than Yang Tongle. Soon after he arrived, she had a very good impression of him: honest, sunny, responsible at work, proactive… Later they went on a business trip together, which made them close, and from then on they became good friends. Once while chatting, Wang Yixue learned that Yang Tongle didn't have a girlfriend, and her younger sister Wang Yifei happened to be single too, so she introduced Wang Yifei to him.

lines.zh: 杨同乐和王一飞认识后，很聊得来，两人之间慢慢产生了爱情，最后成了夫妻。杨同乐说自己很幸运，和王一雪这份同事间的友情，给他带来了美好的爱情。
lines.py: Yáng Tónglè hé Wáng Yīfēi rènshi hòu, hěn liáo de lái, liǎngrén zhījiān mànmàn chǎnshēng le àiqíng, zuìhòu chéng le fūqī. Yáng Tónglè shuō zìjǐ hěn xìngyùn, hé Wáng Yīxuě zhèfèn tóngshì jiān de yǒuqíng, gěi tā dàilái le měihǎo de àiqíng.
lines.en: After meeting, Yang Tongle and Wang Yifei got along very well; love gradually grew between them and they eventually married. Yang Tongle says he's very lucky: his friendship with his colleague Wang Yixue brought him a beautiful love.

texts.title: Love needs to be nurtured even more

lines.zh: 李文在校园里遇见白家月，从此，他们的人生变得更加精彩；王一飞和杨同乐通过王一雪介绍认识后，感情越来越深，最后两人幸福地走到了一起。
lines.py: Lǐ Wén zài xiàoyuán li yùjiàn Bái Jiāyuè, cóngcǐ, tāmen de rénshēng biànde gèngjiā jīngcǎi; Wáng Yīfēi hé Yáng Tónglè tōngguò Wáng Yīxuě jièshào rènshi hòu, gǎnqíng yuè lái yuè shēn, zuìhòu liǎngrén xìngfú de zǒu dào le yìqǐ.
lines.en: Li Wen met Bai Jiayue on campus, and from then on their lives became more wonderful. Wang Yifei and Yang Tongle met through Wang Yixue's introduction; their feelings grew deeper and deeper, and finally they happily came together.

lines.zh: 在我看来，遇见爱情的方式并不重要，重要的是在合适的时间遇到了合适的人。遇见你，刚刚好。不过美好的遇见只是爱的开始，爱更需要经营。在一段感情中，两个人要多关注对方的感受，尤其是结婚后，更要共同经营好家庭，日子才能越过越好。爱，从来都是相互尊重、理解与支持，不是吗？
lines.py: Zàiwǒkànlái, yùjiàn àiqíng de fāngshì bìng bú zhòngyào, zhòngyào de shì zài héshì de shíjiān yùdào le héshì de rén. Yùjiàn nǐ, gānggāng hǎo. Búguò měihǎo de yùjiàn zhǐshì ài de kāishǐ, ài gèng xūyào jīngyíng. Zài yí duàn gǎnqíng zhōng, liǎng ge rényào duō guānzhù duìfāng de gǎnshòu, yóuqí shì jiéhūn hòu, gèngyào gòngtóng jīngyíng hǎo jiātíng, rìzi cáinéng yuèguò yuè hǎo. Ài, cónglái dōu shì xiānghù zūnzhòng, lǐjiě yǔ zhīchí, búshì ma?
lines.en: In my view, how you find love doesn't matter; what matters is meeting the right person at the right time. Meeting you was just perfect. But a beautiful meeting is only the start of love; love needs to be nurtured even more. In a relationship, both people should pay more attention to each other's feelings; especially after marriage, they need to build their family together so life gets better and better. Love has always been about mutual respect, understanding and support, hasn't it?

grammar.title: Contracted sentence 不……也……
grammar.note: 不……也…… means that even under a negative condition, the result is still certain: "even without …, still …". Common in spoken Chinese.
ex: 我不说你也懂我在想什么。
Wǒ bù shuō nǐ yě dǒng wǒ zài xiǎng shénme.
Even if I don't say it, you know what I'm thinking.
他不复习也能考出好成绩。
Tā bú fùxí yě néng kǎochū hǎo chéngjì.
He can get good grades even without reviewing.
我很清楚他为什么生气，不问我也知道。
Wǒ hěn qīngchu tā wèishénme shēngqì, búwèn wǒ yě zhīdào.
I know exactly why he's angry; I don't even need to ask.

grammar.title: Adversative sentence 尽管……，但是/可是……
grammar.note: 尽管 ("though") introduces a situation; 但是/可是 introduces an opposite situation or result: "although …, (still) …".
ex: 他们尽管性格不同，但是有很多共同爱好。
Tāmen jǐnguǎn xìnggé bù tóng, dànshì yǒu hěn duō gòngtóng'àihào.
Although their personalities differ, they share many interests.
尽管时间紧张、压力很大，但是他们还是完成了任务。
Jǐnguǎn shíjiān jǐnzhāng, yālì hěn dà, dànshì tāmen háishi wánchéng le rènwu.
Although time was tight and the pressure great, they still finished the task.
尽管她已经很累了，可是还是很耐心地给女儿读睡前故事。
Jǐnguǎn tā yǐjīng hěnlèi le, kěshì háishi hěn nàixīn de gěi nǚ'ér dú shuì qián gùshì.
Although she was already very tired, she still patiently read her daughter a bedtime story.

grammar.title: Demonstrative pronoun 此
grammar.note: 此 means "this / this one" (= 这、这个) and is mainly used in written language or formal settings.
ex: 此次出差，让两人熟悉了起来，从此成了好朋友。
Cǐcì chūchāi, ràng liǎngrén shúxī le qilai, cóngcǐ chéng le hǎo péngyou.
This business trip made the two of them close, and from then on they became good friends.
此人聪明、有能力，一定能顺利完成任务。
Cǐrén cōngmíng, yǒu nénglì, yídìng néng shùnlìwánchéng rènwu.
This person is smart and capable and will surely complete the task.
此材料很重要，必须直接交给他。
Cǐ cáiliào hěn zhòngyào, bìxū zhíjiē jiāogěi tā.
This material is very important and must be handed to him directly.

grammar.title: Adverb of time 从来
grammar.note: 从来 means something has always been so from the past until now. It's usually used in negative sentences (从来不/没……) and sometimes in affirmative ones.
ex: 爱，从来都是相互尊重、理解与支持，不是吗？
Ài, cónglái dōu shì xiānghù zūnzhòng, lǐjiě yǔ zhīchí, búshì ma?
Love has always been about mutual respect, understanding and support, hasn't it?
我从来没见过这个颜色的花，它叫什么名字啊？
Wǒ cóngláiméi jiànguo zhège yánsè de huā, tā jiào shénme míngzì a?
I've never seen a flower this color. What's it called?
我从来不喜欢一个人旅游，每次都要和家人或朋友一起去。
Wǒ cóngláibù xǐhuan yí ge rén lǚyóu, měicì dōu yào hé jiārén huò péngyou yìqǐ qù.
I've never liked traveling alone; I always go with family or friends.

fill.q: 这次比赛＿＿了很多同学参加，大家都表现得非常积极。
full: 这次比赛吸引了很多同学参加，大家都表现得非常积极。
Zhè cì bǐsài xīyǐn le hěn duō tóngxué cānjiā, dàjiā dōu biǎoxiàn de fēicháng jījí.
This competition attracted many students, and everyone was very enthusiastic.
fill.why: 吸引了很多同学参加 = attracted many students to take part. 吸引 + people + verb.

fill.q: 我特别喜欢吃水果，＿＿喜欢吃香蕉。
full: 我特别喜欢吃水果，尤其喜欢吃香蕉。
Wǒ tèbié xǐhuan chīshuǐguǒ, yóuqí xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo.
I really like fruit, especially bananas.
fill.why: 我特别喜欢吃水果，尤其喜欢…… — 尤其 singles out one item from a group (bananas among fruit).

fill.q: 今天是妈妈的生日，我和爸爸给她买了生日蛋糕，一起给她唱生日歌，＿＿她永远（yǒngyuǎn）年轻、美丽。
full: 今天是妈妈的生日，我和爸爸给她买了生日蛋糕，一起给她唱生日歌，祝她永远（yǒngyuǎn）年轻、美丽。
Jīntiān shì māmā de shēngrì, wǒ hé bàbà gěi tā mǎi le shēngrìdàngāo, yìqǐ gěi tā chàng shēngrìgē, zhù tā yǒngyuǎn (yǒngyuǎn) niánqīng, měilì.
Today is Mom's birthday. Dad and I bought her a cake, sang her happy birthday, and wished her to stay young and beautiful forever.
fill.why: 祝 + person + wish: 祝她永远年轻、美丽. 祝 is used for birthday wishes.

fill.q: 人要对自己说过的话＿＿，说到就一定要做到。
full: 人要对自己说过的话负责，说到就一定要做到。
Rényào duì zìjǐ shuō guo dehuà fùzé, shuō dào jiù yídìng yào zuòdào.
You should be responsible for what you say: if you say it, do it.
fill.why: 对……负责 = be responsible for. 对自己说过的话负责.

fill.q: 这位新同事做事积极，＿＿也很好，大家都很喜欢她。
full: 这位新同事做事积极，性格也很好，大家都很喜欢她。
Zhèwèi xīn tóngshì zuòshì jījí, xìnggé yě hěn hǎo, dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuan tā.
This new colleague is proactive and has a great personality; everyone likes her.
fill.why: 性格也很好 = good personality too. 性格 + 好 describes a person's character.

fill.q: A：他们夫妻两人的＿＿一直特别好。B：是的，他们家真是一个幸福的家庭。
full: A：他们夫妻两人的感情一直特别好。B：是的，他们家真是一个幸福的家庭。
A: Tāmen fūqī liǎngrén de gǎnqíng yìzhí tèbié hǎo. B: Shì de, tāmen jiā zhēnshì yí ge xìngfú de jiātíng.
A: That couple has always had a great relationship. B: Yes, theirs is truly a happy family.
fill.why: 夫妻两人的感情 = the couple's relationship. 感情好 = they get along well.

fill.q: A：你结婚的＿＿定（dìng, set）了吗？B：嗯，定在了下周六，到时候你一定要来啊！
full: A：你结婚的日子定（dìng, set）了吗？B：嗯，定在了下周六，到时候你一定要来啊！
A: Nǐ jiéhūn de rìzi dìng (dìng, set) le ma? B: Ńg, dìng zài le xià zhōuliù, dào shíhou nǐ yídìng yàolái a!
A: Have you set your wedding date? B: Yes, next Saturday. You must come!
fill.why: 结婚的日子 = the wedding date; B answers with a date (下周六).

fill.q: A：我希望自己遇见的＿＿简单、美好，你呢？B：我的想法和你一样，我也希望遇到简单的人，结婚后过简单的日子。
full: A：我希望自己遇见的爱情简单、美好，你呢？B：我的想法和你一样，我也希望遇到简单的人，结婚后过简单的日子。
A: Wǒ xīwàng zìjǐ yùjiàn de àiqíng jiǎndān, měihǎo, nǐ ne? B: Wǒ de xiǎngfǎ hé nǐ yíyàng, wǒ yě xīwàng yùdào jiǎndān de rén, jiéhūn hòu guò jiǎndān de rìzi.
A: I hope the love I find is simple and beautiful. And you? B: Same here: I hope to meet a simple person and live a simple life after marriage.
fill.why: 遇见的爱情 = the love one finds. The rest of the dialogue is about marriage and partners.

fill.q: A：我记得第一次看这个电影时，我都感动得哭了。B：嗯，我对它的印象也很＿＿。
full: A：我记得第一次看这个电影时，我都感动得哭了。B：嗯，我对它的印象也很深。
A: Wǒ jìde dìyīcì kàn zhège diànyǐng shí, wǒ dōu gǎndòng de kū le. B: Ńg, wǒ duì tā de yìnxiàng yě hěn shēn.
A: I remember crying the first time I saw this movie. B: Yes, it left a deep impression on me too.
fill.why: 印象很深 = a deep impression. 深 collocates with 印象.

fill.q: A：看完刚才的足球比赛，你有什么＿＿？B：我觉得球员们踢得很精彩，尤其是8号，表现特别好。
full: A：看完刚才的足球比赛，你有什么感受？B：我觉得球员们踢得很精彩，尤其是8号，表现特别好。
A: Kàn wán gāngcái de zúqiúbǐsài, nǐ yǒu shénme gǎnshòu? B: Wǒ juéde qiúyuán men tī de hěn jīngcǎi, yóuqí shì bā hào, biǎoxiàn tèbié hǎo.
A: How do you feel after watching that soccer match? B: The players were brilliant, especially number 8.
fill.why: 你有什么感受？= How do you feel about it? B then gives his impression of the match.

q: 白家月过生日时，李文送了什么生日礼物？
Bái Jiāyuè guòshēngrì shí, Lǐ Wén sòng le shénme shēngrìlǐwù?
What birthday present did Li Wen give Bai Jiayue?
why: 啊，好漂亮的花！还有巧克力！
A, hǎo piàoliang de huā! Hái yǒu qiǎokèlì!
Bai Jiayue reacts to the flowers and then the chocolate, so the gift is flowers and chocolate (花和巧克力).

q: 白家月认为李文是个什么样的人？
Bái Jiāyuè rènwéi Lǐ Wén shì ge shénmeyàng de rén?
What kind of person does Bai Jiayue think Li Wen is?
why: 其实刚认识不久，你的幽默与耐心就很吸引我。
Qíshí gāng rènshi bùjiǔ, nǐ de yōumò yǔ nàixīn jiù hěn xīyǐn wǒ.
She praises his humor (幽默) and patience. B 没有耐心 is the opposite; responsibility and sports aren't mentioned.

q: 王一飞和杨同乐结婚后怎么样？
Wáng Yīfēi hé Yáng Tónglè jiéhūn hòu zěnmeyàng?
How are Wang Yifei and Yang Tongle after getting married?
why: 看到一飞和同乐结婚后这么幸福，我这个介绍人也特别开心。
Kàndào Yīfēi hé Tónglè jiéhūn hòu zhème xìngfú, wǒ zhège jièshào rén yě tèbié kāixīn.
这么幸福 = so happy. C 非常幸福 matches.

q: 刘明对王一飞和杨同乐有什么希望？
Liú Míng duì Wáng Yīfēi hé Yáng Tónglè yǒu shénme xīwàng?
What does Liu Ming hope for Wang Yifei and Yang Tongle?
why: 希望他们能一直相互理解、相互支持。
Xīwàng tāmen néng yìzhí xiānghù lǐjiě, xiānghù zhīchí.
Liu Ming hopes they will always understand and support each other (相互理解、相互支持).

q: 杨同乐是什么时候认识王一雪的？
Yáng Tónglè shì shénme shíhou rènshi Wáng Yīxuě de?
When did Yang Tongle meet Wang Yixue?
why: 王一雪比杨同乐更早进入公司。杨同乐刚来不久，王一雪对他印象就非常好。
Wáng Yīxuě bǐ Yáng Tónglè gèng zǎo jìnrù gōngsī. Yáng Tónglè gāng lái bùjiǔ, Wáng Yīxuě duì tā yìnxiàng jiù fēicháng hǎo.
Wang Yixue joined the company first; they met after Yang Tongle joined (来公司后).

q: 王一雪和杨同乐是怎么熟悉起来的？
Wáng Yīxuě hé Yáng Tónglè shì zěnme shúxī qilai de?
How did Wang Yixue and Yang Tongle get to know each other well?
why: 后来他们一起出了次差，此次出差，让两人熟悉了起来。
Hòulái tāmen yìqǐ chūle cì chāi, cǐcì chūchāi, ràng liǎngrén shúxī le qilai.
一起出了次差 = went on a business trip together, and 此次出差 (this trip) made them close.

q: 李文是在哪儿遇见白家月的？
Lǐ Wén shì zài nǎr yùjiàn Bái Jiāyuè de?
Where did Li Wen meet Bai Jiayue?
why: 李文在校园里遇见白家月。
Lǐ Wén zài xiàoyuán li yùjiàn Bái Jiāyuè.
在校园里 = on campus. The supermarket appears in Text 1, but only as where he saw the chocolate.

q: “遇见你，刚刚好”是什么意思？
“Yùjiàn nǐ, gānggāng hǎo” shì shénme yìsi?
What does 遇见你，刚刚好 mean?
o: Yùdào nǐ shí tiānqì gānggāng hǎo
the weather was just right when I met you
Zài héshì de dìdiǎn yùjiàn nǐ
meeting you in the right place
在合适的时间遇到合适的人
Zài héshì de shíjiān yùdào héshì de rén
meeting the right person at the right time
why: 重要的是在合适的时间遇到了合适的人。遇见你，刚刚好。
Zhòngyào de shì zài héshì de shíjiān yùdào le héshì de rén. Yùjiàn nǐ, gānggāng hǎo.
The sentence right before explains it: meeting the right person at the right time (在合适的时间遇到合适的人).

en: Southerners just don't get the Northern cold

Learning everyday phrases is important for international students.

texts.title: At home, Liu Ming told Wang Yixue about something he had found online

lines.zh: 你看，这个小伙子从广州去哈尔滨出差，没想到哈尔滨的气温降到了零下二十几度，把他冻坏了。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhège xiǎohuǒzi cóng Guǎngzhōu qù Hā'ěrbīn chūchāi, méixiǎngdào Hā'ěrbīn de qìwēn jiàngdào le língxià èrshíjǐdù, bǎ tā dònghuài le.
lines.en: Look, this young man went from Guangzhou to Harbin on a business trip. He didn't expect the temperature in Harbin to drop to over twenty below zero, and he nearly froze.

lines.zh: 他一定后悔自己穿少了吧？
lines.py: Tā yídìng hòuhuǐ zìjǐ chuānshǎo le ba?
lines.en: He must regret not wearing enough clothes, right?

lines.zh: 是啊，这就叫南方不懂北方的冷。
lines.py: Shì a, zhè jiù jiào nánfāng bù dǒng běifāng de lěng.
lines.en: Yes, that's what they call "the South doesn't understand the North's cold".

lines.zh: 就是呢，冬天北方和南方的温度差别还是很大的。
lines.py: Jiùshì ne, dōngtiān běifāng hé nánfāng de wēndù chābié háishi hěn dà de.
lines.en: Exactly. In winter the temperature difference between north and south is really big.

lines.zh: 所以冬天来北方，尤其是东北，一定要提前查好目的地的天气，看看下不下雪，气温怎么样。
lines.py: Suǒyǐ dōngtiān lái běifāng, yóuqí shì Dōngběi, yídìng yào tíqián cháhǎo mùdìdì de tiānqì, kànkàn xià bu xiàxuě, qìwēn zěnmeyàng.
lines.en: So if you come north in winter, especially to the Northeast, be sure to check the weather at your destination in advance: whether it'll snow and what the temperature is.

lines.zh: 对。更重要的是，说什么也得穿上厚一点儿的衣服。
lines.py: Duì. Gèng zhòngyào de shì, shuō shénme yě děi chuānshang hòu yìdiǎnr de yīfu.
lines.en: Right. And more importantly, you absolutely must wear thicker clothes.

texts.title: On campus, Wang Yifei ran into Chen Tianzhong and Bai Jiayue after class

lines.zh: 寒假你们打算做什么呢？
lines.py: Hánjià nǐmen dǎsuàn zuò shénme ne?
lines.en: What are you planning for winter break?

lines.zh: 我们刚刚还说呢，家月春节时要去广州，我计划去哈尔滨。
lines.py: Wǒmen gānggāng hái shuō ne, Jiāyuè Chūnjié shí yào qù Guǎngzhōu, wǒ jìhuà qù Hā'ěrbīn.
lines.en: We were just talking about it. Jiayue is going to Guangzhou for Spring Festival, and I'm planning to go to Harbin.

lines.zh: 那时候广州暖和，但哈尔滨特别冷，气温一般都低于零下十摄氏度甚至零下二十摄氏度，这么低的温度你受不了吧？
lines.py: Nà shíhou Guǎngzhōu nuǎnhuo, dàn Hā'ěrbīn tèbié lěng, qìwēn yìbān dōu dīyú língxià shí shèshìdù shènzhì língxià èrshí shèshìdù, zhème dī de wēndù nǐ shòubuliǎo ba?
lines.en: Guangzhou will be warm then, but Harbin is really cold; the temperature is usually below minus ten or even minus twenty degrees Celsius. You can't stand such low temperatures, can you?

lines.zh: 没问题，受得了，我有的是厚衣服。我去哈尔滨主要是想看雪，听说春节时那里会举办很多活动。
lines.py: Méi wèntí, shòudeliǎo, wǒ yǒudeshì hòu yīfu. Wǒ qù Hā'ěrbīn zhǔyào shì xiǎng kànxuě, tīngshuō Chūnjié shí nàlǐ huì jǔbàn hěn duō huódòng.
lines.en: No problem, I can handle it. I've got plenty of thick clothes. I mainly want to see snow in Harbin, and I heard they hold lots of events there during the Spring Festival.

lines.zh: 我想在广州过年，那里冬天比较暖和。而且我喜欢看花，听说广州的鲜花市场很有名，里面有各种植物。
lines.py: Wǒ xiǎng zài Guǎngzhōu guònián, nàlǐ dōngtiān bǐjiào nuǎnhuo. Érqiě wǒ xǐhuan kànhuā, tīngshuō Guǎngzhōu de xiānhuā shìchǎng hěn yǒumíng, lǐmiàn yǒu gè zhòng zhíwù.
lines.en: I want to spend New Year in Guangzhou; it's fairly warm there in winter. Also, I like looking at flowers, and I heard Guangzhou's flower market is famous, with all kinds of plants.

lines.zh: 真不错！听你们这么一说，我也想外出旅游了。
lines.py: Zhēnbúcuò! Tīng nǐmen zhème yìshuō, wǒ yě xiǎng wàichū lǚyóu le.
lines.en: Sounds great! Hearing you talk like this, I want to go traveling too.

texts.title: Differences between Guangzhou and Harbin

lines.zh: 广州和哈尔滨，一个在南方，一个在北方，两个城市之间的距离有三千多公里，气候也大不相同。广州基本上没有冬天，而哈尔滨的冬天一般会从十月开始，到第二年的三四月才结束。广州四季开满鲜花，所以又叫“花城”；哈尔滨冬天冰雪多，所以也叫“冰城”。
lines.py: Guǎngzhōu hé Hā'ěrbīn, yí ge zài nánfāng, yí ge zài běifāng, liǎng ge chéngshì zhījiān de jùlí yǒu sānqiānduō gōnglǐ, qìhòu yě dàbùxiāngtóng. Guǎngzhōu jīběnshàng méiyǒudōngtiān, ér Hā'ěrbīn de dōngtiān yìbān huì cóng shíyuè kāishǐ, dào dì'èrnián de sān sìyuè cái jiéshù. Guǎngzhōu sìjì kāi mǎnxiānhuā, suǒyǐ yòu jiào “Huāchéng”; Hā'ěrbīn dōngtiān bīngxuě duō, suǒyǐ yě jiào “Bīngchéng”.
lines.en: Guangzhou and Harbin, one in the south and one in the north, are over 3,000 kilometers apart, and their climates are very different. Guangzhou basically has no winter, while Harbin's winter usually starts in October and doesn't end until March or April of the next year. Guangzhou is full of flowers all year, so it's also called the "Flower City"; Harbin has lots of ice and snow in winter, so it's also called the "Ice City".

lines.zh: 此外，两地的方言也不一样。哈尔滨方言和普通话听起来比较像，而广州方言和普通话差别较大。如果广州人和哈尔滨人都只使用自己的方言，那么交流就很困难，甚至还可能引起误会。其实，中国很多地方都有自己的方言，所以，为了顺利交流，中国人从小都要学习普通话。
lines.py: Cǐwài, liǎngdì de fāngyán yě bù yíyàng. Hā'ěrbīn fāngyán hé pǔtōnghuà tīng qilai bǐjiào xiàng, ér Guǎngzhōu fāngyán hé pǔtōnghuà chābié jiàodà. Rúguǒ Guǎngzhōu rén hé Hā'ěrbīn rén dōu zhǐ shǐyòng zìjǐ de fāngyán, nàme jiāoliú jiù hěn kùnnan, shènzhì hái kěnéng yǐnqǐ wùhuì. Qíshí, Zhōngguó hěn duō dìfang dōu yǒu zìjǐ de fāngyán, suǒyǐ, wèile shùnlì jiāoliú, Zhōngguó rén cóngxiǎo dōu yào xuéxí pǔtōnghuà.
lines.en: In addition, their dialects differ. The Harbin dialect sounds fairly similar to Mandarin, while the Guangzhou dialect is quite different. If people from Guangzhou and Harbin only used their own dialects, communication would be very hard and might even cause misunderstandings. In fact, many places in China have their own dialect, so to communicate smoothly, Chinese people all learn Mandarin from childhood.

texts.title: On World Environment Day, the Student Union of Liu Xiaoxue's school issued an activity initiative

lines.zh: 亲爱的同学们：
lines.py: Qīn'ài de tóngxuémen:
lines.en: Dear classmates:

lines.zh: 今年的“世界环境日”，我们再次开展“绿色生活”活动，希望同学们做到：
lines.py: Jīnnián de “Shìjiè Huánjìng Rì”, wǒmen zàicì kāizhǎn “lǜsè shēnghuó” huódòng, xīwàng tóngxuémen zuòdào:
lines.en: For this year's World Environment Day, we are once again launching the "Green Living" campaign. We hope everyone will:

lines.zh: 一、绿色出行。绿色一小步，环保一大步。根据距离选择绿色交通方式。距离短时可以走路或者骑自行车，距离长时多乘坐公交车或者地铁。
lines.py: Yī, lǜsè chūxíng. Lǜsè yì xiǎobù, huánbǎo yídàbù. Gēnjù jùlí xuǎnzé lǜsè jiāotōng fāngshì. Jùlí duǎnshí kěyǐ zǒulù huòzhě qí zìxíngchē, jùlí cháng shí duō chéngzuò gōngjiāochē huòzhě dìtiě.
lines.en: 1. Commute green. A small green step is a big step for the environment. Choose green transport according to distance: walk or bike for short distances, and take the bus or subway for long ones.

lines.zh: 二、拒绝浪费。节约资源，坚持一水多用、人走灯关、餐餐都“光盘”。
lines.py: Èr, jùjué làngfèi. Jiéyuēzīyuán, jiānchí yìshuǐ duōyòng, rén zǒu dēngguān, cāncān dōu “guāngpán”.
lines.en: 2. Say no to waste. Save resources: reuse water, turn off the lights when you leave, and clean your plate at every meal.

lines.zh: 三、垃圾分类。积极参加校园、小区环保活动，学习垃圾分类知识，从小事做起，做好垃圾分类。
lines.py: Sān, lājī fēnlèi. Jījí cānjiā xiàoyuán, xiǎoqū huánbǎo huódòng, xuéxí lājī fēnlèi zhīshi, cóng xiǎoshì zuòqǐ, zuòhǎo lājī fēnlèi.
lines.en: 3. Sort your trash. Actively join environmental activities on campus and in your neighborhood, learn about trash sorting, start with small things, and sort your garbage properly.

lines.zh: 保护环境是每一个人的责任。同学们，让我们共同努力，让绿色生活成为我们的日常习惯！
lines.py: Bǎohùhuánjìng shì měi yí ge rén de zérèn. Tóngxuémen, ràng wǒmen gòngtóngnǔlì, ràng lǜsè shēnghuó chéngwéi wǒmen de rìcháng xíguàn!
lines.en: Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility. Classmates, let's work together and make green living our everyday habit!

lines.zh: 校学生会　2026年6月5日
lines.py: Xiào xuéshēnghuì èr líng èr liù nián liù yuè wǔ rì
lines.en: School Student Union, June 5, 2026

grammar.title: Fixed pattern 说什么/怎么(着)也得×
grammar.note: 说什么也得 / 怎么(着)也得 + verb expresses necessity or determination: "no matter what, must …". Common in spoken Chinese.
ex: 更重要的是，说什么也得穿上厚一点儿的衣服。
Gèng zhòngyào de shì, shuō shénme yě děi chuānshang hòu yìdiǎnr de yīfu.
More importantly, you absolutely must wear thicker clothes.
假期还有两天就结束了，我明天说什么也得把作业做完了。
Jiàqī hái yǒu liǎngtiān jiù jiéshù le, wǒ míngtiān shuō shénme yě děi bǎ zuòyè zuò wán le.
The holiday ends in two days; no matter what, I have to finish my homework tomorrow.
我很后悔上次没参加这个活动，这次怎么着也得去。
Wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ shàngcì méi cānjiā zhège huódòng, zhè cì zěnmezhe yě děi qù.
I really regret missing this event last time; this time I'm going no matter what.

grammar.title: Set phrase 有的是
grammar.note: 有的是 is common in spoken Chinese and means there is plenty of something: "have plenty of / there's no shortage of".
ex: 没问题，受得了，我有的是厚衣服。
Méi wèntí, shòudeliǎo, wǒ yǒudeshì hòu yīfu.
No problem, I can handle it. I've got plenty of thick clothes.
过年时，家里有的是好吃的、好喝的，孩子们特别开心。
Guònián shí, jiālǐ yǒudeshì hǎochī de, hǎohē de, háizi men tèbié kāixīn.
At New Year there's plenty of good food and drink at home, and the kids are very happy.
这个市场特别大，有的是水果和菜，你想买什么菜都能买到。
Zhège shìchǎng tèbié dà, yǒudeshì shuǐguǒ hé cài, nǐ xiǎng mǎi shénme cài dōu néng mǎi dào.
This market is huge, with plenty of fruit and vegetables; you can buy whatever you want.

grammar.title: Conjunction 而
grammar.note: 而 connects verbs, adjectives, phrases or clauses. Three uses here: (1) contrast: the two parts are opposite ("but / while"); (2) continuation: the meanings follow on ("and"); (3) cause and effect between the parts.
ex: 广州基本上没有冬天，而哈尔滨的冬天一般会从十月开始，到第二年的三四月才结束。
Guǎngzhōu jīběnshàng méiyǒudōngtiān, ér Hā'ěrbīn de dōngtiān yìbān huì cóng shíyuè kāishǐ, dào dì'èrnián de sān sìyuè cái jiéshù.
Guangzhou has basically no winter, while Harbin's winter starts in October and ends in March or April of the next year. (contrast)
在这个紧张而兴奋（xīngfèn）的日子里，我们都走出教室，为运动员们加油。
Zài zhège jǐnzhāng ér xīngfèn (xīngfèn) de rìzi li, wǒmen dōu zǒuchū jiàoshì, wèi yùndòngyuán men jiāyóu.
On this tense and exciting day, we all left the classroom to cheer for the athletes. (continuation)
冬天，这个城市因为天气暖和而吸引了很多游客。
Dōngtiān, zhège chéngshì yīnwèi tiānqì nuǎnhuo ér xīyǐn le hěn duō yóukè.
In winter, this city attracts many tourists because of its warm weather. (cause and effect)

grammar.title: Adverb of frequency 再次
grammar.note: 再次 goes before a verb and means "for a second time / once more / again".
ex: 今年的“世界环境日”，我们再次开展“绿色生活”活动。
Jīnnián de “Shìjiè Huánjìng Rì”, wǒmen zàicì kāizhǎn “lǜsè shēnghuó” huódòng.
For this year's World Environment Day, we're once again launching the "Green Living" campaign.
我去年冬天去过一次哈尔滨，很喜欢那里的雪；今年冬天，我计划再次去哈尔滨看雪。
Wǒ qùnián dōngtiān qùguo yí cì Hā'ěrbīn, hěn xǐhuan nàlǐ de xuě; jīnniándōngtiān, wǒ jìhuà zàicì qù Hā'ěrbīn kànxuě.
I went to Harbin last winter and loved the snow; this winter I plan to go again to see it.
再次感谢您的支持与关心！
Zàicì gǎnxiènín de zhīchí yǔ guānxīn!
Thank you once again for your support and care!

fill.q: 这个时候你还是不要乱说话，否则可能会＿＿更大的误会。
full: 这个时候你还是不要乱说话，否则可能会引起更大的误会。
Zhège shíhou nǐ háishi búyào luànshuōhuà, fǒuzé kěnéng huì yǐnqǐ gèngdà de wùhuì.
You'd better not say anything careless now, or it may cause an even bigger misunderstanding.
fill.why: 引起误会 = cause a misunderstanding. 引起 + bad result is a fixed collocation.

fill.q: 为了保护环境，我们学校每年都＿＿垃圾分类活动。
full: 为了保护环境，我们学校每年都举办垃圾分类活动。
Wèile bǎohùhuánjìng, wǒmen xuéxiào měinián dōu jǔbàn lājī fēnlèi huódòng.
To protect the environment, our school holds a trash-sorting event every year.
fill.why: 举办活动 = hold an event. 每年都举办 + event name.

fill.q: 老师说我们一定要学好知识、打好基础，＿＿，还要多出去走走，了解市场情况。
full: 老师说我们一定要学好知识、打好基础，此外，还要多出去走走，了解市场情况。
Lǎoshī shuō wǒmen yídìng yào xuéhǎo zhīshi, dǎ hǎo jīchǔ, cǐwài, háiyào duō chūqu zǒuzǒu, liǎojiě shìchǎng qíngkuàng.
The teacher said we must learn well and build a solid foundation; in addition, we should get out more and understand the market.
fill.why: 此外 = in addition; it adds one more piece of advice after 学好知识、打好基础.

fill.q: 这本书太＿＿了，一个星期都看不完。
full: 这本书太厚了，一个星期都看不完。
Zhè běnshū tàihòu le, yí ge xīngqī dōu kànbuwán.
This book is too thick; I can't finish it in a week.
fill.why: 书太厚了 → can't finish it in a week. 厚 (thick) describes books and clothes.

fill.q: 每个人平时都应该注意＿＿用水，不要浪费。
full: 每个人平时都应该注意节约用水，不要浪费。
Měi ge rén píngshí dōu yīnggāi zhùyì jiéyuēyòngshuǐ, búyào làngfèi.
Everyone should pay attention to saving water and not waste it.
fill.why: 节约用水 = save water; 不要浪费 confirms the meaning.

fill.q: A：老师今天怎么一直咳嗽？B：＿＿啊，是不是感冒了？
full: A：老师今天怎么一直咳嗽？B：就是啊，是不是感冒了？
A: Lǎoshī jīntiān zěnme yìzhí késou? B: Jiùshì a, shìbushì gǎnmào le?
A: Why does the teacher keep coughing today? B: Right? Maybe she has a cold.
fill.why: 就是啊 = exactly / I know, right? It agrees with what A just said.

fill.q: A：北京那天只有零下五＿＿，你们还是去了长城？B：是的，我们去爬了长城。虽然温度低，但风不大，不觉得冷。
full: A：北京那天只有零下五摄氏度，你们还是去了长城？B：是的，我们去爬了长城。虽然温度低，但风不大，不觉得冷。
A: Běijīng nàtiān zhǐyǒu língxià wǔ shèshìdù, nǐmen háishi qù le Chángchéng? B: Shì de, wǒmen qù pá le Chángchéng. Suīrán wēndù dī, dànfēng búdà, bù juéde lěng.
A: It was only minus five degrees Celsius in Beijing that day, and you still went to the Great Wall? B: Yes, we climbed it. Although it was cold, there wasn't much wind, so it didn't feel cold.
fill.why: 零下五摄氏度 = minus five degrees Celsius. A number + temperature unit.

fill.q: A：你怎么回来了？B：那里太冷了，我实在＿＿那儿的气候。
full: A：你怎么回来了？B：那里太冷了，我实在受不了那儿的气候。
A: Nǐ zěnme huílai le? B: Nàlǐ tàilěng le, wǒ shízài shòubuliǎo nàr de qìhòu.
A: Why did you come back? B: It was too cold there; I really couldn't stand the climate.
fill.why: 受不了 + something = can't stand something. 受不了那儿的气候.

fill.q: A：不好意思，我＿＿说得不太好。B：没有啊，我觉得您说得挺好的。
full: A：不好意思，我普通话说得不太好。B：没有啊，我觉得您说得挺好的。
A: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ pǔtōnghuà shuō de bú tài hǎo. B: Méiyǒu a, wǒ juéde nín shuō de tǐng hǎo de.
A: Sorry, my Mandarin isn't very good. B: Not at all, I think you speak it quite well.
fill.why: 普通话说得不太好 = my Mandarin isn't good. A language noun goes before 说得.

fill.q: A：这些垃圾不能放在一起，不＿＿。B：好的，我们马上就把它们分好类。
full: A：这些垃圾不能放在一起，不环保。B：好的，我们马上就把它们分好类。
A: Zhèxiē lājī bù néng fàngzài yìqǐ, bù huánbǎo. B: Hǎo de, wǒmen mǎshàng jiù bǎ tāmen fēnhǎo lèi.
A: This trash can't all go together; it's not eco-friendly. B: OK, we'll sort it right away.
fill.why: 放在一起，不环保 = putting them together isn't eco-friendly; B then sorts the trash.

q: 小伙子去哈尔滨出差，那里的气温降到了多少度？
Xiǎohuǒzi qù Hā'ěrbīn chūchāi, nàlǐ de qìwēn jiàngdào le duōshao dù?
The young man went to Harbin on business. How low did the temperature drop?
why: 没想到哈尔滨的气温降到了零下二十几度。
Méixiǎngdào Hā'ěrbīn de qìwēn jiàngdào le língxià èrshíjǐdù.
零下二十几度 = twenty-something degrees below zero. Listen for 零下 (below zero) and 二十几.

q: “南方不懂北方的冷”是什么意思？
“Nánfāng bù dǒng běifāng de lěng” shì shénme yìsi?
What does 南方不懂北方的冷 mean?
o: 南方人比北方人更怕冷
Nánfāngrén bǐ běifāng rén gèng pàlěng
southerners fear the cold more than northerners
南方人不知道北方天天下雪
Nánfāngrén bù zhīdào běifāng tiāntiān xiàxuě
southerners don't know it snows every day in the north
南方人不知道北方的冬天有多冷
Nánfāngrén bù zhīdào běifāng de dōngtiān yǒu duō lěng
southerners don't know how cold northern winters are
南方人不了解北方的冬天有多长
Nánfāngrén bù liǎojiě běifāng de dōngtiān yǒu duōzhǎng
southerners don't know how long northern winters are
why: 冬天北方和南方的温度差别还是很大的。
Dōngtiān běifāng hé nánfāng de wēndù chābié háishi hěn dà de.
The young man from the south didn't expect how cold Harbin would be. The saying means southerners don't know how cold northern winters are (C).

q: 白家月春节时打算做什么？
Bái Jiāyuè Chūnjié shí dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
What is Bai Jiayue planning for the Spring Festival?
o: go to Guangzhou to see flowers
go to Guangzhou to see the sea
go to Harbin to see snow
why: 我想在广州过年……而且我喜欢看花，听说广州的鲜花市场很有名。
Wǒ xiǎng zài Guǎngzhōu guònián…… érqiě wǒ xǐhuan kànhuā, tīngshuō Guǎngzhōu de xiānhuā shìchǎng hěn yǒumíng.
She's going to Guangzhou for the warm weather and to see flowers (去广州看花). Harbin is Chen Tianzhong's plan.

q: 陈天中春节时去哈尔滨，王一飞担心他什么？
Chén Tiānzhōng Chūnjié shí qù Hā'ěrbīn, Wáng Yīfēi dānxīn tā shénme?
Chen Tianzhong is going to Harbin. What is Wang Yifei worried about?
why: 这么低的温度你受不了吧？
Zhème dī de wēndù nǐ shòubuliǎo ba?
Wang Yifei worries he can't stand the low temperature (受不了那里的气温). The snow is what he wants to see.

q: 广州和哈尔滨之间有多远？
Guǎngzhōu hé Hā'ěrbīn zhījiān yǒuduōyuǎn?
How far apart are Guangzhou and Harbin?
why: 两个城市之间的距离有三千多公里。
Liǎng ge chéngshì zhījiān de jùlí yǒu sānqiānduō gōnglǐ.
三千多公里 = over 3,000 km. The text gives distance, not travel time.

q: 关于广州和哈尔滨，可以知道什么？
Guānyú Guǎngzhōu hé Hā'ěrbīn, kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What do we know about Guangzhou and Harbin?
o: it often snows in Harbin in winter
why: 哈尔滨冬天冰雪多，所以也叫“冰城”。
Hā'ěrbīn dōngtiān bīngxuě duō, suǒyǐ yě jiào “Bīngchéng”.
Harbin has lots of ice and snow in winter. A is wrong (Guangzhou has basically no winter), B is wrong (all Chinese learn Mandarin), C is wrong (dialects differ).

q: “世界环境日”时，校学生会再次开展：
“Shìjiè Huánjìng Rì” shí, xiào xuéshēnghuì zàicì kāizhǎn:
On World Environment Day, the Student Union is again launching:
why: 我们再次开展“绿色生活”活动。
Wǒmen zàicì kāizhǎn “lǜsè shēnghuó” huódòng.
The campaign is called “绿色生活” (Green Living). Trash sorting and saving resources are parts of it, not its name.

q: 下列哪项不是课文中说的节约资源的方法？
Xiàliè nǎxiàng búshì kèwén zhōng shuō de jiéyuēzīyuán de fāngfǎ?
Which is NOT a way to save resources mentioned in the text?
o: turn off the lights when you leave
clean your plate at every meal
why: 坚持一水多用、人走灯关、餐餐都“光盘”。
Jiānchí yìshuǐ duōyòng, rén zǒu dēngguān, cāncān dōu “guāngpán”.
The three methods listed are reusing water, turning off lights and cleaning your plate. Using the air conditioner less is NOT mentioned, so B.
